subject: api.callback
text: The api.callback type has no attribute for the callback's map-key name (e.g. 'onPaymentComplete'), so the callback name cannot be captured.
proposed_change: Add a name attribute to api.callback holding the callback map key.

subject: api.callback
text: It is unclear whether one api.callback node represents a named callback (a map entry) or a single expression entry within it, since the definition and the expression attribute blur the two.
proposed_change: Clarify the definition to state whether a node is a named callback or a single expression-to-PathItem entry, and align attributes accordingly.

subject: api.callback
text: The 'uses' relationship from api.callback to api.server is dubious because callback targets are resolved at runtime and do not correspond to a declared server.
proposed_change: Remove or reconsider the uses relationship from api.callback to api.server.

subject: api.callback
text: The api layer description mentions webhooks, but no webhook element type exists; webhooks are an OpenAPI 3.1 concept that could be confused with callbacks.
proposed_change: Either add a webhook type or remove the webhook mention from the layer description, and document the distinction from callbacks.

subject: api.components
text: The composes relationship from api.components to api.paths is invalid because an OpenAPI 3.0 Components object has no paths or pathItems (these exist only in 3.1).
proposed_change: Remove the composes relationship from api.components to api.paths.

subject: api.components
text: The composes relationship from api.components to api.responses is wrong because components.responses holds individual Response objects, not a Responses map.
proposed_change: Drop the composes relationship from api.components to api.responses.

subject: api.components
text: api.response is related to api.components by both an aggregates and a composes relationship, which express the same meaning redundantly.
proposed_change: Keep only one of aggregates or composes between api.components and api.response.

subject: api.components
text: The association between api.oauthflows and api.components is spurious because OAuth flows nest within securityscheme, not directly in components.
proposed_change: Remove the association from api.oauthflows to api.components.

subject: api.contact
text: The api.contact definition mentions a 'name' but the type has no name attribute, although the OpenAPI Contact Object defines name, url and email.
proposed_change: Add a name attribute (string) to api.contact.

subject: api.contact
text: The associated-with relationship from api.contact to api.openapidocument duplicates the path through api.info aggregates, since Contact is reachable only via Info in OpenAPI 3.0.
proposed_change: Remove the associated-with relationship between api.contact and api.openapidocument.

subject: api.encoding
text: The api.encoding style attribute's description claims it applies to multipart/form-data, but per OpenAPI 3.0 style, explode and allowReserved apply only to application/x-www-form-urlencoded.
proposed_change: Reword the style description to say it applies only to application/x-www-form-urlencoded and remove the multipart mention.

subject: api.encoding
text: The api.encoding style enum includes matrix, label and simple, but OpenAPI 3.0 allows only form, spaceDelimited, pipeDelimited and deepObject for Encoding style.
proposed_change: Restrict the style enum to form, spaceDelimited, pipeDelimited and deepObject.

subject: api.encoding
text: The api.encoding definition states it 'Handles complex content negotiation', which is inaccurate for an Encoding object.
proposed_change: Remove the 'Handles complex content negotiation' sentence from the definition.

subject: api.encoding
text: api.encoding lacks a 'headers' attribute for the headers map that OpenAPI 3.0 Encoding objects support.
proposed_change: Add a headers attribute to api.encoding.

subject: api.encoding
text: The association between api.encoding and api.parameter is spurious because encoding applies to request body properties, not parameters.
proposed_change: Remove the relationship between api.encoding and api.parameter.

subject: api.example
text: The attribute api.example.value is typed string, but OpenAPI allows any JSON value for an example value, so it should be typed any.
proposed_change: Change the type of api.example.value from string to any.

subject: api.example
text: Relationships from api.requestbody and api.servervariable to api.example are non-standard because OpenAPI 3.0 RequestBody and ServerVariable have no examples field.
proposed_change: Remove the requestbody-to-example and servervariable-to-example relationships or mark them as non-standard.

subject: api.example
text: The association between api.example and api.operation is not part of OpenAPI 3.0.
proposed_change: Remove the example-to-operation relationship or mark it as non-standard.

subject: api.example
text: api.example has no attribute capturing the map-key name under which the example is registered in the examples map.
proposed_change: Add a name attribute to api.example holding the examples map key.

subject: api.externaldocumentation
text: The incoming 'references' relationship from api.pathitem to api.externaldocumentation has no basis in OpenAPI 3.0 because PathItem has no externalDocs field.
proposed_change: Remove the 'references' relationship from api.pathitem to api.externaldocumentation.

subject: api.externaldocumentation
text: The incoming 'references' relationship from api.paths to api.externaldocumentation has no basis in OpenAPI 3.0 because Paths has no externalDocs field.
proposed_change: Remove the 'references' relationship from api.paths to api.externaldocumentation.

subject: api.externaldocumentation
text: The outgoing 'associated-with' relationship from api.externaldocumentation to api.info has no basis in OpenAPI 3.0 because Info has no externalDocs field.
proposed_change: Remove the 'associated-with' relationship from api.externaldocumentation to api.info.

subject: api.externaldocumentation
text: A 'serves' relationship from api.externaldocumentation to api.tag is missing, although Tag has an externalDocs field.
proposed_change: Add a 'serves' relationship from api.externaldocumentation to api.tag.

subject: api.externaldocumentation
text: The externalDocs attribute is typed object on api.schema but string on api.openapidocument, which is inconsistent for the same reference to ExternalDocumentation.
proposed_change: Type both externalDocs attributes as the same reference type pointing to api.externaldocumentation.

subject: api.header
text: The api.header definition says headers are for 'responses or request components', which is misleading because request headers are modelled as Parameters with in: header.
proposed_change: Reword the definition to drop the 'request components' wording and state that request headers are Parameters (in: header).

subject: api.header
text: The api.header definition refers to a 'name' attribute as a local identifier, but no 'name' attribute is listed on the type.
proposed_change: Either add a 'name' attribute or remove the mention of 'name' from the definition.

subject: api.header
text: The api.header.style enum lists values (matrix, label, form, spaceDelimited, pipeDelimited, deepObject) that OAS 3.0 does not allow for headers, which are restricted to 'simple'.
proposed_change: Narrow the style enum to 'simple' only or remove the attribute.

subject: api.header
text: The attributes allowEmptyValue and allowReserved on api.header apply only to query parameters in OAS 3.0 and so do not belong on a header.
proposed_change: Remove allowEmptyValue and allowReserved from api.header.

subject: api.info
text: The relationship api.externaldocumentation → api.info has no OpenAPI 3.0 basis because the Info object has no externalDocs field; external documentation belongs on api.openapidocument.
proposed_change: Remove the api.externaldocumentation → api.info relationship and attach external documentation to api.openapidocument instead.

subject: api.info
text: The outgoing 'associated-with' relationship from api.info to api.openapidocument duplicates the incoming 'composes' relationship between the same pair of types.
proposed_change: Remove the info→openapidocument 'associated-with' relationship and keep the 'composes' edge.

subject: api.info
text: The string attributes api.info.contact and api.info.license duplicate the aggregates relationships from api.info to api.contact and api.license.
proposed_change: Remove the contact and license string attributes and rely on the aggregates relationships.

subject: api.license
text: The api.license type does not list the OpenAPI License Object's required 'name' field as an attribute; it is presumably carried by the element's generic name, but this is not stated explicitly.
proposed_change: State explicitly in the api.license definition that the OpenAPI 'name' field is carried by the element's generic name (or add a name attribute).

subject: api.license
text: The outgoing associated-with relationship from api.license to api.openapidocument may be redundant because the same connection is already expressed via api.info aggregation.
proposed_change: Remove the associated-with relationship from api.license to api.openapidocument, relying on the path through api.info.

subject: api.link
text: The outgoing relationships from api.link to api.tag and api.schema have no basis in the OpenAPI Link Object and should be removed.
proposed_change: Remove the relationships from api.link to api.tag and api.schema.

subject: api.link
text: The 'uses' relationship from api.link to api.server reflects the Link Object 'server' field, but api.link has no corresponding 'server' attribute.
proposed_change: Add a 'server' attribute to api.link capturing the Link Object server field.

subject: api.link
text: The relationship from api.responses to api.link is questionable because Links attach to an individual Response, not to the Responses container.
proposed_change: Remove the api.responses to api.link edge and attach links to api.response instead.

subject: api.link
text: Modellers may confuse api.link with HAL-style payload links carried in response bodies.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: api.mediatype
text: The api.mediatype description of 'example' refers to an 'examples' map, but no 'examples' attribute is modelled on api.mediatype.
proposed_change: Add an 'examples' map attribute to api.mediatype, or rely on the api.example relationships and remove the reference.

subject: api.mediatype
text: The attribute api.mediatype.example is typed string, but OpenAPI allows an example to be any value, not just a string.
proposed_change: Change the type of 'example' to allow any value (e.g. any/json) instead of string.

subject: api.mediatype
text: api.mediatype has both aggregates and composes relationships toward api.encoding, which are duplicate and ambiguous.
proposed_change: Keep a single relationship (composes) from api.mediatype to api.encoding and remove the other.

subject: api.mediatype
text: api.mediatype has both aggregates and references relationships toward api.example, which are duplicate and ambiguous.
proposed_change: Keep one relationship from api.mediatype to api.example and remove the duplicate.

subject: api.mediatype
text: api.mediatype has both aggregates and references relationships toward api.schema, which are duplicate and ambiguous.
proposed_change: Keep one relationship from api.mediatype to api.schema and remove the duplicate.

subject: api.mediatype
text: The associated-with relationship from api.mediatype to api.header has no basis in OpenAPI, since headers belong to Encoding or Response rather than MediaType.
proposed_change: Remove the associated-with relationship from api.mediatype to api.header.

subject: api.oauthflow
text: api.oauthflow has no explicit flowType attribute; its grant type is only implied by which parent OAuthFlows field references it, so an explicit flowType enum is suggested for classification.
proposed_change: Add a flowType enum attribute (implicit, password, clientCredentials, authorizationCode) to api.oauthflow.

subject: api.oauthflow
text: The outgoing relationship from api.oauthflow to api.tag (aggregates) looks spurious because an OAuth flow is consumed only via its SecurityScheme.
proposed_change: Remove the aggregates relationship from api.oauthflow to api.tag.

subject: api.oauthflow
text: The outgoing relationship from api.oauthflow to api.ratelimit looks spurious because an OAuth flow is consumed only via its SecurityScheme.
proposed_change: Remove the relationship from api.oauthflow to api.ratelimit.

subject: api.oauthflow
text: The outgoing relationship from api.oauthflow to api.server looks spurious because an OAuth flow is consumed only via its SecurityScheme.
proposed_change: Remove the relationship from api.oauthflow to api.server.

subject: api.oauthflow
text: The outgoing serves relationship from api.oauthflow to api.operation looks spurious because an OAuth flow is consumed only via its SecurityScheme.
proposed_change: Remove the serves relationship from api.oauthflow to api.operation.

subject: api.oauthflow
text: api.oauthflows has both an aggregates and a composes relationship to api.oauthflow, which express the same meaning.
proposed_change: Keep only the composes relationship and remove the aggregates relationship from api.oauthflows to api.oauthflow.

subject: api.oauthflows
text: The type api.oauthflows has no attributes or other means to represent its four grant-type slots (implicit, password, clientCredentials, authorizationCode), so the grant type of each child OAuthFlow cannot be recorded even though api.oauthflow says the type is implied by the parent slot.
proposed_change: Model the grant-type slots as an attribute on api.oauthflows or as a qualifier on the oauthflows-to-oauthflow relationship.

subject: api.oauthflows
text: The link from api.oauthflows to api.oauthflow is listed both as 'aggregates' and as 'composes', which express the same meaning.
proposed_change: Keep only one of the two relationships (composes is the likely fit) and remove the other.

subject: api.oauthflows
text: The associations from api.oauthflows to api.operation and to api.components look spurious.
proposed_change: Remove the associations from api.oauthflows to api.operation and api.components.

subject: api.openapidocument
text: The reference attributes info, servers, components and tags on api.openapidocument are typed string but duplicate the composes/aggregates relationships, so only one mechanism (attribute or relationship) should be used.
proposed_change: Pick one mechanism: either remove the string reference attributes or remove the duplicating composes/aggregates relationships.

subject: api.openapidocument
text: The attributes servers and tags on api.openapidocument should be arrays rather than a single string.
proposed_change: Change the type of servers and tags to arrays.

subject: api.openapidocument
text: The outgoing composes relationships from api.openapidocument to api.responses and api.schema contradict OpenAPI, where these live under Components or Operations rather than the root document.
proposed_change: Remove the composes relationships from api.openapidocument to api.responses and api.schema.

subject: api.openapidocument
text: The relationship from api.info to api.openapidocument with predicate 'associated-with' duplicates the composes relationship from api.openapidocument to api.info.
proposed_change: Remove the info→openapidocument 'associated-with' relationship and keep the document→info composes.

subject: api.operation
text: The attributes operationId, summary and tags of api.operation are marked required although OpenAPI 3.0 makes them optional, so valid specs would be rejected.
proposed_change: Make operationId, summary and tags optional (not required).

subject: api.operation
text: The attribute api.operation.tags is typed as a string but should be an array of strings.
proposed_change: Change the type of tags from string to array of strings.

subject: api.operation
text: The attribute api.operation.http_path duplicates the key of the parent PathItem and is therefore redundant.
proposed_change: Remove http_path or derive it from the parent PathItem key.

subject: api.operation
text: api.operation has no security attribute although its definition discusses operation-level security overriding global security, including the empty array case.
proposed_change: Add a security attribute (array of security requirements, where an empty array removes security) to api.operation.

subject: api.operation
text: The outgoing 'composes api.paths' relationship from api.operation is inverted, since Paths composes operations (via PathItem) rather than the reverse.
proposed_change: Reverse the edge or remove it so that paths/pathitem composes operation.

subject: api.operation
text: Operations located inside callback PathItems are ambiguous with respect to api.operation, since it is unclear whether they are the same kind of operation as those under Paths.
proposed_change: Clarify in the definition or add a boundary rule for how operations inside callback PathItems are modeled.

subject: api.parameter
text: The api.parameter type lacks the required OpenAPI 'name' attribute, even though (name, in) together form the parameter's identity.
proposed_change: Add a required string attribute 'name' to api.parameter.

subject: api.parameter
text: The outgoing 'references' relationship from api.parameter to api.tag looks wrong because parameters do not reference tags.
proposed_change: Remove the references relationship from api.parameter to api.tag.

subject: api.parameter
text: The outgoing 'references' relationship from api.parameter to api.operation is redundant because operation-to-parameter already exists as an aggregates relationship, and it points the opposite way.
proposed_change: Remove the references relationship from api.parameter to api.operation and keep the operation aggregates parameter relationship.

subject: api.parameter
text: The attribute 'example: any' on api.parameter sits uneasily beside the api.example relationship, creating overlap or ambiguity about how examples are represented.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: api.pathitem
text: api.pathitem has no attribute holding the path template itself (the map key, e.g. /users/{userId}).
proposed_change: Add an attribute (e.g. path_template) to api.pathitem holding the path template.

subject: api.pathitem
text: api.pathitem has no attribute for the PathItem-level $ref.
proposed_change: Add a ref attribute to api.pathitem for the PathItem-level $ref.

subject: api.pathitem
text: api.operation duplicates the path template in its http_path attribute, which overlaps with the path held by the parent api.pathitem.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: api.pathitem
text: The cross-layer relations from api.pathitem (realizes businessfunction, requires securitypolicy, depends-on technologyservice) overlap with the same relations defined at the api.operation level.
proposed_change: Remove the duplicated cross-layer relations from api.pathitem or define a precedence rule relative to operation-level relations.

subject: api.pathitem
text: The api.pathitem to api.pathitem 'references' relation, which stands in for $ref, is listed twice in the catalog.
proposed_change: Remove the duplicate 'references' relationship entry and keep one.

subject: api.paths
text: Relationships from api.paths to servers, tags, externalDocs and rate limits do not match OpenAPI 3.0, since the Paths Object holds none of these (servers belong to PathItem/Operation).
proposed_change: Remove the relationships from api.paths to api.server, api.tag, api.externaldocumentation and api.ratelimit.

subject: api.paths
text: A relationship between api.components and api.paths is incorrect because Components does not contain paths in OpenAPI 3.0.
proposed_change: Remove the api.components to api.paths relationship.

subject: api.paths
text: The relationship 'api.operation composes api.paths' inverts containment, since paths contain operations via path items.
proposed_change: Remove or reverse the relationship so containment does not run from api.operation to api.paths.

subject: api.paths
text: api.paths has duplicate aggregates and composes relationships to api.pathitem that express the same meaning.
proposed_change: Keep only the composes relationship and remove the aggregates edge.

subject: api.paths
text: api.paths has no way to represent x- specification extension keys allowed by OpenAPI on the Paths Object.
proposed_change: Consider adding support for x- extension keys on api.paths.

subject: api.ratelimit
text: api.ratelimit is not an OpenAPI 3.0 construct, so the api layer's standard does not ground it.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: api.ratelimit
text: The scope and keyBy attributes of api.ratelimit overlap; for example scope 'per-ip' duplicates keyBy 'request.ip'.
proposed_change: Derive one of scope or keyBy from the other so they do not duplicate information.

subject: api.ratelimit
text: The format of the api.ratelimit window attribute is unspecified; ISO 8601 duration is suggested.
proposed_change: Specify the window value format as an ISO 8601 duration.

subject: api.ratelimit
text: api.ratelimit lacks a burst/capacity attribute needed for token-bucket limiters.
proposed_change: Add a burst/capacity attribute to api.ratelimit.

subject: api.ratelimit
text: The 'governs' and 'serves' relationships from api.ratelimit to api.operation appear redundant.
proposed_change: Remove one of the two redundant relationships.

subject: api.requestbody
text: The required 'content' map of api.requestbody has no attribute and is representable only through relationships to api.mediatype.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: api.requestbody
text: api.requestbody declares both 'aggregates' and 'composes' relationships to api.mediatype, plus a 'mediatype serves requestbody' relationship, which are redundant and inconsistent.
proposed_change: Keep only one relationship between api.requestbody and api.mediatype and remove the others.

subject: api.requestbody
text: api.requestbody has direct relationships to api.example, api.schema and api.encoding that bypass api.mediatype, where OpenAPI places them.
proposed_change: Remove the direct links from api.requestbody to api.example, api.schema and api.encoding and route them via api.mediatype.

subject: api.response
text: The api.response type has no attribute holding the HTTP status code, which exists only as the map key in api.responses; a statusCode attribute is suggested.
proposed_change: Add a statusCode attribute to api.response.

subject: api.response
text: Relationships from api.response to api.header and to api.mediatype are declared as both aggregates and composes, which is redundant.
proposed_change: Keep only one of aggregates or composes for each of the response-to-header and response-to-mediatype pairs.

subject: api.response
text: The relationship 'api.mediatype --serves--> api.response' points in the reverse of the natural direction.
proposed_change: Reverse the relationship so it goes from api.response to api.mediatype, or replace it with a composition from response to mediatype.

subject: api.response
text: The api.responses definition wrongly states that 2XX status ranges are unsupported, whereas OpenAPI 3.0 allows range keys 1XX through 5XX.
proposed_change: Correct the api.responses definition to say that 1XX–5XX range keys are supported.

subject: api.responses
text: The api.responses definition wrongly says status code ranges (e.g., 2XX) are not supported; OpenAPI 3.0 permits uppercase range keys 1XX-5XX.
proposed_change: Rewrite the definition to state that keys may be specific status codes, uppercase ranges 1XX-5XX, or 'default'.

subject: api.responses
text: The relationship from api.openapidocument to api.responses is invalid because the OpenAPI document has no root Responses object.
proposed_change: Remove the relationship between api.openapidocument and api.responses.

subject: api.responses
text: The relationship from api.components to api.responses is invalid because components.responses holds Response objects, not a Responses object.
proposed_change: Remove the components to responses relationship (components should relate to api.response instead).

subject: api.responses
text: The aggregates relationships to header and schema and the references relationship to link are attributed to api.responses but belong on api.response.
proposed_change: Move the aggregates header, aggregates schema and references link relationships from api.responses to api.response.

subject: api.responses
text: api.responses has no attributes and could gain a 'statusCodes' attribute listing the defined keys.
proposed_change: Add a 'statusCodes' attribute listing the status code keys defined in the map.

subject: api.schema
text: The api.schema definition says it uses a subset of JSON Schema Draft 7, but OpenAPI 3.0 uses an extended subset of JSON Schema Wright Draft 00, so the reference is wrong.
proposed_change: Correct the definition to say OpenAPI 3.0 uses an extended subset of JSON Schema Wright Draft 00 instead of Draft 7.

subject: api.schema
text: The word 'inline' in the api.schema definition conflicts with the fact that components compose (hold) schemas, since schemas may be named component entries.
proposed_change: Reword the definition to remove 'inline' so it covers both component-registered and nested schemas.

subject: api.schema
text: The api.schema 'type' attribute is a free string and needs an enum of allowed values.
proposed_change: Define an enum for type (string, number, integer, boolean, array, object).

subject: api.schema
text: The api.schema 'default' attribute is typed string but should be typed any because defaults can be any value.
proposed_change: Change the type of default to any.

subject: api.schema
text: The api.schema 'enum' attribute is typed string but should be typed array.
proposed_change: Change the type of enum to array.

subject: api.schema
text: api.schema lacks validation keyword attributes: minimum/maximum, minLength/maxLength, pattern, additionalProperties, not, and minItems/maxItems.
proposed_change: Add minimum, maximum, minLength, maxLength, pattern, additionalProperties, not, minItems and maxItems attributes.

subject: api.schema
text: The boundary between api.schema and data-model.jsonschema needs a rule because both describe JSON Schema-based data shapes.
proposed_change: Add a boundary or precedence rule distinguishing api.schema from data-model.jsonschema.

subject: api.securityscheme
text: api.securityscheme lacks a 'name' attribute (the header/query/cookie key name), which is required for apiKey schemes and is cited in the type's definition.
proposed_change: Add a 'name' string attribute to api.securityscheme, required when type is apiKey.

subject: api.securityscheme
text: The 'in' attribute of api.securityscheme is an untyped string and should be an enum limited to header, query, and cookie.
proposed_change: Change 'in' to string enum[header|query|cookie].

subject: api.securityscheme
text: There is no element type in the api layer for security requirement objects, which reference security schemes by name from root or operation security.
proposed_change: Add an element type for security requirement objects in the api layer.

subject: api.securityscheme
text: The outgoing relationships from api.securityscheme to data-store.collection (maps-to) and to business.businessrole (serves) are speculative and invite misclassification.
proposed_change: Remove the maps-to data-store.collection and serves business.businessrole relationships from api.securityscheme.

subject: api.server
text: The attribute api.server.variables is typed string although it holds a map of placeholder names to api.servervariable nodes.
proposed_change: Change variables to an object type, or drop the attribute and rely on the aggregates relationship to api.servervariable alone.

subject: api.server
text: The outgoing 'references' relationship from api.server to api.securityscheme has no basis in OpenAPI, since servers do not bind security.
proposed_change: Remove the references relationship from api.server to api.securityscheme.

subject: api.server
text: The relationship 'serves' from api.server to application.applicationcomponent inverts the usual dependency direction and should be reviewed.
proposed_change: Review the relationship and likely reverse its direction or remove it.

subject: api.server
text: Deployment hosts belong to technology.node, while api.server is only the declared URL, so the boundary between the two types needs to be clear.
proposed_change: Clarify that api.server is only the declared URL and that deployment hosts are modeled as technology.node.

subject: api.servervariable
text: Attribute 'enum' of api.servervariable is typed string, but OpenAPI requires a non-empty array of strings.
proposed_change: Change the type of 'enum' to a non-empty array of strings.

subject: api.servervariable
text: api.servervariable has no explicit name attribute even though the map key in Server.variables serves as its identity.
proposed_change: Add an explicit 'name' attribute holding the placeholder name.

subject: api.servervariable
text: The outgoing relationships from api.servervariable 'serves api.operation', 'associated-with api.parameter' and 'references api.example' have no basis in OpenAPI.
proposed_change: Review and remove these three relationships.

subject: api.servervariable
text: The relationship 'governs api.server' from api.servervariable duplicates the inverse 'aggregates' relationship from api.server.
proposed_change: Remove 'governs api.server' and keep the 'aggregates' relationship.

subject: api.tag
text: The api.tag type lacks an explicit required 'name' attribute, which is the tag's identity in OpenAPI 3.0, and needs a uniqueness constraint on it.
proposed_change: Add a required string attribute 'name' to api.tag with a uniqueness constraint among root-level tags.

subject: api.tag
text: The tag→operation 'aggregates' and 'serves' relationships duplicate the operation→tag 'aggregates' and 'references' relationships.
proposed_change: Remove the duplicate tag→operation relationships (or the operation→tag ones) and keep a single direction and predicate.

subject: api.tag
text: The relationships from oauthflow, parameter, schema and paths to tag have no basis in OpenAPI.
proposed_change: Remove the oauthflow→tag, parameter→tag, schema→tag and paths→tag relationships.

subject: api.tag
text: The api.tag type has no explicit externalDocs attribute or relationship to externaldocumentation, although the OpenAPI Tag Object supports externalDocs.
proposed_change: Add an externalDocs attribute or a relationship from api.tag to api.externaldocumentation.

subject: apm.alert
text: The apm.alert type lacks a pending/'for' duration attribute specifying how long the condition must hold before the alert fires.
proposed_change: Add a pending/for duration attribute to apm.alert.

subject: apm.alert
text: The apm.alert type lacks a labels attribute for arbitrary key-value metadata.
proposed_change: Add a labels attribute to apm.alert.

subject: apm.alert
text: The apm.alert type lacks a runbookUrl attribute linking to remediation documentation.
proposed_change: Add a runbookUrl attribute to apm.alert.

subject: apm.alert
text: The apm.alert type lacks a 'tool' attribute naming the hosting monitoring tool, which apm.dashboard has.
proposed_change: Add a tool attribute to apm.alert, consistent with apm.dashboard.

subject: apm.alert
text: OpenTelemetry defines no alerting concept, so apm.alert has no standard anchor.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: apm.alert
text: The apm layer has no SLO element type even though the layer scope mentions SLOs, so burn-rate alerts lack a target to reference.
proposed_change: Add an SLO element type to the apm layer and a relationship from alert to it.

subject: apm.alert
text: The 'dashboard monitors alert' relationship is semantically odd; 'displays' would fit better.
proposed_change: Change the predicate from 'monitors' to 'displays'.

subject: apm.dashboard
text: The apm.dashboard type has no OpenTelemetry equivalent, so its standard_reference is null.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: apm.dashboard
text: The apm.dashboard.panels attribute is an untyped array; it should have a panel schema (title, query, visualization type, signal reference) so 'monitors' relationships can be derived.
proposed_change: Define a structured panel item schema with title, query, visualization type and signal reference fields.

subject: apm.dashboard
text: The apm.dashboard.tool enum lacks values such as kibana, honeycomb, splunk and prometheus console.
proposed_change: Add kibana, honeycomb, splunk and prometheus console to the tool enum.

subject: apm.dashboard
text: The 'monitors' relationship from apm.dashboard to apm.alert is semantically odd; 'displays' fits better.
proposed_change: Replace the 'monitors' predicate with 'displays' for the dashboard to alert relationship.

subject: apm.exporterconfig
text: The apm.exporterconfig definition mentions batching and retry policies, but the type has no batching or retry attributes, and batching belongs to span/log processors.
proposed_change: Drop batching and retry from the definition, or add timeout and retry attributes.

subject: apm.exporterconfig
text: The apm.exporterconfig.protocol attribute is a free string but should be an enum with values grpc, http/protobuf and http/json.
proposed_change: Change protocol to a string enum [grpc|http/protobuf|http/json].

subject: apm.exporterconfig
text: apm.exporterconfig lacks a headers attribute for exporter request headers.
proposed_change: Add a headers attribute.

subject: apm.exporterconfig
text: apm.exporterconfig lacks a signal attribute identifying whether the exporter handles traces, metrics or logs.
proposed_change: Add a signal attribute as an enum [traces|metrics|logs].

subject: apm.exporterconfig
text: The 'logging' value in the apm.exporterconfig.type enum is deprecated in the Collector and has been replaced by 'debug'.
proposed_change: Replace 'logging' with 'debug' in the type enum.

subject: apm.exporterconfig
text: apm.exporterconfig.endpoint is required, but it should not be required for stdout exporters.
proposed_change: Make endpoint optional (conditionally required except for stdout).

subject: apm.instrumentationconfig
text: The attribute 'type' on apm.instrumentationconfig is a required free string that overlaps confusingly with 'instrumentationType'.
proposed_change: Rename 'type' to 'category'.

subject: apm.instrumentationconfig
text: The attribute 'type' on apm.instrumentationconfig is an unconstrained free string and should be limited to a fixed set of values.
proposed_change: Constrain 'type' with an enum.

subject: apm.instrumentationconfig
text: apm.instrumentationconfig lacks a 'libraryVersion' attribute to record the version of the instrumented library.
proposed_change: Add a 'libraryVersion' attribute.

subject: apm.instrumentationconfig
text: apm.instrumentationconfig lacks an 'options' object for settings such as ignored paths or captured headers.
proposed_change: Add an 'options' object attribute.

subject: apm.instrumentationconfig
text: The granularity of apm.instrumentationconfig is ambiguous; instances could be per SDK bootstrap or per library, and it should be fixed at one instance per instrumented library or code path.
proposed_change: Define one instance per instrumented library or code path, not one per SDK bootstrap.

subject: apm.instrumentationscope
text: apm.instrumentationscope has no explicit 'name' attribute although OTel instrumentation scope identity is name+version+schemaUrl.
proposed_change: Add a 'name' attribute to apm.instrumentationscope.

subject: apm.instrumentationscope
text: apm.instrumentationscope.droppedAttributesCount is required, which is a runtime artifact and awkward for design-time models.
proposed_change: Make droppedAttributesCount optional.

subject: apm.instrumentationscope
text: The 'aggregates' relationship from apm.instrumentationscope to apm.exporterconfig is questionable because exporters are configured at provider level, not per scope.
proposed_change: Remove or reconsider the aggregates relationship from instrumentationscope to exporterconfig.

subject: apm.instrumentationscope
text: The description of apm.instrumentationscope.attributes says 'this signal', but an instrumentation scope is not a signal.
proposed_change: Reword the attributes description to refer to the scope rather than 'this signal'.

subject: apm.logconfiguration
text: The required attribute apm.logconfiguration.serviceName conflicts with TraceConfiguration's rule that service identity belongs on Resource, so LogConfiguration should not carry its own service name.
proposed_change: Remove serviceName from apm.logconfiguration and rely on the depends-on link to Resource.

subject: apm.logconfiguration
text: The minimumSeverity enum of apm.logconfiguration collapses OTel's 24-level severityNumber scale into only six SeverityText names, losing granularity.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: apm.logconfiguration
text: apm.logconfiguration has no inline attribute for attached processors or exporters; this information is carried only by the aggregates relationships.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: apm.logconfiguration
text: The 'monitors business service' relationship from apm.logconfiguration is questionable.
proposed_change: Reconsider or remove the monitors relationship to business service.

subject: apm.logprocessor
text: apm.logprocessor lacks the OTel batch processor tuning attributes maxQueueSize, scheduleDelayMillis, maxExportBatchSize and exportTimeoutMillis.
proposed_change: Add maxQueueSize, scheduleDelayMillis, maxExportBatchSize and exportTimeoutMillis attributes to apm.logprocessor.

subject: apm.logprocessor
text: The apm.logprocessor.type enum (simple|batch|custom) does not distinguish Collector processors (filter, attributes, transform) from SDK processors.
proposed_change: Extend the type enum or add an attribute to distinguish Collector processors such as filter, attributes and transform from SDK processors.

subject: apm.logprocessor
text: The flows-to relationship from apm.logprocessor to apm.span is semantically wrong.
proposed_change: Remove or correct the flows-to relationship between apm.logprocessor and apm.span.

subject: apm.logprocessor
text: The relationship from apm.metricinstrument to apm.logprocessor is semantically wrong.
proposed_change: Remove or correct the relationship between apm.metricinstrument and apm.logprocessor.

subject: apm.logprocessor
text: There is no SpanProcessor counterpart element type in the apm layer; span processors are buried inside apm.traceconfiguration.
proposed_change: Add a dedicated apm.spanprocessor element type as the counterpart of apm.logprocessor.

subject: apm.logrecord
text: The apm.logrecord type lacks traceId and spanId attributes, so its claimed trace context correlation cannot be expressed.
proposed_change: Add traceId and spanId attributes to apm.logrecord.

subject: apm.logrecord
text: The apm.logrecord type lacks an eventName attribute.
proposed_change: Add an eventName attribute to apm.logrecord.

subject: apm.logrecord
text: The apm.logrecord.severityNumber attribute is typed as string but should be an integer constrained to the range 0-24.
proposed_change: Change severityNumber to integer with a 0-24 range constraint.

subject: apm.logrecord
text: The required instance-level fields of apm.logrecord (timestamps, flags) conflict with modelling design-time log event types.
proposed_change: Make the instance-level fields optional, or split the type into a log event definition type and a log record instance type.

subject: apm.metricconfiguration
text: The required attribute apm.metricconfiguration.serviceName duplicates the Resource service.name and is inconsistent with TraceConfiguration, which moved service identity to Resource.
proposed_change: Remove serviceName from MetricConfiguration and rely on the Resource's service.name for service identity.

subject: apm.metricconfiguration
text: The definition of apm.metricconfiguration refers to 'MeterConfig', which does not exist in the apm layer.
proposed_change: Reword the definition to drop the reference to the nonexistent 'MeterConfig'.

subject: apm.metricconfiguration
text: The attributes exportIntervalMillis and exportTimeoutMillis on apm.metricconfiguration are properties of the metric reader, not of the MeterProvider.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: apm.metricconfiguration
text: apm.metricconfiguration has no attributes for views, aggregation temporality, or reader type.
proposed_change: Add attributes for views, aggregation temporality, and reader type.

subject: apm.metricconfiguration
text: The 'serves' relationship from apm.metricconfiguration to apm.resource appears to point in the wrong direction.
proposed_change: Invert the relationship direction or replace it with a predicate that fits, such as having the configuration reference or use the resource.

subject: apm.metricinstrument
text: apm.metricinstrument has no explicit name attribute, although OTel instrument names have syntax rules.
proposed_change: Add a name attribute to apm.metricinstrument that follows the OTel instrument name syntax.

subject: apm.metricinstrument
text: apm.metricinstrument has no attribute for recorded attribute keys (dimensions).
proposed_change: Add an attribute listing the attribute keys (dimensions) recorded by the instrument.

subject: apm.metricinstrument
text: apm.metricinstrument has no attribute for histogram bucket boundaries (advisory parameters).
proposed_change: Add an attribute for histogram explicit bucket boundaries (advisory parameters).

subject: apm.metricinstrument
text: The type enum of apm.metricinstrument has no value for Prometheus Summary.
proposed_change: Add a Summary value to the type enum.

subject: apm.metricinstrument
text: The relationship from apm.metricinstrument flows-to apm.logprocessor is semantically wrong for the OTel model.
proposed_change: Remove or rework the flows-to relationship from metricinstrument to logprocessor.

subject: apm.metricinstrument
text: The relationship from apm.metricinstrument flows-to apm.span is semantically wrong for the OTel model.
proposed_change: Remove or rework the flows-to relationship from metricinstrument to span.

subject: apm.metricinstrument
text: The relationship span composes metricinstrument is semantically wrong for the OTel model, since spans do not contain metric instruments.
proposed_change: Remove or rework the composes relationship from span to metricinstrument.

subject: apm.resource
text: The serviceName attribute is duplicated on apm.logconfiguration and apm.metricconfiguration, contradicting traceconfiguration's statement that service identity belongs on Resource.
proposed_change: Remove serviceName from apm.logconfiguration and apm.metricconfiguration, keeping it only on apm.resource.

subject: apm.resource
text: The attribute apm.resource.droppedAttributesCount is required but is rarely observable from code, so it should be optional with a default of 0.
proposed_change: Make droppedAttributesCount optional with a default value of 0.

subject: apm.resource
text: The relationships where apm.resource aggregates exporterconfig, metricinstrument and span misstate the model, because exporters attach to providers and signals reference resources rather than being owned by them.
proposed_change: Remove the aggregates relationships from resource to exporterconfig, metricinstrument and span, and model signals as referencing the resource and exporters as attached to providers.

subject: apm.span
text: The runtime-instance attributes of apm.span (traceId, spanId, parentSpanId, traceState, startTimeUnixNano, endTimeUnixNano, droppedAttributesCount, droppedEventsCount, droppedLinksCount) are required, but design-time span definitions extracted from code cannot supply them, so they should be optional.
proposed_change: Make the runtime-instance attributes optional (not required) on apm.span.

subject: apm.span
text: apm.span.parentSpanId is required, but root spans have no parent, so it cannot be required.
proposed_change: Make parentSpanId optional.

subject: apm.span
text: apm.span.droppedEventsCount and apm.span.droppedLinksCount are typed as string but should be integers, consistent with droppedAttributesCount.
proposed_change: Change the type of droppedEventsCount and droppedLinksCount from string to integer.

subject: apm.span
text: The 'composes' relationships between apm.span and apm.traceconfiguration and between apm.span and apm.metricinstrument appear to point in the wrong direction.
proposed_change: Invert the direction of the composes relationships for traceconfiguration and metricinstrument.

subject: apm.spanevent
text: apm.spanevent lacks a 'name' attribute, even though OTLP requires an event name and the definition relies on name='exception'.
proposed_change: Add 'name' as a required string attribute to apm.spanevent.

subject: apm.spanevent
text: The relationship 'apm.spanevent triggers apm.metricinstrument' is dubious because span events do not drive metric instruments.
proposed_change: Remove or reconsider the triggers relationship from apm.spanevent to apm.metricinstrument.

subject: apm.spanevent
text: The relationship 'apm.spanevent monitors ux.actioncomponent' is dubious because span events do not directly monitor UI components.
proposed_change: Remove or reconsider the monitors relationship from apm.spanevent to ux.actioncomponent.

subject: apm.spanevent
text: The OTel Events API now emits LogRecords, which blurs the boundary between apm.spanevent and apm.logrecord.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: apm.spanlink
text: apm.spanlink lacks the OTLP Link 'flags' attribute (sampled/isRemote).
proposed_change: Add a flags attribute to apm.spanlink covering sampled and isRemote.

subject: apm.spanlink
text: The traceId and spanId attributes of apm.spanlink duplicate the references relationship to apm.span, and the spec does not state which is authoritative.
proposed_change: State explicitly whether the traceId/spanId attributes or the references relationship to apm.span is authoritative.

subject: apm.spanlink
text: The apm.spanlink definition says the link targets a span in a different trace, but links may target spans in the same trace.
proposed_change: Reword the definition so links may target spans in the same or a different trace.

subject: apm.spanlink
text: On apm.span, droppedLinksCount and droppedEventsCount are typed string while droppedAttributesCount is integer, which is inconsistent.
proposed_change: Change droppedLinksCount and droppedEventsCount to integer, matching droppedAttributesCount.

subject: apm.traceconfiguration
text: The definition of apm.traceconfiguration mentions a span processor pipeline, but the type has no attribute for processor type, batch size, schedule delay, or span limits.
proposed_change: Add attributes for span processor type (simple|batch), batch size, schedule delay, and span limits.

subject: apm.traceconfiguration
text: The propagators attribute of apm.traceconfiguration is an untyped array and should be an enum of propagation formats.
proposed_change: Make propagators an array of enum values: tracecontext, baggage, b3, b3multi, jaeger, xray.

subject: apm.traceconfiguration
text: The relationships apm.traceconfiguration aggregates span, aggregates metricinstrument, and span composes traceconfiguration confuse configuration with emitted instances.
proposed_change: Review these three relationships and remove or redefine them so configuration is not tied to emitted instances.

subject: application.applicationcollaboration
text: application.applicationcollaboration rarely maps to a single code symbol, so a classifier will seldom match it from a state card.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: application.applicationcollaboration
text: ArchiMate assigns a collaboration to an interaction, but the spec models the link as depends-on/delivers-value, so an 'assigned-to' relationship from application.applicationcollaboration to application.applicationinteraction is missing.
proposed_change: Add an 'assigned-to' relationship from applicationcollaboration to applicationinteraction.

subject: application.applicationcollaboration
text: The parallel aggregates and depends-on relationships between application.applicationcollaboration and application.applicationcomponent are redundant.
proposed_change: Remove one of the redundant relationships, keeping a single one between collaboration and component.

subject: application.applicationcollaboration
text: application.applicationcollaboration lacks a 'members' attribute or a minimum-cardinality constraint to express that it groups two or more components.
proposed_change: Add a 'members' attribute or a minimum-cardinality constraint of two on member components.

subject: application.applicationcomponent
text: The attribute 'type' on application.applicationcomponent has a name that collides with the element-type concept.
proposed_change: Rename the 'type' attribute to a non-colliding name such as 'kind' (and 'sourcing' for the ownership axis).

subject: application.applicationcomponent
text: The 'type' enum on application.applicationcomponent mixes two axes, ownership (internal/external) and style (service-component), and includes 'generic' as a catch-all.
proposed_change: Split 'type' into two attributes, 'sourcing' (internal/external) and 'kind' (e.g. service-component, generic).

subject: application.applicationcomponent
text: The granularity of application.applicationcomponent is unclear: it is not stated whether plain classes qualify as components or only deployable units.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: application.applicationcomponent
text: The self-referential 'uses' relationship on application.applicationcomponent is listed twice.
proposed_change: Remove the duplicate 'uses' self-relationship so it is listed once.

subject: application.applicationevent
text: Event payload classes blur with application.dataobject; the specification of application.applicationevent should state that the published type is the event, with an optional dataobject for a reusable payload.
proposed_change: Add a boundary rule stating the published type is the applicationevent, with an optional dataobject modelling a reusable payload.

subject: application.applicationevent
text: The eventType enum of application.applicationevent has no value for user or UI-originated events.
proposed_change: Add an enum value such as 'user' (or 'ui') to eventType.

subject: application.applicationevent
text: application.applicationevent lacks an attribute for the topic or channel name on which the event is published.
proposed_change: Add a topic/channel name attribute to applicationevent.

subject: application.applicationevent
text: application.applicationevent lacks an attribute referencing the event's payload.
proposed_change: Add a payload reference attribute pointing to a dataobject.

subject: application.applicationevent
text: The relationship data-store.eventhandler triggers application.applicationevent appears to have an inverted direction.
proposed_change: Reverse the direction so the applicationevent triggers the eventhandler, or otherwise correct the predicate.

subject: application.applicationfunction
text: The definition of application.applicationfunction ('for internal purposes' / invoked from inside rather than offered to external consumers) conflicts with its realizes relationship to ApplicationService; it should state that the function is the internal behavior realizing the service, not the exposed contract.
proposed_change: Clarify the definition so the function is the internal behavior that realizes the ApplicationService, not the exposed contract.

subject: application.applicationfunction
text: application.applicationfunction lacks a granularity rule, so every private method would qualify as an ApplicationFunction.
proposed_change: Add a granularity rule specifying which behaviors qualify as an ApplicationFunction.

subject: application.applicationfunction
text: The relationship api.operation realizes application.applicationfunction appears inverted; operations normally realize or serve services rather than functions.
proposed_change: Reverse or replace the relationship so operations realize or serve application services (or the function realizes the operation) instead of the operation realizing the function.

subject: application.applicationinteraction
text: application.applicationinteraction lacks the 'properties' attribute that every sibling type in the application layer has.
proposed_change: Add a 'properties' attribute to application.applicationinteraction consistent with siblings.

subject: application.applicationinteraction
text: The 'pattern' enum of application.applicationinteraction has overlapping values 'event-driven' and 'publish-subscribe' that are hard to tell apart.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: application.applicationinteraction
text: The 'pattern' enum of application.applicationinteraction lacks saga and orchestration style values.
proposed_change: Add saga and orchestration values to the pattern enum.

subject: application.applicationinteraction
text: A single code symbol usually implements only one side of an application interaction, so classifiers will rarely match application.applicationinteraction directly.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: application.applicationinteraction
text: The relationships realizes and delivers-value from applicationinteraction both point to applicationservice and are redundant.
proposed_change: Remove one of the two redundant relationships, keeping a single one to applicationservice.

subject: application.applicationinteraction
text: The relationship where applicationcollaboration depends-on applicationinteraction appears inverted in direction.
proposed_change: Reverse the direction of the depends-on relationship or replace it with a more suitable predicate.

subject: application.applicationinterface
text: The protocol enum of application.applicationinterface mixes true protocols with architectural styles (REST, GraphQL).
proposed_change: Separate protocols from architectural styles, e.g. remove or relocate REST and GraphQL so the enum holds a single axis.

subject: application.applicationinterface
text: The protocol enum of application.applicationinterface has HTTP and HTTPS as separate values, splitting on TLS, which contradicts the attribute's own guidance that transport-level concerns like TLS belong in the Technology Layer.
proposed_change: Merge HTTP and HTTPS into a single HTTP value.

subject: application.applicationinterface
text: The protocol enum of application.applicationinterface lacks values for CLI, Kafka, MQTT and in-process/library APIs.
proposed_change: Add CLI, Kafka, MQTT and in-process/library API values to the protocol enum.

subject: application.applicationinterface
text: application.applicationinterface has both depends-on and serves relationships to application.applicationservice, which express the same meaning and are redundant.
proposed_change: Remove one of the two relationships, keeping the one with the correct semantics.

subject: application.applicationinterface
text: The boundary between application.applicationinterface and the api layer needs to be stated: contract files belong in the api layer, runtime bindings belong in the application interface.
proposed_change: Add a distinction to the definition stating that contract files go in the api layer and runtime bindings go in ApplicationInterface.

subject: application.applicationprocess
text: application.applicationprocess has no attributes for trigger, steps or outcome, so the ordered nature that defines the type cannot be captured structurally.
proposed_change: Add structural attributes for trigger, steps and outcome to application.applicationprocess.

subject: application.applicationprocess
text: application.applicationprocess should have a 'steps' list attribute to capture its ordered steps.
proposed_change: Add a 'steps' list attribute to application.applicationprocess.

subject: application.applicationprocess
text: application.applicationprocess lacks an optional 'executionMode' attribute (sync/async/batch/long-running).
proposed_change: Add an optional 'executionMode' enum attribute with values sync, async, batch, long-running.

subject: application.applicationprocess
text: Both application processes and application functions use a delivers-value relationship toward a service, making these relationships overlap or redundant between the two source types.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: application.applicationprocess
text: Relationship names in the application layer are non-ArchiMate, for example depends-on rather than ArchiMate access or assignment.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: application.applicationservice
text: A @Service class in code is often both an application component and an application service, so classifiers need a rule to distinguish them: model the exposed contract as applicationservice and the deployable unit as applicationcomponent.
proposed_change: Add a classifier rule that models the exposed contract as applicationservice and the deployable unit as applicationcomponent.

subject: application.applicationservice
text: The enum values of application.applicationservice.serviceType overlap because it mixes timing (synchronous/asynchronous) with style (event-driven/batch) on one axis.
proposed_change: Separate timing and style into distinct axes or attributes, or redefine the enum values so they do not overlap.

subject: application.applicationservice
text: The relationship 'applicationinterface depends-on applicationservice' duplicates the 'serves' relationship between the same types and should be reviewed.
proposed_change: Review the depends-on relationship and likely remove it in favor of serves.

subject: application.dataobject
text: application.dataobject has no attribute capturing the structure (fields) of the data object.
proposed_change: Add an attribute describing the fields/structure of the data object.

subject: application.dataobject
text: application.dataobject has no attribute capturing the mutability of the data object.
proposed_change: Add a mutability attribute (e.g. mutable/immutable).

subject: application.dataobject
text: application.dataobject has no attribute capturing its kind (DTO, value object, command, etc.).
proposed_change: Add a kind attribute with an enum such as dto, value_object, command.

subject: application.dataobject
text: The boundary between application.dataobject and data-model.objectschema, persistence entities and API schemas lacks an explicit precedence rule.
proposed_change: Add a precedence rule: ORM-mapped → persistence; published schema → api/data-model; otherwise application.dataobject.

subject: application.dataobject
text: Event payload classes straddle application.dataobject and application.applicationevent, leaving the boundary unclear.
proposed_change: Clarify how event payload classes are classified relative to applicationevent.

subject: application.dataobject
text: The self-referencing 'realizes' relationship on application.dataobject has unclear semantics.
proposed_change: Clarify the semantics of the self-referencing realizes relationship or remove it.

subject: business.businessactor
text: The relationship businessrole --serves--> businessactor departs from ArchiMate, where a role is reached from an actor only by assignment.
proposed_change: Remove the serves relationship from businessrole to businessactor and rely on assignment from actor to role.

subject: business.businessactor
text: The relationship businessactor --serves--> motivation.stakeholder should probably be an association rather than serves.
proposed_change: Replace the serves relationship from businessactor to motivation.stakeholder with an association relationship.

subject: business.businessactor
text: The businessfunction definition says functions are 'performed by an actor', but ArchiMate assigns both processes and functions to actors or roles.
proposed_change: Reword the businessfunction definition to say functions are performed by an actor or role.

subject: business.businessactor
text: businessactor lacks an attribute distinguishing internal actors from external ones.
proposed_change: Add an internal/external attribute to businessactor.

subject: business.businesscollaboration
text: The 'composes' relationship from business.businesscollaboration to BusinessRole conflicts with ArchiMate, which uses aggregation because roles exist independently of the collaboration.
proposed_change: Replace the 'composes' relationship to BusinessRole with an aggregation relationship.

subject: business.businessevent
text: The relationship businessrole --triggers--> businessevent is invalid in ArchiMate because triggers links only behavior elements, so a role cannot trigger an event.
proposed_change: Replace the triggers relationship with assignment, or remove it.

subject: business.businessevent
text: The enum on business.businessevent.type mixes origin values (internal/external) with mechanism values (message/timer), so it cannot express an external message event.
proposed_change: Separate origin and mechanism into distinct axes or attributes so combinations like external message can be expressed.

subject: business.businessevent
text: The attribute name 'type' on business.businessevent collides with the element type concept.
proposed_change: Rename the attribute to something more specific, such as trigger classification.

subject: business.businessevent
text: The business.businessevent definition should mention BusinessInteraction as something it can trigger or result from, to match the relationships.
proposed_change: Add BusinessInteraction to the definition alongside BusinessProcess and BusinessFunction.

subject: business.businessfunction
text: BusinessInteraction's definition says functions are 'performed by an actor' while the business layer's relationships assign behavior to roles, so the wording of business.businessfunction and BusinessInteraction should be aligned.
proposed_change: Align the wording so that functions are described as performed by a role (or actor) consistently across BusinessInteraction and BusinessFunction definitions.

subject: business.businessfunction
text: The business.businessfunction relationship 'realizes motivation.goal' contradicts the definition that a function is 'not goal-oriented'; ArchiMate core elements realize requirements and influence goals.
proposed_change: Replace the 'realizes motivation.goal' relationship with realizes motivation.requirement and/or influences motivation.goal.

subject: business.businessfunction
text: The 'serves businessrole' relationship from business.businessfunction is unusual for a function.
proposed_change: Review and likely remove or reconsider the 'serves businessrole' relationship from businessfunction.

subject: business.businessfunction
text: The boundary between business.businessfunction and product.capability (capability vs function) lacks explicit guidance.
proposed_change: Add explicit guidance distinguishing capability from function, including a precedence or boundary rule.

subject: business.businessinteraction
text: The definition of business.businessinteraction wrongly states that BusinessProcess is performed by a role and BusinessFunction by an actor, whereas ArchiMate allows either to be assigned to actors or roles.
proposed_change: Reword the definition to drop the role-only/actor-only contrast between BusinessProcess and BusinessFunction.

subject: business.businessinteraction
text: The 'serves' relationship from business.businessinteraction to business.businessservice is non-standard because in ArchiMate behavior elements realize services.
proposed_change: Remove or replace the serves relationship to businessservice with a realizes relationship.

subject: business.businessinteraction
text: A 'realizes' relationship from business.businessinteraction to business.businessservice is missing from the catalog.
proposed_change: Add a realizes relationship from businessinteraction to businessservice.

subject: business.businessinteraction
text: business.businessinteraction cannot express its participating roles or the minimum of two participants; a 'participants' attribute or an explicit minimum-two-roles constraint should be considered.
proposed_change: Add a 'participants' attribute or a constraint requiring at least two roles.

subject: business.businessinterface
text: Outgoing accesses/flows-to relationships from business.businessinterface to BusinessObject are not direct ArchiMate relationships for an active structure element.
proposed_change: Remove or re-model the direct accesses/flows-to relationships from BusinessInterface to BusinessObject.

subject: business.businessinterface
text: Outgoing triggers relationships from business.businessinterface to BusinessProcess/BusinessFunction are not direct ArchiMate relationships for an active structure element.
proposed_change: Remove or re-model the triggers relationships from BusinessInterface to BusinessProcess/BusinessFunction.

subject: business.businessinterface
text: The relationship between business.businessinterface and BusinessService uses 'provides' but ArchiMate defines it as 'assigned-to'.
proposed_change: Use 'assigned-to' instead of 'provides' for the interface–service relationship.

subject: business.businessinterface
text: Links from api.operation to business.businessinterface risk conflating BusinessInterface with ApplicationInterface.
proposed_change: Avoid or constrain api.operation links to BusinessInterface and clarify the boundary with ApplicationInterface.

subject: business.businessinterface
text: business.businessinterface lacks an attribute capturing its channel type.
proposed_change: Add a 'channelType' enum attribute with values in-person, phone, web, mail, partner.

subject: business.businessobject
text: In ArchiMate, Contract is a specialization of BusinessObject, but in this spec business.contract and business.businessobject are modelled as siblings with no specialization relationship.
proposed_change: Model contract as a specialization of businessobject or add an explicit specialization relationship between them.

subject: business.businessobject
text: The relationship 'contract accesses businessobject' is invalid because it connects a passive structure element to another passive element via accesses; it should be aggregation or specialization.
proposed_change: Replace the accesses relationship with aggregation or specialization.

subject: business.businessobject
text: The 'composes' relationship is listed twice for business.businessobject, making it redundant.
proposed_change: Remove the duplicate composes relationship entry.

subject: business.businessobject
text: The 'messages' example for business.businessobject overlaps with businessevent of type message.
proposed_change: Drop or clarify the 'messages' example, or add a boundary rule against businessevent type=message.

subject: business.businessobject
text: The 'contracts' example in the businessobject definition should be removed because contract is a separate sibling type.
proposed_change: Remove 'contracts' from the examples in the businessobject definition.

subject: business.businessprocess
text: The incoming relationship 'businessservice realizes businessprocess' is inverted relative to the outgoing 'businessprocess realizes businessservice', so only the outgoing one should be kept.
proposed_change: Remove 'businessservice realizes businessprocess' and keep 'businessprocess realizes businessservice'.

subject: business.businessprocess
text: The relationship 'businessprocess aggregates application.applicationprocess' breaks layer independence and should probably be expressed as applicationprocess realizes or serves businessprocess.
proposed_change: Replace the aggregates relationship with 'applicationprocess realizes' or 'applicationprocess serves' businessprocess.

subject: business.businessprocess
text: The businessrole relationships 'assigned-to' and 'performs' toward businessprocess are duplicates expressing the same meaning.
proposed_change: Keep one of the two relationships and remove the other.

subject: business.businessprocess
text: The definition of the sibling type BusinessInteraction wrongly implies that functions are performed only by actors and processes only by roles.
proposed_change: Reword the BusinessInteraction definition so it does not restrict functions to actors and processes to roles.

subject: business.businessrole
text: The relationships 'performs' and 'assigned-to' from business.businessrole to business process/function are redundant, since ArchiMate uses assignment only.
proposed_change: Remove the 'performs' relationship and keep only 'assigned-to' from role to process/function.

subject: business.businessrole
text: The relationship 'role serves actor' from business.businessrole to business.businessactor has no basis in ArchiMate.
proposed_change: Remove the 'serves' relationship from businessrole to businessactor.

subject: business.businessrole
text: The business.businessinteraction definition wrongly implies that processes are performed by roles and functions by actors.
proposed_change: Reword the BusinessInteraction definition to remove the implied role-to-process and actor-to-function performer mapping.

subject: business.businessrole
text: The inbound maps-to relationship from security.role to business.businessrole invites conflating access-control roles with business roles.
proposed_change: Clarify the boundary between security.role and business.businessrole, or restrict or remove the maps-to relationship.

subject: business.businessservice
text: The outgoing relationship 'business.businessservice realizes business.businessprocess' inverts ArchiMate, where the process realizes the service.
proposed_change: Remove or reverse the edge so businessprocess realizes businessservice.

subject: business.businessservice
text: The outgoing 'businessservice realizes businessprocess' relationship duplicates the existing incoming edge between the same pair.
proposed_change: Remove the outgoing realizes edge and keep the incoming businessprocess realizes businessservice edge.

subject: business.businessservice
text: The 'business.businessservice delivers business.businessobject' relationship is non-standard; ArchiMate would use access.
proposed_change: Replace 'delivers' with an 'accesses' relationship to businessobject.

subject: business.businessservice
text: The relationships 'data-store.database realizes businessservice' and 'technology.systemsoftware realizes businessservice' skip the application layer.
proposed_change: Remove these direct edges or route realization through the application layer.

subject: business.businessservice
text: business.businessservice lacks optional serviceLevel and consumer attributes.
proposed_change: Add optional serviceLevel and consumer attributes to businessservice.

subject: business.contract
text: The outgoing serves, triggers, and accesses relationships from business.contract are invalid because ArchiMate treats Contract as passive structure, which is accessed and does not act.
proposed_change: Remove the outgoing serves, triggers, and accesses relationships from business.contract.

subject: business.contract
text: business.contract should be modelled as a specialization of business.businessobject, as in ArchiMate, instead of a separate unrelated type.
proposed_change: Model Contract as a specialization of BusinessObject.

subject: business.contract
text: business.contract lacks structured attributes such as parties, effectiveDate, expiryDate, and version that would help classification.
proposed_change: Add parties, effectiveDate, expiryDate, and version attributes to business.contract.

subject: business.product
text: The definition of business.product calls Product a passive structure element, but in ArchiMate 3.2 it is a composite element.
proposed_change: Redefine business.product as a composite element that bundles services and a contract offered as a whole.

subject: business.product
text: business.product relationships cover only business services and contracts, but ArchiMate also allows products to aggregate application services, technology services, business objects and data objects.
proposed_change: Add aggregation relationships from business.product to application services, technology services, business objects and data objects.

subject: business.product
text: business.product has no attributes for target market, pricing model or lifecycle status.
proposed_change: Add attributes for target market, pricing model and lifecycle status.

subject: business.product
text: Classifiers will confuse e-commerce 'Product' entity classes with the business.product type.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: business.representation
text: The business.representation format enum mixes media types (pdf, html, json) with serialization formats (xml, binary, plain-text) and so mixes values from different axes.
proposed_change: Align the format values with MIME types, or separate media type from serialization format.

subject: business.representation
text: The business.representation format enum lacks values for paper/print, spreadsheet (xlsx/csv), image, and email, and has no 'other' value.
proposed_change: Add values such as 'paper', spreadsheet, image, email, and 'other' to the format enum.

subject: business.representation
text: On-screen forms fit poorly under the 'html' value of business.representation format.
proposed_change: Add a distinct value for on-screen forms or clarify how they map to existing values.

subject: business.representation
text: Without guidance, application-layer DataObject serializations such as JSON API payloads risk being modelled as business.representation, so the boundary with application-layer DataObject is unclear.
proposed_change: Add guidance or a boundary rule distinguishing business Representation from application-layer DataObject serializations.

subject: data-model.arrayschema
text: The attribute 'type' on data-model.arrayschema is typed 'any' and optional, but it should be a required string fixed to 'array'.
proposed_change: Change 'type' to a required string constrained to the constant value 'array'.

subject: data-model.arrayschema
text: The attribute 'items' on data-model.arrayschema is typed as a string, so it cannot express Draft 7's tuple form where items is an array of schemas.
proposed_change: Change 'items' so it can hold either a single schema or an array of schemas (tuple form).

subject: data-model.arrayschema
text: data-model.arrayschema lacks the Draft 7 'additionalItems' attribute.
proposed_change: Add an 'additionalItems' attribute to data-model.arrayschema.

subject: data-model.arrayschema
text: The aggregates relationships of data-model.arrayschema omit arrayschema to arrayschema, which is needed for nested arrays.
proposed_change: Add an aggregates relationship from data-model.arrayschema to data-model.arrayschema.

subject: data-model.arrayschema
text: The aggregates relationships of data-model.arrayschema omit boolean element types, such as boolean schemas as items.
proposed_change: Add aggregates relationships from data-model.arrayschema to boolean element types.

subject: data-model.jsonschema
text: The attribute 'type' on data-model.jsonschema is marked required, but Draft 7 root documents may omit type (e.g. documents of pure definitions or compositions), so it should be optional.
proposed_change: Make the 'type' attribute of data-model.jsonschema optional.

subject: data-model.jsonschema
text: The data-model.jsonschema type lacks a description attribute, unlike its sibling types.
proposed_change: Add a description attribute to data-model.jsonschema.

subject: data-model.jsonschema
text: The relationships from data-model.jsonschema to motivation.goal and business.businessservice look overreaching for a schema document.
proposed_change: Remove or reconsider the relationships from data-model.jsonschema to motivation.goal and business.businessservice.

subject: data-model.jsonschema
text: data-model.jsonschema overlaps with api.schema via the realizes relationship, and the boundary between them should be clarified.
proposed_change: Clarify the boundary and the realizes relationship between data-model.jsonschema and api.schema.

subject: data-model.numericschema
text: The 'type' attribute of data-model.numericschema is a required enum (number|integer), unlike the sibling StringSchema and ArraySchema where type is not required or uses 'any', so required-ness is inconsistent across siblings.
proposed_change: Align the 'type' attribute across NumericSchema and its siblings (make it consistently required or optional/using 'any').

subject: data-model.numericschema
text: data-model.numericschema has no 'format' attribute to carry int32/int64/float/double hints, which OpenAPI-derived code commonly includes.
proposed_change: Add a 'format' string attribute to NumericSchema for int32/int64/float/double hints.

subject: data-model.numericschema
text: data-model.numericschema overlaps with data-model.schemaproperty, whose type enum includes number/integer, and it is unspecified whether inline field bounds create a separate NumericSchema element or stay on the property.
proposed_change: Specify a boundary rule stating whether inline numeric bounds create a separate NumericSchema element or remain on the SchemaProperty.

subject: data-model.objectschema
text: The attribute data-model.objectschema.type is a free string but should be a constant 'object'.
proposed_change: Constrain type to the const value 'object'.

subject: data-model.objectschema
text: The attributes additionalProperties, patternProperties and propertyNames on data-model.objectschema are typed as string, but Draft 7 allows boolean or schema values (additionalProperties, propertyNames) and regex-to-schema maps (patternProperties).
proposed_change: Retype additionalProperties and propertyNames as boolean or schema, and patternProperties as a map of regex to schema.

subject: data-model.objectschema
text: The properties attribute on data-model.objectschema duplicates the aggregates relationship to data-model.schemaproperty, so only one representation should exist.
proposed_change: Keep either the properties attribute or the aggregates relationship to schemaproperty and remove the other.

subject: data-model.objectschema
text: data-model.objectschema lacks the Draft 7 'dependencies' keyword attribute.
proposed_change: Add a dependencies attribute to objectschema.

subject: data-model.objectschema
text: The realizes relationship from data-model.objectschema to motivation.goal appears semantically wrong.
proposed_change: Remove or rework the realizes relationship to motivation.goal.

subject: data-model.reference
text: The maps-to relationship from data-model.reference to application.applicationservice looks wrong because a schema pointer does not realise a service.
proposed_change: Remove or replace the maps-to relationship to application.applicationservice.

subject: data-model.reference
