text: data-model.reference overlaps with SchemaProperty, which also carries a $ref attribute, so the boundary between the two types is fuzzy.
proposed_change: Define a boundary or precedence rule between reference and schemaproperty regarding $ref usage.

subject: data-model.reference
text: data-model.reference has no attribute distinguishing internal fragment references from external URI references.
proposed_change: Add an attribute (e.g. a reference kind enum of internal/external) to distinguish internal fragment from external URI references.

subject: data-model.reference
text: The 'references' relationship from data-model.reference is limited to schemadefinition targets, but a $ref may also point at a jsonschema root or another external schema.
proposed_change: Add references relationships from reference to jsonschema and other external schema targets.

subject: data-model.schemacomposition
text: data-model.schemacomposition has no discriminator attribute for oneOf variants (OpenAPI discriminator, Pydantic discriminator), so tagged unions lose their tag.
proposed_change: Add a discriminator attribute (e.g. property name and mapping) to data-model.schemacomposition.

subject: data-model.schemacomposition
text: The 'not' attribute of data-model.schemacomposition is typed string but holds a subschema; the outgoing composes relationships carry the real link.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: data-model.schemacomposition
text: data-model.schemacomposition has no composes relationship to data-model.reference, although subschemas are usually $refs.
proposed_change: Add a composes relationship from data-model.schemacomposition to data-model.reference.

subject: data-model.schemacomposition
text: Draft 7 if/then/else conditional keywords have no home type in the data-model layer.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: data-model.schemadefinition
text: Object-typed data-model.schemadefinition instances have no properties or required attributes, so they must defer structure to objectschema, but the spec does not say whether that link is composes or aggregates.
proposed_change: Define an explicit relationship from schemadefinition to objectschema and state whether it is composes or aggregates.

subject: data-model.schemadefinition
text: data-model.schemadefinition has no attribute holding the definitions key (the name used as the $ref target #/definitions/{name}); title is only an annotation.
proposed_change: Add a name/key attribute holding the definitions key used as the $ref target.

subject: data-model.schemadefinition
text: The enum attribute of data-model.schemadefinition is typed as an array while the enum attribute on schemaproperty is a string, an inconsistency.
proposed_change: Align the enum attribute type across schemadefinition and schemaproperty (array is the JSON Schema-correct type).

subject: data-model.schemadefinition
text: data-model.schemadefinition does not mention the Draft 2019+ '$defs' keyword, only 'definitions'.
proposed_change: Mention '$defs' in the definition as the Draft 2019+ equivalent of 'definitions'.

subject: data-model.schemaproperty
text: The attributes enum, examples, default and const on data-model.schemaproperty are typed string although they hold arrays (enum, examples) or arbitrary JSON values (default, const).
proposed_change: Retype enum and examples as array, and default and const as arbitrary JSON values (any type).

subject: data-model.schemaproperty
text: The enum attribute on data-model.schemaproperty is typed string while sibling types type enum as array, making the typing inconsistent.
proposed_change: Type schemaproperty.enum as array to match siblings.

subject: data-model.schemaproperty
text: data-model.schemaproperty has no per-property required or nullable flag, because required is held on objectschema.
proposed_change: Add a required and/or nullable attribute to schemaproperty, or document that required lives on objectschema.

subject: data-model.schemaproperty
text: The format attribute on data-model.schemaproperty lacks the enum of allowed values that stringschema.format has.
proposed_change: Add the same enum of format values to schemaproperty.format as stringschema.format has.

subject: data-model.schemaproperty
text: data-model.schemaproperty has no attribute for the property name; the name is only implicit in the element name.
proposed_change: Add an explicit name attribute to schemaproperty.

subject: data-model.stringschema
text: The format enum on data-model.stringschema mixes in values from post-Draft-7 JSON Schema (duration and uuid from 2019-09), although the attribute is documented as Draft 7.
proposed_change: Remove duration and uuid from the format enum to align with Draft 7.

subject: data-model.stringschema
text: The format enum on data-model.stringschema lacks the Draft 7 value uri-template.
proposed_change: Add uri-template to the format enum.

subject: data-model.stringschema
text: The type attribute on data-model.stringschema is typed 'any' instead of being fixed to the string type.
proposed_change: Change type from 'any' to const 'string'.

subject: data-model.stringschema
text: The format attribute is duplicated on stringschema, schemaproperty and schemadefinition, which blurs which type owns it.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: data-model.stringschema
text: String enum and const constraints have no home on data-model.stringschema, so they are modelled on schemaproperty instead.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: data-store.accesspattern
text: The attribute data-store.accesspattern.targetCollection duplicates the accesses relationship from accesspattern to collection, so the same information is stored twice.
proposed_change: Keep either the targetCollection attribute or the accesses relationship to collection and remove the other.

subject: data-store.accesspattern
text: The accesses and aggregates relationships from data-store.accesspattern to collection overlap in meaning, so one should be chosen.
proposed_change: Pick one of accesses or aggregates and remove or clearly differentiate the other.

subject: data-store.accesspattern
text: A single-valued targetCollection on data-store.accesspattern cannot express join or multi-collection transaction access patterns.
proposed_change: Allow multiple target collections, for example by using the relationship to collection with multiplicity instead of a single string.

subject: data-store.accesspattern
text: The patternType enum of data-store.accesspattern lacks a DELETE value for deletion access patterns.
proposed_change: Add DELETE to the patternType enum.

subject: data-store.accesspattern
text: data-store.accesspattern lacks a projection attribute describing which fields are returned.
proposed_change: Add a projection attribute listing returned fields.

subject: data-store.accesspattern
text: data-store.accesspattern lacks a pagination or limit attribute.
proposed_change: Add a pagination/limit attribute.

subject: data-store.accesspattern
text: data-store.accesspattern lacks a latency target attribute.
proposed_change: Add a latency target attribute.

subject: data-store.collection
text: The Elasticsearch index is assigned to both data-store.namespace and data-store.collection (collectionType SEARCH_INDEX), creating overlap between the two types.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: data-store.collection
text: The collectionType enum value NODE_LABEL collides in name with the LABEL value of the field fieldRole attribute.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: data-store.collection
text: The collectionType attribute of data-store.collection should probably be required.
proposed_change: Make collectionType a required attribute.

subject: data-store.collection
text: The outgoing relationship 'collection composes namespace' appears inverted, since a namespace should compose collections.
proposed_change: Reverse the direction so namespace composes collection.

subject: data-store.collection
text: Per-key Redis structures (HASH, SORTED_SET) need a granularity rule: model the key pattern as a collection, not each individual key.
proposed_change: Add a granularity rule stating that a collection models the key pattern, not each key.

subject: data-store.database
text: The boundary between the data-store.database element (server instance) and a logical database is unclear, since one PostgreSQL server can host many databases, and the type has no endpoint or host attribute.
proposed_change: Add an endpoint or host attribute to data-store.database to identify the server/connection and clarify the instance vs logical database boundary.

subject: data-store.database
text: The composes relationships from data-store.database to field, index and validationrule bypass collection and duplicate containment already expressed through collection.
proposed_change: Remove the direct composes edges from database to field, index and validationrule, keeping containment via collection.

subject: data-store.database
text: MongoDB's 'database' concept maps to data-store.namespace, which conflicts with the name data-store.database being used for the deployment-level element.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: data-store.database
text: The deploymentModel attribute of data-store.database overlaps with the topology information expressed by technology.node.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: data-store.eventhandler
text: The handlerType values WATCHER and ALERT_RULE fire on periodic conditions rather than data changes, but the timing enum on data-store.eventhandler has no SCHEDULED/PERIODIC value to express this.
proposed_change: Add a SCHEDULED or PERIODIC value to the timing enum.

subject: data-store.eventhandler
text: The events attribute of data-store.eventhandler is a free array with no item enum, so valid event values are not constrained.
proposed_change: Define an item enum for events (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, REPLACE, DROP, INVALIDATE, EXPIRE, SET, DEL, THRESHOLD, ANOMALY, CUSTOM).

subject: data-store.eventhandler
text: The boundary between data-store.eventhandler and application-layer consumers (e.g. a service calling watch()) is unclear, namely whether the subscription or the consumer is modelled in the data-store layer.
proposed_change: Specify in the definition whether the subscription or the consuming application component is modelled by eventhandler, and add a boundary rule against application-layer consumers.

subject: data-store.eventhandler
text: The relationship field --triggers--> eventhandler should probably use the predicate 'monitors' because it represents an UPDATE OF column watch rather than causation.
proposed_change: Rename the predicate from 'triggers' to 'monitors'.

subject: data-store.field
text: The data-store.field attribute nullable duplicates the NOT_NULL rule type of validationrule, so the spec should state which of the two is the canonical representation.
proposed_change: Declare either field.nullable or validationrule NOT_NULL as canonical and document the precedence rule.

subject: data-store.field
text: The fieldRole enum value LABEL on data-store.field (graph node label) overlaps with the NODE_LABEL value of data-store.collection.
proposed_change: Remove LABEL from fieldRole or define a boundary with collection NODE_LABEL.

subject: data-store.field
text: The fieldRole enum of data-store.field lacks a PRIMARY_KEY or ID value for identifier fields.
proposed_change: Add a PRIMARY_KEY (or ID) value to fieldRole.

subject: data-store.field
text: The fieldRole values VALUE and PROPERTY on data-store.field are ambiguous for graph databases because both describe ordinary data fields.
proposed_change: Clarify the distinction between VALUE and PROPERTY or merge them.

subject: data-store.field
text: Composition of data-store.field by database and namespace should probably be restricted so that only collection composes field.
proposed_change: Remove the database-composes-field and namespace-composes-field relationships, keeping only collection-composes-field.

subject: data-store.field
text: data-store.field lacks a field-level description or comment attribute.
proposed_change: Add a description (comment) string attribute to data-store.field.

subject: data-store.index
text: The data-store.index method enum mixes access methods (e.g. BTREE) with key shapes (COMPOUND, MULTIKEY), which are orthogonal axes.
proposed_change: Remove COMPOUND and MULTIKEY from the method enum and represent key shape separately (e.g. derived from fields or a separate attribute).

subject: data-store.index
text: The data-store.index fields attribute is a plain string, so it cannot express per-field sort direction or operator class.
proposed_change: Change fields to a structured list of field entries each with name, sort direction, and opclass.

subject: data-store.index
text: The Elasticsearch 'index' concept is claimed by both the collection and namespace definitions, creating ambiguity over which type models it, in relation to data-store.index.
proposed_change: Define a boundary/precedence rule assigning the Elasticsearch index to a single type (collection).

subject: data-store.index
text: Unique indexes (data-store.index unique attribute) overlap with the ValidationRule UNIQUE constraint.
proposed_change: Add a precedence rule stating when a unique index is modeled as an Index versus a ValidationRule UNIQUE.

subject: data-store.index
text: The relationships from AccessPattern to Index include redundant 'aggregates' and 'uses' relationships expressing the same meaning.
proposed_change: Collapse the two relationships into one (keep uses) and remove the redundant aggregates.

subject: data-store.namespace
text: Mapping an Elasticsearch index to data-store.namespace conflicts with data-store.collection's SEARCH_INDEX type, so only one of the two should own Elasticsearch indexes.
proposed_change: Remove Elasticsearch index from the Namespace definition and map it to Collection (SEARCH_INDEX) only.

subject: data-store.namespace
text: The relationship 'collection composes namespace' appears inverted, since a namespace should contain collections, or it skips a level.
proposed_change: Reverse the relationship so namespace composes collection, or remove it.

subject: data-store.namespace
text: The relationship 'namespace composes field' appears to skip a level, because fields belong to collections rather than directly to namespaces.
proposed_change: Remove the direct namespace-to-field composition and route it through collection.

subject: data-store.namespace
text: A Redis key prefix is only a naming convention and not an engine object, so it does not fit the Namespace definition as a database object container.
proposed_change: Drop Redis prefix from Namespace mappings or mark it explicitly as a convention-only case.

subject: data-store.namespace
text: Namespace lacks an attribute for Cassandra keyspace replication strategy.
proposed_change: Add a replication strategy attribute to Namespace.

subject: data-store.namespace
text: Namespace lacks a per-namespace charset or collation attribute.
proposed_change: Add charset and collation attributes to Namespace.

subject: data-store.retentionpolicy
text: data-store.retentionpolicy has a single retentionDuration and a single action, so it cannot express multi-phase lifecycles such as ILM hot/warm/cold/delete.
proposed_change: Add a phases array of duration/action steps to data-store.retentionpolicy.

subject: data-store.retentionpolicy
text: data-store.retentionpolicy overlaps with collection.ttlDefault and MongoDB TTL indexes, so a boundary or precedence rule is needed.
proposed_change: Define a boundary or precedence rule between retentionpolicy, collection.ttlDefault and TTL indexes.

subject: data-store.retentionpolicy
text: retentionDuration uses an ISO 8601 duration format while downsampleInterval uses a shorthand like '1h', so the duration formats are inconsistent.
proposed_change: Make downsampleInterval use ISO 8601 durations, consistent with retentionDuration.

subject: data-store.retentionpolicy
text: The 'aggregates' relationships from data-store.retentionpolicy duplicate the 'governs' relationships.
proposed_change: Remove the 'aggregates' edges or merge them into 'governs'.

subject: data-store.retentionpolicy
text: data-store.retentionpolicy lacks an attribute stating the age basis, i.e. whether age is measured from insert time or from a timestamp field.
proposed_change: Add an age-basis attribute that specifies insert time or a named timestamp field.

subject: data-store.storedlogic
text: The logicType value LAMBDA contradicts the definition of storedlogic as logic that executes within the data store engine, since DynamoDB Lambda triggers run outside the engine and are better modelled as an eventhandler bound to external application code.
proposed_change: Remove LAMBDA from logicType and model DynamoDB Lambda triggers as an eventhandler bound to external application code.

subject: data-store.storedlogic
text: The language value EXTERNAL (logic implemented outside the database) contradicts the definition of storedlogic as logic that executes within the data store engine.
proposed_change: Remove EXTERNAL from the language enum or otherwise reconcile it with the in-engine execution definition.

subject: data-store.storedlogic
text: The logicType value CONTINUOUS_QUERY overlaps with the view type's CONTINUOUS_AGGREGATE and with the retentionpolicy's DOWNSAMPLE.
proposed_change: Define a boundary or precedence rule between CONTINUOUS_QUERY and view CONTINUOUS_AGGREGATE / retentionpolicy DOWNSAMPLE, or drop CONTINUOUS_QUERY.

subject: data-store.storedlogic
text: The logicType values PROCEDURE and STORED_PROCEDURE duplicate each other.
proposed_change: Merge PROCEDURE and STORED_PROCEDURE into a single value.

subject: data-store.storedlogic
text: StoredLogic lacks a parameters/signature attribute describing its inputs.
proposed_change: Add a parameters/signature attribute to storedlogic.

subject: data-store.storedlogic
text: The 'migrates' relationship from storedlogic to collection is unclear in meaning.
proposed_change: Clarify the semantics of the 'migrates' relationship to collection, or replace or remove it.

subject: data-store.validationrule
text: The ruleType enum value NOT_NULL duplicates the field.nullable attribute, so null-ability is expressible in two places.
proposed_change: Merge or remove NOT_NULL from ruleType, or define a precedence rule against field.nullable.

subject: data-store.validationrule
text: The ruleType enum splits UNIQUE and UNIQUENESS_CONSTRAINT into two values that mean the same thing, which is redundant.
proposed_change: Merge UNIQUE and UNIQUENESS_CONSTRAINT into a single value.

subject: data-store.validationrule
text: The ruleType value TTL_CONSTRAINT overlaps with collection.ttlDefault and with the retentionpolicy element type.
proposed_change: Remove TTL_CONSTRAINT or define a boundary delegating TTL to retentionpolicy and collection.ttlDefault.

subject: data-store.validationrule
text: validationrule has no deferrable or initiallyDeferred attribute to represent SQL DEFERRABLE constraints.
proposed_change: Add deferrable and initiallyDeferred attributes to validationrule.

subject: data-store.validationrule
text: The description of onDelete value NO_ACTION as 'deferred reject' is accurate only for deferrable constraints, so it is misleading.
proposed_change: Reword the NO_ACTION description to say it rejects at statement end and is deferred only when the constraint is deferrable.

subject: data-store.validationrule
text: The enforcement enum (STRICT/WARN/LOG) cannot express MongoDB validationLevel values such as strict and moderate.
proposed_change: Extend enforcement or add an attribute to represent MongoDB validationLevel (strict/moderate).

subject: data-store.view
text: The data-store.view attribute 'materialized' is redundant with 'viewType' and can contradict it (e.g. viewType ALIAS with materialized=true).
proposed_change: Derive 'materialized' from viewType (or remove it) so the two cannot contradict each other.

subject: data-store.view
text: InfluxDB continuous queries are covered both by data-store.view viewType CONTINUOUS_AGGREGATE and by the storedlogic CONTINUOUS_QUERY value, so the two types overlap.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: data-store.view
text: The viewType enum value FILTERED overlaps with VIRTUAL, since a filtered read-only subset is a computed-on-read view.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: data-store.view
text: data-store.view lacks an 'updatable' attribute to say whether the view accepts writes.
proposed_change: Add an 'updatable' boolean attribute to data-store.view.

subject: motivation.assessment
text: The assessmentType enum on motivation.assessment mixes analysis methods (SWOT) with subject kinds (risk, gap, impact), so it combines different axes.
proposed_change: Split assessmentType into separate attributes or otherwise separate method values from subject-kind values.

subject: motivation.assessment
text: motivation.assessment cannot record which SWOT quadrant (strength, weakness, opportunity, threat) a finding belongs to.
proposed_change: Add a swotCategory attribute to motivation.assessment.

subject: motivation.assessment
text: motivation.assessment lacks severity and likelihood attributes needed to describe risk findings.
proposed_change: Add severity and likelihood attributes to motivation.assessment for risk findings.

subject: motivation.assessment
text: The relationship assessment-influence-assessment appears twice in the relationship list of motivation.assessment, which may be an unintended duplicate.
proposed_change: Confirm whether the duplicate is intentional and remove it if it is not.

subject: motivation.constraint
text: The definition of motivation.constraint says constraints are 'as opposed to requirements which must be satisfied', which is misleading because in ArchiMate a constraint is also binding, being a requirement-like element that restricts realization.
proposed_change: Reword the definition to drop the contrast with requirements and state that a constraint is a binding restriction on how the system may be realized.

subject: motivation.constraint
text: The constraintType enum values 'external' and 'regulatory' on motivation.constraint overlap in meaning.
proposed_change: Remove or redefine 'external' so it does not overlap 'regulatory'.

subject: motivation.constraint
text: The constraintType enum of motivation.constraint lacks 'contractual/legal' and 'security' values.
proposed_change: Add 'contractual' (or 'legal') and 'security' values to the constraintType enum.

subject: motivation.constraint
text: motivation.constraint has no source or rationale attribute to record where the constraint comes from or why it exists.
proposed_change: Add a source/rationale attribute to motivation.constraint.

subject: motivation.constraint
text: The self-loop 'specializes' relationship on motivation.constraint is listed twice, making it redundant.
proposed_change: Remove the duplicate specializes self-loop relationship so it is listed once.

subject: motivation.driver
text: The motivation.driver 'category' enum mixes overlapping values: 'business' overlaps with market, strategic and competitive.
proposed_change: Consolidate the category enum to remove 'business' overlap with market/strategic/competitive values.

subject: motivation.driver
text: The motivation.driver 'category' enum contains 'technical' and 'technological', which are duplicates of each other.
proposed_change: Merge 'technical' and 'technological' into a single value.

subject: motivation.driver
text: motivation.driver has no attribute flagging whether the driver is internal or external, although its definition hinges on that distinction.
proposed_change: Add an 'origin' enum attribute (e.g. internal/external) to motivation.driver.

subject: motivation.driver
text: The incoming 'influence' relationship from stakeholder to driver is non-standard, since ArchiMate defines stakeholder-to-driver as association.
proposed_change: Review the stakeholder-to-driver influence relationship and replace it with association if appropriate.

subject: motivation.goal
text: The relationship from motivation.goal to motivation.assessment of type influence departs from ArchiMate 3.2 or is questionable.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: motivation.goal
text: The aggregation relationship from motivation.requirement to motivation.goal departs from ArchiMate 3.2 or is questionable.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: motivation.goal
text: The realization relationship from motivation.goal to motivation.value departs from ArchiMate 3.2 or is questionable.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: motivation.goal
text: The relationship in which data-model.jsonschema realizes motivation.goal departs from ArchiMate 3.2 or is questionable.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: motivation.goal
text: The 'informational' value of the priority enum on motivation.goal does not fit a goal.
proposed_change: Remove the 'informational' value from the priority enum of motivation.goal.

subject: motivation.goal
text: motivation.goal lacks owner and timeHorizon attributes, which would help separate goals from outcomes.
proposed_change: Add owner and timeHorizon attributes to motivation.goal.

subject: motivation.meaning
text: motivation.meaning has no 'context' attribute identifying the context of interpretation.
proposed_change: Add a 'context' attribute to motivation.meaning.

subject: motivation.meaning
text: motivation.meaning has no attribute or reference identifying the concept or element being interpreted.
proposed_change: Add a reference attribute to the interpreted element on motivation.meaning.

subject: motivation.meaning
text: motivation.meaning lacks association relationships to motivation.requirement and motivation.principle, though ArchiMate permits meaning to be associated with any concept.
proposed_change: Add association relationships from motivation.meaning to motivation.requirement and motivation.principle.

subject: motivation.meaning
text: motivation.meaning lacks relationships to elements in other layers, though ArchiMate permits meaning to be associated with any concept.
proposed_change: Add association relationships from motivation.meaning to elements in other layers.

subject: motivation.meaning
text: A classifier may classify glossary entries as motivation.meaning in bulk.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: motivation.outcome
text: motivation.outcome has no attributes for measure, targetValue or targetDate, so measurability is only expressible in free text.
proposed_change: Add measure, targetValue and targetDate attributes to motivation.outcome.

subject: motivation.outcome
text: Both 'influence' and 'realizes' relationships from outcome to goal exist, although ArchiMate standardizes realization, making the two redundant.
proposed_change: Keep the standard 'realizes' relationship to goal and remove or justify the redundant 'influence' relationship.

subject: motivation.outcome
text: The outcome 'realizes' value relationship is non-standard, since ArchiMate associates value with outcome rather than having outcome realize value.
proposed_change: Replace the outcome 'realizes' value relationship with an association (or the ArchiMate-conformant relationship) between value and outcome.

subject: motivation.outcome
text: SLO targets overlap with apm metric elements; the outcome is the target, not the instrument, so a boundary is needed between motivation.outcome and apm metric elements.
proposed_change: Define a boundary rule stating that outcome expresses the target while apm metric elements are the measuring instrument.

subject: motivation.principle
text: The motivation.principle type has no dedicated attributes for TOGAF-style statement, rationale and implications, so this content is forced into the free-text documentation attribute.
proposed_change: Add statement, rationale and implications attributes to motivation.principle.

subject: motivation.principle
text: The category enum of motivation.principle lacks values for business and usability/UX domains.
proposed_change: Add business and usability (UX) values to the category enum.

subject: motivation.principle
text: Code-level types such as systemsoftware (implements) and applicationcomponent (realizes) relate directly to motivation.principle, bypassing requirements, whereas ArchiMate expects principles to be realized via requirements.
proposed_change: Remove the direct realization/implements relationships from code-level types to principle and route them through requirement.

subject: motivation.principle
text: The relationship name 'governed-by-principles' is not a standard ArchiMate relationship name.
proposed_change: Rename or replace 'governed-by-principles' with a standard relationship predicate.

subject: motivation.requirement
text: motivation.requirement and motivation.constraint lack explicit boundary rules, since ArchiMate treats Constraint as a specialization of Requirement.
proposed_change: Add explicit boundary/precedence rules between requirement and constraint.

subject: motivation.requirement
text: The requirementType enum value 'regulatory' on motivation.requirement overlaps with the 'regulatory' value of constraintType on motivation.constraint.
proposed_change: Merge or deduplicate the overlapping 'regulatory' values across requirementType and constraintType.

subject: motivation.requirement
text: The requirementType value 'non-functional' overlaps with the 'quality' value in the same enum (and in constraintType).
proposed_change: Merge the 'non-functional' and 'quality' values.

subject: motivation.requirement
text: The relationship 'requirement aggregates goal' has an inverted direction compared to the normal direction.
proposed_change: Reverse the direction (goal aggregates requirement) or replace the relationship.

subject: motivation.requirement
text: Incoming relationships to motivation.requirement use 'satisfies', 'realizes', and 'fulfills' inconsistently for similar meanings.
proposed_change: Standardize the incoming predicates to a single consistent predicate (e.g. realizes).

subject: motivation.requirement
text: motivation.requirement lacks an attribute for verification or acceptance criteria.
proposed_change: Add a verification/acceptanceCriteria attribute to motivation.requirement.

subject: motivation.stakeholder
text: The enum attribute 'type' on motivation.stakeholder mixes orthogonal axes (internal/external relationship, role such as sponsor/customer/end-user, and kind such as system/regulatory), so its values are not mutually exclusive.
proposed_change: Split the enum into separate attributes per axis (e.g. relationship to organization, role, kind) or otherwise make the values mutually exclusive.

subject: motivation.stakeholder
text: The attribute name 'type' on motivation.stakeholder collides with the element-type field.
proposed_change: Rename the attribute to something non-colliding such as 'classification' or 'stakeholder_kind'.

subject: motivation.stakeholder
text: The enum value 'system' in motivation.stakeholder.type departs from ArchiMate's Stakeholder concept.
proposed_change: Remove or justify the 'system' value to align with ArchiMate.

subject: motivation.stakeholder
text: The boundary between motivation.stakeholder and business.businessactor/business.businessrole needs to be stated.
proposed_change: Add a distinction stating when to use stakeholder versus business actor or role.

subject: motivation.stakeholder
text: motivation.stakeholder lacks a 'concerns' attribute capturing the stakeholder's interests or concerns.
proposed_change: Add a 'concerns' attribute to motivation.stakeholder.

subject: motivation.value
text: The relationships 'motivation.goal realizes motivation.value' and 'motivation.outcome realizes motivation.value' deviate from ArchiMate, which only associates value with other elements.
proposed_change: Replace the realizes relationships from goal and outcome to value with associated-with, or otherwise align them with ArchiMate.

subject: motivation.value
text: The relationship 'motivation.value associated-with motivation.value' is listed twice in the catalog.
proposed_change: Remove the duplicate value associated-with value relationship so it is listed once.

subject: motivation.value
text: The motivation.value valueType enum lacks a customer or user-experience category, so modellers will overload 'social' or 'operational'.
proposed_change: Add a customer or user-experience value to the valueType enum.

subject: motivation.value
text: motivation.value has no attribute to quantify the value, such as an amount and unit.
proposed_change: Add an optional quantification attribute, such as amount and unit, to motivation.value.

subject: navigation.breadcrumbconfig
text: The definition of navigation.breadcrumbconfig promises separator styles, truncation behavior and path generation rules, but no attributes exist to capture them.
proposed_change: Add separator, maxItems and truncationStrategy attributes to navigation.breadcrumbconfig.

subject: navigation.breadcrumbconfig
text: The required attribute 'label' on the global navigation.breadcrumbconfig is semantically unclear, as it is uncertain whether it is a fallback label or the scope name.
proposed_change: Clarify whether label is a fallback label or the scope name, and rename or adjust its required-ness accordingly.

subject: navigation.breadcrumbconfig
text: The attribute navigation.breadcrumbconfig.homeRoute duplicates the 'references Route' relationship from breadcrumbconfig.
proposed_change: Remove the redundancy by dropping either the homeRoute attribute or the references Route relationship.

subject: navigation.breadcrumbconfig
text: The semantics of the 'tracks NavigationFlow' relationship from navigation.breadcrumbconfig are unclear.
proposed_change: Clarify the meaning of the tracks relationship to NavigationFlow, or remove it if it cannot be justified.

subject: navigation.contextvariable
text: The scope enum value 'session' of navigation.contextvariable overlaps with the persistedIn value 'sessionStorage', so the two attributes mix lifetime and storage axes.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: navigation.contextvariable
text: The scope enum value 'global' of navigation.contextvariable contradicts the type's definition as flow-scoped state shared across steps of a NavigationFlow.
proposed_change: Remove or redefine the 'global' scope value so it is consistent with the flow-scoped definition.

subject: navigation.contextvariable
text: The persistedIn enum of navigation.contextvariable lacks values for history-state (location.state) and server-side persistence.
proposed_change: Add 'history-state' and a server-side persistence value to persistedIn.

subject: navigation.contextvariable
text: navigation.contextvariable declares no name attribute, although it is meant to be a named variable.
proposed_change: Add a name attribute to navigation.contextvariable.

subject: navigation.contextvariable
text: The defaultValue attribute of navigation.contextvariable is an untyped string, though variables are typed.
proposed_change: Give defaultValue a type consistent with the variable's schema, or a serialized-value format.

subject: navigation.contextvariable
text: navigation.guardcondition has both consumes and uses relationships to navigation.contextvariable, which express the same meaning and are redundant.
proposed_change: Keep only one of the consumes or uses edges between guardcondition and contextvariable.

subject: navigation.contextvariable
text: A 'triggers' relationship from the passive navigation.contextvariable to navigation.navigationtransition is questionable because passive state does not trigger transitions.
proposed_change: Remove the triggers edge or replace it with a more fitting predicate or direction.

subject: navigation.flowstep
text: The 'route' string attribute on navigation.flowstep duplicates the navigates-to and realizes relationships from flowstep to navigation.route, so only one representation should be kept.
proposed_change: Keep only one of the route attribute or the flowstep-to-route relationship and remove the duplicate.

subject: navigation.flowstep
text: The 'realizes' relationship from navigation.flowstep to navigation.route is semantically odd.
proposed_change: Remove or replace the realizes predicate with a more fitting one (e.g. keep navigates-to).

subject: navigation.flowstep
text: The aggregates and composes relationships from navigation.navigationflow to navigation.flowstep are redundant with each other.
proposed_change: Keep only one of aggregates or composes between navigationflow and flowstep.

subject: navigation.flowstep
text: The waitBehavior enum value 'timeout' on navigation.flowstep has no accompanying timeout-duration attribute to specify the timeout.
proposed_change: Add a timeout duration attribute to flowstep for use with waitBehavior 'timeout'.

subject: navigation.flowstep
text: The 'required' attribute name on navigation.flowstep collides with ContextVariable.required, and 'skippable' or 'optional' would be clearer.
proposed_change: Rename 'required' to 'skippable' or 'optional'.

subject: navigation.guardaction
text: The attributes 'target' and 'message' on navigation.guardaction are marked required although they apply only to some actions, so they should be conditionally required.
proposed_change: Make target required only for redirect actions and message required only for notify and prompt actions.

subject: navigation.guardaction
text: The description of navigation.guardaction.target mentions 'replace' actions, but the action enum has no 'replace' value.
proposed_change: Add 'replace' to the action enum or remove the 'replace' wording from the target description.

subject: navigation.guardaction
text: The 'prompt' action typically arises from leave guards such as canDeactivate rather than access denial, so the definition's 'access denied' framing of navigation.guardaction is too narrow.
proposed_change: Broaden the definition to cover leave guards and confirmation prompts, not only access denial.

subject: navigation.guardaction
text: The attribute navigation.guardaction.preserveRoute assumes an authentication context, although guard actions are not limited to authentication.
proposed_change: Reword preserveRoute to be independent of authentication, and consider making it optional.

subject: navigation.guardcondition
text: The timeout attribute of navigation.guardcondition is required even when async is false, which is meaningless for synchronous predicates.
proposed_change: Make timeout optional or conditionally required only when async is true.

subject: navigation.guardcondition
text: The 'constrains' relationship from navigation.guardcondition to navigation.route duplicates the role already played by the guard.
proposed_change: Remove the constrains relationship from guardcondition to route.

subject: navigation.guardcondition
text: The 'consumes' and 'uses' relationships from navigation.guardcondition to navigation.contextvariable are redundant with each other.
proposed_change: Keep only one of consumes or uses between guardcondition and contextvariable.

subject: navigation.guardcondition
text: The expression language of navigation.guardcondition (JS, CEL, named reference) is not recorded, so a language attribute is lacking.
proposed_change: Add a 'language' enum attribute with values such as JS, CEL, and named reference.

subject: navigation.navigationflow
text: The navigation.navigationflow definition promises entry and exit points, but no attribute records them; entryStep and exitStep attributes should be added.
proposed_change: Add entryStep and exitStep attributes to navigation.navigationflow.

subject: navigation.navigationflow
text: navigation.navigationflow lacks an explicit name attribute.
proposed_change: Add a name attribute to navigation.navigationflow.

subject: navigation.navigationflow
text: NavigationFlow has both aggregates and composes relationships to flowstep, which are redundant.
proposed_change: Keep composes and remove the aggregates relationship to flowstep.

subject: navigation.navigationflow
text: NavigationFlow both realizes and triggers business.businessprocess, which is ambiguous.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: navigation.navigationflow
text: ContextVariable scope value 'flow' implies a flow identifier that is not modeled on NavigationFlow.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: navigation.navigationgraph
text: NavigationGraph has both 'aggregates' and 'composes' relationships to Route and NavigationTransition, which is redundant.
proposed_change: Choose one of 'aggregates' or 'composes' for the relationships from NavigationGraph to Route and NavigationTransition and remove the other.

subject: navigation.navigationgraph
text: The meaning of navigation.navigationgraph.version is ambiguous: it could be the model revision or the router library version.
proposed_change: Clarify or rename version to state it is the model revision, and record the router library version in the technology.systemsoftware link.

subject: navigation.navigationgraph
text: No cardinality rule is defined for NavigationGraph in applications with micro-frontends or multiple router instances.
proposed_change: Define a cardinality rule for NavigationGraph per application for micro-frontends or multiple router instances.

subject: navigation.navigationgraph
text: NavigationGraph lacks attributes capturing the router framework or history mode.
proposed_change: Consider adding 'routerFramework' or 'historyMode' attributes to NavigationGraph.

subject: navigation.navigationguard
text: The enum attribute 'type' of navigation.navigationguard lacks a value for leave/deactivate guards such as unsaved-changes prompts.
proposed_change: Add an enum value (e.g. 'deactivate' or 'unsaved-changes') to navigationguard.type.

subject: navigation.navigationguard
text: navigation.navigationguard has no attribute capturing the hook phase (e.g. beforeEnter, canDeactivate, canMatch).
proposed_change: Add a hook phase attribute (e.g. 'phase') to navigationguard.

subject: navigation.navigationguard
text: navigation.navigationguard has no attribute capturing guard scope (global versus per-route).
proposed_change: Add a scope attribute (e.g. 'scope' with values global/per-route) to navigationguard.

subject: navigation.navigationguard
text: The relationships 'evaluates' and 'uses' from navigationguard to guardcondition express the same meaning and are duplicates.
proposed_change: Merge 'evaluates' and 'uses' into a single relationship to guardcondition.

subject: navigation.navigationguard
text: RouteMeta states that guards live in the security layer, which contradicts navigationguard being placed in the navigation layer.
proposed_change: Reconcile the layer placement by fixing the RouteMeta wording or the navigationguard layer assignment.

subject: navigation.navigationtransition
text: The definition of navigation.navigationtransition uses the word 'authorized', which is undefined; guards constrain transitions rather than authorize them.
proposed_change: Reword the definition to drop 'authorized' (e.g. 'permitted route change') and state that guards constrain transitions.

subject: navigation.navigationtransition
text: NavigationTransition has redundant relationships: flows-to and navigates-to both target Route.
proposed_change: Remove one of flows-to or navigates-to, keeping a single relationship from NavigationTransition to Route.

subject: navigation.navigationtransition
text: The navigation graph both aggregates and composes NavigationTransition, which is a redundant pair of relationships.
proposed_change: Keep only one of aggregates or composes between NavigationGraph and NavigationTransition.

subject: navigation.navigationtransition
text: The string attributes 'from' and 'to' on NavigationTransition duplicate the edges to Route and are untyped references.
proposed_change: Remove the from/to string attributes and rely on relationships to Route (or make them typed Route references).

subject: navigation.navigationtransition
text: The 'redirect' value of the trigger attribute overlaps with Route type=redirect and GuardAction action=redirect, and the spec does not state which element owns a redirect.
proposed_change: Add an ownership rule to the spec stating which element (transition, route or guard action) owns a redirect.

subject: navigation.route
text: navigation.route has no path or name attribute, so the defining URL pattern and route parameters cannot be recorded.
proposed_change: Add path (URL pattern), name and route parameters attributes to navigation.route.

subject: navigation.route
text: The navigation.route type enum mixes three independent dimensions: access (public/protected), behaviour (redirect/alias) and loading (lazy), so a protected lazy route cannot be expressed.
proposed_change: Split the type enum into separate attributes for access, behaviour and loading.

subject: navigation.route
text: The aggregates and composes relationships from navigation.route look redundant with each other.
proposed_change: Keep only one of aggregates or composes.

subject: navigation.route
text: The flows-to, triggers and navigates-to relationships from navigation.route look redundant with each other.
proposed_change: Consolidate flows-to, triggers and navigates-to into a single relationship.

subject: navigation.route
text: The boundary between navigation.route and api.pathitem needs to be stated.
proposed_change: State in the definition that navigation.route is a client-side route entry and api.pathitem is a server-side HTTP path.

subject: navigation.routemeta
text: The attributes roles, permissions, layout, keepAlive and transition of navigation.routemeta are marked required, but real meta objects set only a few fields, so they should be optional.
proposed_change: Make roles, permissions, layout, keepAlive and transition optional (not required).

subject: navigation.routemeta
text: The roles and permissions attributes of navigation.routemeta are typed as comma-separated strings but should be string arrays.
proposed_change: Change the type of roles and permissions from comma-separated string to array of strings.

subject: navigation.routemeta
text: The 'transition' attribute of navigation.routemeta collides with the NavigationTransition element type and the uses→navigationtransition edge.
proposed_change: Rename the attribute 'transition' to 'animation'.

subject: navigation.routemeta
text: The definition of navigation.routemeta wrongly places NavigationGuard in the security layer, although it is a navigation layer type.
proposed_change: Fix the definition so NavigationGuard is not described as being in the security layer.

subject: product.capability
text: The outgoing 'realizes' relationship from product.capability to business.businessfunction inverts ArchiMate, where behaviour realizes capability.
proposed_change: Replace 'realizes' with 'serves' or 'associated-with' for product.capability to business.businessfunction.

subject: product.capability
text: Feature has both 'realizes' and 'uses' relationships toward product.capability without a stated distinction between them.
proposed_change: Document the semantic distinction between 'realizes' and 'uses' from feature to capability, or remove one.

subject: product.capability
text: product.capability lacks a granularity or level attribute (e.g. L1/L2) to support capability hierarchies built via 'aggregates'.
proposed_change: Add a granularity/level attribute (e.g. enum L1/L2/L3) to product.capability.

subject: product.capability
text: The status enum of product.capability duplicates that of product.feature, blurring lifecycle versus delivery status.
proposed_change: Differentiate capability status as lifecycle values distinct from feature's delivery status values.

subject: product.feature
text: Both 'realizes' and 'uses' relationships from product.feature to product.capability exist without guidance on when to use each, so they are redundant or ambiguous.
proposed_change: Define when to use 'realizes' versus 'uses' between product.feature and product.capability, or drop the 'uses' relationship.

subject: product.feature
text: The 'informational' value of the product.feature priority enum reads like a severity level and does not fit a deliverable.
proposed_change: Remove or replace the 'informational' value in the priority enum.

subject: product.feature
text: The product.feature size enum (xs|s|m|l|xl) lacks a stated scale, so it is unclear whether it means story points or effort.
proposed_change: State the scale the size enum represents (e.g. story points or effort) in the attribute description.

subject: product.feature
text: The depends-on self-relationship of product.feature appears in both the outgoing and incoming relationship lists, duplicating it.
proposed_change: List the depends-on self-relationship only once, not in both outgoing and incoming lists.

subject: product.milestone
text: The product.milestone type is defined as time-bound, but no attribute such as a target date supports this, so a targetDate (ISO 8601) attribute is missing.
proposed_change: Add a targetDate attribute in ISO 8601 format to product.milestone.

subject: product.milestone
text: The product.milestone type may also need an optional startDate or version label attribute to capture its time period or release identity.
proposed_change: Optionally add startDate and a version label attribute to product.milestone.

subject: product.milestone
text: The product.milestone.status enum (proposed, planned, active, completed, cancelled) differs from the capability/feature lifecycle, which is acceptable but should be documented.
proposed_change: Document the reason the milestone status enum differs from the capability/feature lifecycle.

subject: product.milestone
text: The precedes relationship on product.milestone is listed twice, making it redundant.
proposed_change: Remove the duplicate precedes relationship entry for product.milestone.

subject: product.milestone
text: A completed product.milestone may need to link to the release tag that realized it, and no such relationship exists.
proposed_change: Consider adding a relationship from a completed milestone to the release tag that realized it.

subject: product.persona
text: The product.persona.category enum mixes importance values (primary, secondary) with Cooper's persona kinds (served, negative), so its description 'by importance' is misleading.
proposed_change: Split the enum into separate axes (importance vs. Cooper kind) or correct the description so it no longer says 'by importance'.

subject: product.persona
text: The product.persona definition cites goals and pain points, but no attributes on product.persona capture goals or pain points.
proposed_change: Add attributes such as goals and painPoints to product.persona.

subject: product.persona
text: The boundary between product.persona and business.businessrole is fuzzy, since authorization roles such as admin or editor are roles rather than personas.
proposed_change: Define a boundary rule stating that auth/access roles belong to business.businessrole and personas are user archetypes.

subject: product.persona
text: The relationship 'product.persona serves business.businessrole' appears to point the wrong way or use an ill-fitting predicate.
proposed_change: Replace 'serves' with 'aggregates' or 'associated with', or reverse the direction.

subject: product.userworkflow
text: The 'composes' relationship from product.userworkflow to product.feature is questionable because a workflow exercises features through its steps rather than owning them.
proposed_change: Replace 'composes' with 'uses' or route the connection through product.workflowstep.

subject: product.userworkflow
text: The complexity enum on product.userworkflow (simple|moderate|complex) has no decision criteria for choosing a value.
proposed_change: Add guidance defining complexity levels by step count or branching.

subject: product.userworkflow
text: product.userworkflow has no attribute capturing the workflow's goal or its trigger.
proposed_change: Add 'goal' and 'trigger' attributes to product.userworkflow.

subject: product.workflowstep
text: The product.workflowstep sequence attribute and the flows-to relationships between workflow steps can contradict each other, and the spec does not define which one is authoritative for ordering.
proposed_change: Define which of sequence or flows-to is authoritative for step order (or how they must be kept consistent).

subject: product.workflowstep
text: product.workflowstep cannot express branching or alternative paths in a workflow.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: product.workflowstep
text: The 'uses capability' relationship from product.workflowstep duplicates what the Feature already delivers via the step's feature link.
proposed_change: Remove or justify the workflowstep-to-capability 'uses' relationship since the Feature already covers it.

subject: product.workflowstep
text: product.workflowstep has no way to name which Persona performs a step when a workflow involves several actors, other than the general 'serves' link.
proposed_change: Add an explicit performer relationship or attribute linking a step to the Persona who performs it.

subject: product.workflowstep
text: The flows-to relationship from product.workflowstep is listed twice in the catalog.
proposed_change: Remove the duplicate flows-to relationship entry.

subject: security.accesscondition
text: The attribute security.accesscondition.source is a required string, whereas sibling types use an optional source-code-reference object for 'source', so its typing is inconsistent.
proposed_change: Make source an optional source-code-reference object consistent with siblings.

subject: security.accesscondition
text: The attribute security.accesscondition.source has a name that collides with the sibling 'source' source-code-reference concept while meaning something different.
proposed_change: Rename source to something like attributeSource.

subject: security.accesscondition
text: The operator enum on security.accesscondition lacks values such as gte, lte and not-in.
proposed_change: Add gte, lte and not-in to the operator enum.

subject: security.accesscondition
text: The value attribute of security.accesscondition is string-only, so it cannot represent non-string values such as numbers, booleans or lists.
proposed_change: Allow value to hold non-string types (e.g. number, boolean, list) rather than string only.

subject: security.accesscondition
text: Both 'accesscondition composes policyrule' and 'policyrule uses accesscondition' exist, which are redundant relationships between the same pair of types.
proposed_change: Remove one of the two redundant relationships.

subject: security.accesscondition
text: The relationship 'accesscondition composes policyrule' has its direction reversed, since a policy rule should compose access conditions.
proposed_change: Reverse it to policyrule composes accesscondition or drop it in favor of the existing uses relationship.

subject: security.accesscondition
text: The message attribute of security.accesscondition is required, but it should not be required for every predicate.
proposed_change: Make message optional.

subject: security.accountabilityrequirement
text: security.accountabilityrequirement has no attribute identifying the obligated actor even though its definition says 'who'; it depends on the constrains→actor relationship.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: security.accountabilityrequirement
text: The boolean attribute nonRepudiation on security.accountabilityrequirement weakens the type's AU-10 anchor, since false would negate the purpose of the type.
proposed_change: Replace nonRepudiation boolean with a required evidence-strength enum.

subject: security.accountabilityrequirement
text: The attribute purposeDeclaration on security.accountabilityrequirement overlaps with NeedToKnow.objective.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: security.accountabilityrequirement
text: The definition says the type covers under what conditions evidence can be challenged, but the challengeable attribute is only a boolean, so challenge conditions cannot be recorded.
proposed_change: Add a way to record challenge conditions beyond the boolean challengeable.

subject: security.actor
text: The security.actor attribute `objectives` references goal nodes, but no ActorObjective element type exists in the security layer, even though NeedToKnow also mentions one.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: security.actor
text: Security.actor has two redundant relationships to delegation, associated-with and references, that express the same meaning.
proposed_change: Collapse the associated-with and references edges from actor to delegation into a single relationship.

subject: security.actor
text: Security.actor has two redundant relationships to authenticationconfig, governed-by and requires, that express the same meaning.
proposed_change: Collapse the governed-by and requires edges from actor to authenticationconfig into a single relationship.

subject: security.actor
text: The trustLevel enum value 'full' conflicts with zero-trust semantics, because zero trust implies no actor is fully trusted.
proposed_change: Remove or rename the 'full' value in the trustLevel enum.

subject: security.actor
text: Security.actor has no explicit `name` attribute even though it is defined as a named principal.
proposed_change: Add an explicit `name` attribute to security.actor.

subject: security.actor
text: Modellers may confuse security.actor with individual end users, since the definition does not make clear that actors can represent populations, services or external parties.
proposed_change: Clarify the definition to say that an actor is a principal or population, not just an individual end user.

subject: security.auditconfig
text: The definition of security.auditconfig mentions retention periods and storage destinations, which overlap with RetentionPolicy.
proposed_change: Remove retention periods and storage destinations from the security.auditconfig definition.

subject: security.auditconfig
text: The security.auditconfig definition refers to 'what events' to capture but the type has no attribute to express which events are audited.
proposed_change: Add an eventTypes/events array attribute to security.auditconfig.

subject: security.auditconfig
text: The security.auditconfig.level enum value 'none' duplicates the meaning of enabled=false.
proposed_change: Remove the 'none' value from the level enum.

subject: security.auditconfig
text: security.auditconfig.sanitizeFields is typed as a string although it holds multiple fields, and is marked required although it is arguably optional.
proposed_change: Change sanitizeFields to an array of strings and make it optional.

subject: security.auditconfig
text: The source object attribute on security.auditconfig has a different meaning from the source string attribute on Evidence, causing a naming collision.
proposed_change: Rename or harmonize security.auditconfig.source to disambiguate it from Evidence's source string.

subject: security.authenticationconfig
text: security.authenticationconfig has both 'references' and 'uses' edges to security.passwordpolicy, and passwordpolicy also 'constrains' authenticationconfig, so these overlapping relationships are redundant and only one should be kept.
proposed_change: Keep a single relationship between authenticationconfig and passwordpolicy and remove the others.

subject: security.authenticationconfig
text: security.securitymodel has both 'aggregates' and 'composes' edges to security.authenticationconfig, which express the same containment meaning redundantly.
proposed_change: Keep only one of aggregates or composes from securitymodel to authenticationconfig.

subject: security.authenticationconfig
text: The provider enum on security.authenticationconfig lacks values for jwt, api-key, mtls and kerberos.
proposed_change: Add jwt, api-key, mtls and kerberos to the provider enum.

subject: security.authenticationconfig
text: The verificationLevel attribute of security.authenticationconfig uses IAL (identity assurance) but omits AAL (authenticator assurance, NIST SP 800-63B), which fits authentication better.
proposed_change: Use or add AAL levels (aal1-aal3) per SP 800-63B for the assurance level attribute.

subject: security.authenticationconfig
text: The unit of security.authenticationconfig.sessionTimeout is unspecified.
proposed_change: Specify the unit (e.g., seconds) in the description or name of sessionTimeout.

subject: security.bindingofduty
text: The NIST SP 800-53 CM-5 anchor for security.bindingofduty is weak because no NIST 800-53 control names binding of duty; STS-ml is the real source of the concept.
proposed_change: Replace the CM-5 anchor with STS-ml Binding of Duties as the primary standard reference.

subject: security.bindingofduty
text: security.bindingofduty has no attribute listing the bound operations or workflow steps, which the governs relationship to security.resourceoperation only partly covers.
proposed_change: Add an attribute listing the bound operations or steps.

subject: security.bindingofduty
text: The constrains relationship from security.bindingofduty to security.role implies role-level binding, whereas the definition of security.bindingofduty is actor-level, so the binding granularity is inconsistent.
proposed_change: Clarify the binding granularity (actor-level vs role-level) and align the definition and the constrains relationship.

subject: security.condition
text: The 'operator' attribute of security.condition fits a simple field+value predicate rather than a compound expression, so it is a poor fit for Condition.
proposed_change: Remove the operator attribute from security.condition.

subject: security.condition
text: The 'operator' attribute of security.condition duplicates the operator concept already carried by AccessCondition.
proposed_change: Remove operator from security.condition and leave comparison operators to AccessCondition.

subject: security.condition
text: The evaluationType enum of security.condition has overlapping values: static vs compile-time and dynamic vs runtime.
proposed_change: Collapse the overlapping enum values into distinct, non-synonymous phases.

subject: security.condition
text: The description of security.condition.evaluationType names three phases (build time, policy load, runtime) while the enum has four values.
proposed_change: Align the description and the enum so the number of phases matches the number of values.

subject: security.condition
text: security.condition lacks a 'language' attribute identifying the expression language (e.g. SpEL, CEL, Rego).
proposed_change: Add a 'language' attribute to security.condition for the expression language.

subject: security.condition
text: The 'triggers' relationship from security.condition to policyaction may be wrong, since the trigger should perhaps route through PolicyRule rather than directly from Condition to PolicyAction.
proposed_change: Confirm whether the relationship should be removed or rerouted through PolicyRule.

subject: security.countermeasure
text: The definition of security.countermeasure mentions tracking residual risk, but no attribute captures residual risk.
proposed_change: Add a residual risk attribute to security.countermeasure, or remove residual risk from the definition.

subject: security.countermeasure
text: The security.countermeasure.type enum follows the SP 800-53 Rev. 3 control classes (technical, operational, management), which Rev. 4/5 removed, and its 'physical' value was never one of those classes.
proposed_change: Revise the type enum to align with current SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (drop the Rev. 3 class scheme), and remove or justify 'physical'.

subject: security.countermeasure
text: security.countermeasure lacks a controlId attribute holding a control identifier such as 'SC-8'.
proposed_change: Add a controlId string attribute to security.countermeasure.

subject: security.countermeasure
text: The boolean security.countermeasure.implemented is too coarse to express implementation status.
proposed_change: Replace the boolean with a string enum of planned|partial|implemented.

subject: security.countermeasure
text: The parallel mandates and requires incoming relationships to security.countermeasure express the same meaning and are redundant.
proposed_change: Keep one of the mandates/requires incoming relationships and remove the other.

subject: security.dataclassification
text: The definition of security.dataclassification speaks of 'policies' and its attribute text speaks of a 'scheme', but each instance has a single classificationLevel so it is effectively one tier; the tier-versus-scheme semantics must be decided.
proposed_change: Decide whether an instance is a tier or a scheme and align the definition and attribute descriptions (e.g. define it as a single labelled tier and replace 'scheme' wording).

subject: security.dataclassification
text: security.dataclassification has no name or label attribute to identify the tier it represents.
proposed_change: Add a name or label attribute to security.dataclassification.

subject: security.dataclassification
text: InformationEntity.classification duplicates security.dataclassification.classificationLevel as a free string instead of referencing the DataClassification type or using its enum.
proposed_change: Make InformationEntity.classification reference security.dataclassification or reuse the classificationLevel enum.

subject: security.delegation
text: The attribute security.delegation.delegationType mixes orthogonal axes (scope: full/partial; time: temporary; condition: conditional; revocability: revocable) in a single enum, although a delegation can be partial and temporary at once.
proposed_change: Split delegationType into a scope attribute (full/partial) plus a separate boolean revocable attribute, with time and condition expressed by other attributes.

subject: security.delegation
text: security.delegation has no attribute naming the delegated scope, so partial delegations cannot record the role or permission list being delegated.
proposed_change: Add an attribute (or equivalent) that identifies the delegated scope, such as a role or permission list.

subject: security.delegation
text: The authorizes relationship from delegation to role can carry the delegated scope, but there is no corresponding edge from security.delegation to permission, so permission-level delegation cannot be expressed.
proposed_change: Add a relationship from security.delegation to security.permission (e.g. authorizes) for permission-level delegation.

subject: security.evidence
text: The strength enum on security.evidence mixes an ordinal scale (strong/moderate/weak) with a mechanism value ('cryptographic'), which overlaps the type enum, so the scales should be separated.
proposed_change: Remove 'cryptographic' from the strength enum and keep it as an ordinal scale, representing the cryptographic mechanism via the type enum or a separate attribute.

subject: security.evidence
text: The strength attribute of security.evidence cites NIST SP 800-63-3, which defines authenticator/identity assurance rather than evidence strength, so the citation is loose.
proposed_change: Replace or qualify the SP 800-63-3 citation with a reference that actually addresses evidence strength.

subject: security.evidence
text: The required string attribute 'source' on security.evidence conflicts with sibling 'source' attributes elsewhere that are source-code reference objects, so it should be renamed to 'origin'.
proposed_change: Rename the attribute 'source' to 'origin'.

subject: security.fieldaccesscontrol
text: The maskingStrategy attribute of security.fieldaccesscontrol cites NIST SC-28 (protection at rest), but masking on exposure is closer to AC-3/AC-21.
proposed_change: Re-cite maskingStrategy to NIST AC-3/AC-21 instead of SC-28.

subject: security.fieldaccesscontrol
text: security.fieldaccesscontrol has no attribute naming the permission or roles that may see the clear value; this information exists only in the requires relationship.
proposed_change: Add an attribute naming the permission or roles that can see the clear value.

subject: security.fieldaccesscontrol
text: The maskingStrategy enum of security.fieldaccesscontrol lacks the values 'omit' and 'partial'.
proposed_change: Add 'omit' and 'partial' to the maskingStrategy enum.

subject: security.fieldaccesscontrol
text: The governs and protects relationships from security.fieldaccesscontrol to security.secureresource appear redundant with each other.
proposed_change: Keep only one of the governs or protects relationships to secureresource.

subject: security.informationentity
text: The definition of security.informationentity cites NIST control IP-1, which is a Rev. 3 Appendix J control superseded by the PT family in Rev. 5, so the reference is outdated.
proposed_change: Update the definition's reference from IP-1 to the Rev. 5 PT family control.

subject: security.informationentity
text: The attribute security.informationentity.classification is a free string that duplicates the DataClassification enum and the constrained-by relationship.
proposed_change: Change classification to an enum of the classification levels or to a reference to a DataClassification element.

subject: security.informationentity
text: The attribute security.informationentity.authorizationRequirements duplicates the bidirectional governs relationships with InformationRight.
proposed_change: Remove authorizationRequirements and rely on the governs relationships with InformationRight.

subject: security.informationright
text: The definition of security.informationright cites NIST SP 800-53 AC-3(14) for ABAC, but AC-3(14) is 'Individual Access' in Rev.5 and ABAC is AC-3(13), so the citation is wrong.
proposed_change: Correct the definition to cite AC-3(13) for attribute-based access control instead of AC-3(14).

subject: security.informationright
text: The operations array attribute of security.informationright has no enum constraining its values; it should reuse the ResourceOperation enum.
proposed_change: Type the operations items with the existing ResourceOperation enum.

subject: security.informationright
text: The accesses and governs relationships from security.informationright to security.informationentity, plus the reverse governs edge from informationentity, are redundant with each other.
proposed_change: Remove the redundant edges, keeping a single relationship between informationright and informationentity.

subject: security.informationright
text: The actor and constraint string attributes of security.informationright duplicate the assigned-to and constrained-by relationships.
proposed_change: Remove the actor and constraint string attributes and rely on the assigned-to and constrained-by relationships.

subject: security.needtoknow
text: The security.needtoknow definition cites NIST AC-3(3), which is label-based Mandatory Access Control and does not describe purpose-based restriction; the standard reference should be AC-6 and PT-3.
proposed_change: Replace the AC-3(3) citation with AC-6 and PT-3 in the definition and standard reference.

subject: security.needtoknow
text: The 'resource' string attribute on security.needtoknow duplicates the 'protects' relationship to InformationEntity.
proposed_change: Remove the 'resource' string attribute and rely on the 'protects' relationship.

subject: security.needtoknow
text: The attribute name 'objective' on security.needtoknow collides with Actor.objectives.
proposed_change: Rename 'objective' to 'purpose'.

subject: security.needtoknow
text: security.needtoknow has no attribute for a set of allowed purposes.
proposed_change: Add an attribute holding a list of allowed purposes.

subject: security.passwordpolicy
text: The attribute security.passwordpolicy.expiryDays is required, although NIST SP 800-63B discourages forced periodic password rotation, so it should be optional with 0 meaning no expiry.
proposed_change: Make expiryDays optional and define 0 as meaning no expiry.

subject: security.passwordpolicy
text: The attribute security.passwordpolicy.lockoutDuration is an integer with no declared unit.
proposed_change: Declare the unit (e.g. seconds) in the attribute or rename it to include the unit.

subject: security.passwordpolicy
text: Lockout (lockoutAttempts, lockoutDuration) in security.passwordpolicy belongs to NIST control AC-7, not IA-5(1), which the type definition cites.
proposed_change: Correct the definition and standard reference so lockout is attributed to AC-7 rather than IA-5(1).

subject: security.passwordpolicy
text: security.passwordpolicy lacks an attribute for breached-password screening.
proposed_change: Consider adding an attribute for breached-password screening.

subject: security.passwordpolicy
text: The 'mandates' and 'requires' relationships from security.passwordpolicy to security.countermeasure express the same meaning and duplicate each other.
proposed_change: Remove one of the two relationships, keeping a single predicate.

subject: security.permission
text: The security.permission scope enum mixes access level values (read-only, write, admin) with grant mechanism values (delegated, conditional), mixing two different axes.
proposed_change: Restrict scope to access level values and move delegated/conditional to a separate attribute or to other types such as delegation or conditions.

subject: security.permission
text: The security.permission scope enum overlaps with the action enum, so contradictory combinations such as scope=admin with action=read are possible.
proposed_change: Remove the overlap between scope and action, or define constraints so contradictory combinations are disallowed.

subject: security.permission
text: The security.permission action enum lacks approve, share, export and import values, which ResourceOperation has.
proposed_change: Add approve, share, export and import to the action enum.

subject: security.permission
text: The security.permission resource attribute is a plain string and should be a reference to SecureResource.
proposed_change: Change resource to a reference to security.secureresource.

subject: security.permission
text: Role to Permission has three redundant relationships (aggregates, authorizes, provides) expressing the same meaning.
proposed_change: Collapse the three relationships into a single Role-to-Permission relationship.

subject: security.policyaction
text: The allow and deny values of security.policyaction.type duplicate the effect attribute of PolicyRule, so type should be restricted to obligation-style actions.
proposed_change: Remove allow and deny from the type enum so it only contains obligation-style actions.

subject: security.policyaction
text: The NIST SP 800-53 citations CA-9 and SI-3 in the security.policyaction definition are inapt; AC-3 and XACML obligations should be cited instead.
proposed_change: Replace the CA-9 and SI-3 citations with NIST AC-3 and XACML obligation expressions.

subject: security.policyaction
text: The 'mask' value of security.policyaction.type overlaps with the FieldAccessControl type.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: security.policyaction
text: The 'rate-limit' value of security.policyaction.type overlaps with api.ratelimit.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: security.policyaction
text: The 'mandates' and 'requires' relationships from PolicyAction to Countermeasure are redundant with each other.
proposed_change: Keep one of the two relationships and remove the other.

subject: security.policyaction
text: The enforces-requirement relationship to policyrule inverts the direction of the existing triggers relationship between PolicyRule and PolicyAction.
proposed_change: Remove or reverse the enforces-requirement relationship so it is consistent with the triggers relationship.

subject: security.policyrule
text: The enum of security.policyrule.effect includes 'indeterminate' and 'not-applicable', which are XACML decision results rather than rule effects; XACML Rule Effect allows only Permit or Deny.
proposed_change: Remove 'indeterminate' and 'not-applicable' from the effect enum, leaving permit and deny.

subject: security.policyrule
text: security.policyrule has no rule id or ordering attribute even though rules are said to be evaluated in order, while priority exists only on SecurityPolicy.
proposed_change: Add a rule id and an ordering/priority attribute to security.policyrule.

subject: security.policyrule
text: The 'mandates' and 'requires' relationships from PolicyRule to Countermeasure appear to express the same meaning and are redundant.
proposed_change: Consolidate 'mandates' and 'requires' into a single relationship between PolicyRule and Countermeasure.

subject: security.resourceoperation
text: The outgoing 'accesses' and 'governs' relationships from security.resourceoperation to security.secureresource, plus the incoming 'aggregates' relationship, express the same meaning and are redundant.
proposed_change: Keep only one of the accesses, governs and aggregates relationships and remove the others.

subject: security.resourceoperation
text: The operation enum on security.resourceoperation diverges from the action enum on security.permission, which lacks approve, share, export and import.
proposed_change: Align the two enums by adding approve, share, export and import to permission.action or otherwise making both value sets identical.

subject: security.resourceoperation
text: security.resourceoperation has no attribute naming its owning resource, so the link to the resource depends solely on the aggregation relationship.
proposed_change: Add an attribute identifying the owning secure resource (e.g. a resource reference).

subject: security.resourceoperation
text: The rateLimit attribute of security.resourceoperation references api.ratelimit in another layer, while the security layer intro claims rate limits live in the security layer.
proposed_change: Reconcile the layer intro and the attribute, either by moving rate limits into security or by correcting the intro to say they reside in api.

subject: security.retentionpolicy
text: security.retentionpolicy has no attribute (e.g. dataType or scope) naming the data category being retained, so the policy's subject is only expressed through relationships.
proposed_change: Add an attribute such as dataType or scope identifying the retained data category.

subject: security.retentionpolicy
text: The format of the security.retentionpolicy.period attribute is unspecified.
proposed_change: Specify a format for period, e.g. ISO 8601 duration.

subject: security.retentionpolicy
text: The deletionMethod enum value 'archive' is not a disposal method and duplicates the destination value 'archive'.
proposed_change: Remove 'archive' from the deletionMethod enum.

subject: security.retentionpolicy
text: security.retentionpolicy overlaps with data-store.retentionpolicy, needing a boundary or precedence rule.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: security.retentionpolicy
text: auditconfig both governs and is governed by retentionpolicy, forming a circular relationship.
proposed_change: Keep only one direction of the governs relationship between auditconfig and retentionpolicy.

subject: security.role
text: The attribute security.role.inheritsFrom is required, but root roles have no parent role, so it should be optional.
proposed_change: Make inheritsFrom optional.
