subject: security.role
text: The attribute security.role.inheritsFrom duplicates the role-specializes-role relationship between roles.
proposed_change: Remove the inheritsFrom attribute or the specializes relationship so role inheritance is expressed only once.

subject: security.role
text: The three outgoing relationships from security.role to security.permission (aggregates, authorizes, provides) overlap in meaning.
proposed_change: Consolidate the three role-to-permission relationships into a single relationship.

subject: security.role
text: The direction of the security.role.level attribute (whether a higher value means more privilege) is not specified.
proposed_change: Document that a higher level means more privilege (or the chosen direction) in the attribute description.

subject: security.role
text: Single inheritance via inheritsFrom excludes multi-parent role hierarchies common in Keycloak and LDAP.
proposed_change: Allow multiple parent roles, e.g. make inheritsFrom an array or use multiple specializes relationships.

subject: security.secureresource
text: security.secureresource overlaps with security.informationentity, and the spec should state that SecureResource is the system-level container while InformationEntity is the logical asset.
proposed_change: Add a boundary statement to the definitions: SecureResource is the system-level container, InformationEntity is the logical information asset.

subject: security.secureresource
text: security.permission.resource and security.accesscondition reference resources by string rather than by a relationship to security.secureresource, which should be aligned.
proposed_change: Replace the string resource references with relationships to security.secureresource, or otherwise align them.

subject: security.secureresource
text: The security.secureresource.type enum lacks values for queue/topic (perhaps folded into stream) and object-storage.
proposed_change: Add 'queue'/'topic' (or clarify they fall under stream) and 'object-storage' to the type enum.

subject: security.secureresource
text: security.secureresource has no classification attribute even though DataClassification governs it.
proposed_change: Add a classification attribute or relationship linking SecureResource to DataClassification.

subject: security.securityconstraints
text: The security.securityconstraints container lacks a scoping attribute (application/scope) to indicate which application it applies to.
proposed_change: Add a scope/application attribute to security.securityconstraints.

subject: security.securityconstraints
text: The security.securityconstraints container has no description attribute.
proposed_change: Add a description attribute to security.securityconstraints.

subject: security.securityconstraints
text: The outgoing 'enforces' and 'governs' relationships from security.securityconstraints to security.securitypolicy are redundant with each other and semantically odd for a passive container.
proposed_change: Remove the redundant 'enforces' and 'governs' relationships (or keep at most one) from securityconstraints to securitypolicy.

subject: security.securityconstraints
text: Incoming 'satisfies' relationships from apm.logprocessor, navigationflow and objectschema target the security.securityconstraints container rather than individual rules, which weakens traceability.
proposed_change: Redirect these 'satisfies' relationships to the aggregated rule types (e.g. separationofduty, bindingofduty, needtoknow) instead of the container.

subject: security.securitymodel
text: security.securitymodel has redundant relationships to authenticationconfig, which is both aggregated and composed; one semantics should be chosen.
proposed_change: Keep only one of aggregates or composes between securitymodel and authenticationconfig.

subject: security.securitymodel
text: security.securitymodel has redundant relationships to securitypolicy, which is both composed and governed; one semantics should be chosen.
proposed_change: Keep only one of composes or governs between securitymodel and securitypolicy.

subject: security.securitymodel
text: security.securitymodel has redundant relationships to threat, which is both aggregated and managed; one semantics should be chosen.
proposed_change: Keep only one of aggregates or manages between securitymodel and threat.

subject: security.securitymodel
text: The attribute security.securitymodel.accessControlModel allows only a single enum value, but real systems are often hybrid (e.g. RBAC+ABAC).
proposed_change: Change accessControlModel to an array of the enum values.

subject: security.securitymodel
text: security.securitymodel lacks a source attribute although most sibling types have one.
proposed_change: Add a source attribute to securitymodel consistent with siblings.

subject: security.securitypolicy
text: security.securitypolicy has no rule- or policy-combining algorithm attribute (e.g., deny-overrides, first-applicable), which XACML requires.
proposed_change: Add a combining-algorithm attribute (enum such as deny-overrides, permit-overrides, first-applicable) to security.securitypolicy.

subject: security.securitypolicy
text: The direction of the security.securitypolicy 'priority' attribute (whether a higher or lower value wins) is not stated normatively.
proposed_change: State normatively in the priority attribute description whether higher or lower values take precedence.

subject: security.securitypolicy
text: The security.securitypolicy 'target' attribute holds only a category enum, so the concrete target identifier is missing.
proposed_change: Add a target identifier attribute (e.g., targetRef or targetId) that names the concrete target alongside the category.

subject: security.securitypolicy
text: The 'mandates' and 'requires' relationships from SecurityPolicy to Countermeasure are duplicates that express overlapping meaning.
proposed_change: Merge the two edges into one, keeping a single predicate between SecurityPolicy and Countermeasure.

subject: security.securitypolicy
text: The AuthenticationConfig 'constrained-by' edge to SecurityPolicy and the PasswordPolicy 'governs' edge stretch SecurityPolicy beyond access decisions.
proposed_change: Remove or rework these edges, or broaden the SecurityPolicy definition, so they stay within access-decision scope.

subject: security.separationofduty
text: security.separationofduty has no attributes naming the conflicting roles or tasks; they exist only via 'constrains' relationships, so conflicting pairs cannot be expressed precisely.
proposed_change: Add conflictingRoles and conflictingTasks array attributes to security.separationofduty.

subject: security.separationofduty
text: security.separationofduty.mutuallyExclusive only captures static separation of duty, so dynamic SoD cannot be expressed.
proposed_change: Add a static/dynamic enum attribute (e.g., type or enforcementMode) to security.separationofduty.

subject: security.separationofduty
text: security.separationofduty lacks a scope attribute, unlike security.bindingofduty which has scope.
proposed_change: Add a scope attribute to security.separationofduty matching bindingofduty.scope.

subject: security.threat
text: The security.threat attributes likelihood and impact use the vocabulary low|moderate|high while criticality uses low|medium|high|critical, so the vocabularies are inconsistent.
proposed_change: Align the criticality enum with the low|moderate|high vocabulary, or derive criticality from likelihood and impact.

subject: security.threat
text: The 'threatens' relationship on security.threat duplicates the 'targets' relationships of security.threat.
proposed_change: Remove the 'threatens' relationship and keep the 'targets' relationships.

subject: security.threat
text: The security.threat attribute 'source' (a code reference) collides in name with the NIST SP 800-30 concept 'threat source' (the adversary).
proposed_change: Rename 'source' to something like 'code_reference' or 'source_ref' to avoid collision with threat source.

subject: security.threat
text: security.threat lacks an attribute for the threat source (the adversary) as defined in NIST SP 800-30.
proposed_change: Add a threat source attribute (adversary type) to security.threat.

subject: security.threat
text: security.threat lacks a threat category attribute such as STRIDE.
proposed_change: Add a threat category attribute, e.g., an enum of STRIDE categories.

subject: security.threat
text: The accesses, constrains and realizes-driver relationships of security.threat look semantically dubious.
proposed_change: Review the accesses, constrains and realizes-driver relationships and remove or rework those whose semantics do not fit.

subject: security.validationrule
text: The definition of security.validationrule mentions 'transformations', but no enum value or attribute models a transformation.
proposed_change: Remove the word 'transformations' from the definition, or add an enum value or attribute that models a transformation.

subject: security.validationrule
text: The 'length' type of security.validationrule.type allows only a maximum character count, so a minimum length cannot be expressed.
proposed_change: Allow the length type to express a minimum as well as a maximum, e.g. via a min/max range format or separate attributes.

subject: security.validationrule
text: security.validationrule has no attribute naming the target field, so the validated field is implied only by relationships.
proposed_change: Add an attribute that names the target field the rule applies to.

subject: security.validationrule
text: The boundary between security.validationrule and data-model schema constraints is undefined and needs a rule.
proposed_change: Add a rule that only security-motivated validation is modeled in security.validationrule, leaving other constraints to the data-model layer.

subject: technology.artifact
text: The artifactType enum of technology.artifact has overlapping values: 'file' subsumes 'script' and 'configuration'.
proposed_change: Make artifactType values mutually exclusive, e.g. remove or redefine 'file' relative to 'script' and 'configuration'.

subject: technology.artifact
text: The artifactType enum of technology.artifact has overlapping values: a JAR is both 'library' and 'archive'.
proposed_change: Clarify or separate the 'library' and 'archive' values so a JAR maps to exactly one.

subject: technology.artifact
text: The definition of technology.artifact names 'executable/binary' but the artifactType enum has no such value.
proposed_change: Add an 'executable' (or 'binary') value to artifactType.

subject: technology.artifact
text: technology.artifact lacks version, location/URI and checksum attributes.
proposed_change: Add version, location (URI) and checksum attributes to technology.artifact.

subject: technology.artifact
text: The relationship list of technology.artifact repeats the artifact-to-artifact relations redundantly.
proposed_change: Deduplicate the artifact-to-artifact relationships.

subject: technology.artifact
text: The attribute name 'source' on technology.artifact (a source code reference) risks confusion with artifacts that are themselves source files.
proposed_change: Rename 'source' to something clearer, such as sourceReference.

subject: technology.communicationnetwork
text: The networkType enum of technology.communicationnetwork mixes orthogonal axes: scope (lan/wan), technology (vpn/wireless) and ownership (internet/intranet).
proposed_change: Split networkType into separate scope and medium (and ownership) attributes, or otherwise separate the axes.

subject: technology.communicationnetwork
text: The networkType enum of technology.communicationnetwork has no value that fits cloud VPCs, subnets or container overlay networks.
proposed_change: Add 'virtual' and/or 'overlay' values to networkType.

subject: technology.communicationnetwork
text: technology.communicationnetwork has no attribute for the network's address space (CIDR).
proposed_change: Add an address space / CIDR attribute to communicationnetwork.

subject: technology.communicationnetwork
text: A duplicate self-aggregation relationship is listed for technology.communicationnetwork.
proposed_change: Remove the duplicate self-aggregation relationship.

subject: technology.communicationnetwork
text: The serviceType enum of technology.technologyservice lacks a 'network' value.
proposed_change: Add a 'network' value to technologyservice serviceType.

subject: technology.device
text: The node nodeType values physical-server and bare-metal overlap with the technology.device deviceType value server, so physical hosts could be modelled as either Device or Node, and the boundary must be decided.
proposed_change: Decide whether physical hosts are Devices or Nodes and add a precedence rule, e.g. remove physical-server and bare-metal from node nodeType or document the boundary.

subject: technology.device
text: technology.device has no attributes for hardware model, serial number, or location, which are common in evidence.
proposed_change: Add attributes such as model, serialNumber, and location to technology.device.

subject: technology.device
text: The deviceType enum value 'embedded' must absorb IoT sensors, which the device definition cites explicitly, but there is no dedicated value for them.
proposed_change: Add an explicit IoT sensor value to deviceType or document that 'embedded' covers IoT sensors.

subject: technology.node
text: The technology.node nodeType enum values physical-server and bare-metal are redundant with each other.
proposed_change: Merge or remove one of physical-server and bare-metal from the nodeType enum.

subject: technology.node
text: The nodeType values physical-server and bare-metal overlap with technology.device (deviceType server).
proposed_change: Remove the physical-server/bare-metal values or define a boundary rule versus device with deviceType server.

subject: technology.node
text: The nodeType value kubernetes-cluster and the 'server cluster' example in the definition of technology.node overlap with technology.technologycollaboration.
proposed_change: Add a boundary or precedence rule between node and technologycollaboration for clusters, or drop the overlapping value and example.

subject: technology.node
text: The 'container runtime' example in the technology.node definition belongs to technology.systemsoftware and should not be listed for node.
proposed_change: Remove 'container runtime' from the technology.node definition examples.

subject: technology.node
text: The technology.node nodeType enum lacks values for managed or serverless platforms (e.g. AWS Lambda, Azure App Service), so such nodes have no fitting value.
proposed_change: Add enum values for managed or serverless platforms to nodeType.

subject: technology.path
text: technology.path lacks a source attribute that every sibling technology type has, even though IaC and config files are its main evidence.
proposed_change: Add a source attribute to technology.path consistent with sibling types.

subject: technology.path
text: The technology.path pathType enum mixes topology values (point-to-point, multicast, broadcast) with directionality ('bidirectional'), which is not exclusive of 'point-to-point'.
proposed_change: Split pathType into separate topology and direction attributes.

subject: technology.path
text: The relationships 'realizes technologyservice', 'flows-to technologyservice' and 'assigned-to technologyinterface' from technology.path are not ArchiMate-valid for a structure element.
proposed_change: Review these relationships and remove or replace those that are not ArchiMate-valid.

subject: technology.systemsoftware
text: The softwareType enum of technology.systemsoftware lacks values for language runtimes (JVM, Node.js, CPython), web servers/reverse proxies (nginx) and application servers, even though the layer description lists frameworks and runtimes.
proposed_change: Add enum values such as language-runtime, web-server and application-server to softwareType.

subject: technology.systemsoftware
text: Frameworks have no home element type in the technology layer, although the layer description lists frameworks.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: technology.systemsoftware
text: The softwareType enum values cache and dbms overlap for products such as Redis, so the enum mixes categories that are not mutually exclusive.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: technology.systemsoftware
text: The serviceType values database, cache and messaging of technology.technologyservice duplicate the softwareType enum of technology.systemsoftware, blurring the boundary between software product and capability.
proposed_change: Define a clear product-versus-capability boundary and remove or differentiate the duplicated values between the two enums.

subject: technology.technologycollaboration
text: The technology.node type's enum value kubernetes-cluster overlaps with technology.technologycollaboration, and the spec needs a rule for when a cluster is a Node versus a Collaboration.
proposed_change: Add a boundary rule stating when a cluster is modelled as a Node (single addressed deployment unit) versus a TechnologyCollaboration (grouping of individually modelled cooperating members).

subject: technology.technologycollaboration
text: The relationship 'technologyinteraction realizes technologycollaboration' inverts ArchiMate, where a collaboration is assigned to an interaction.
proposed_change: Replace it with technologycollaboration assigned-to technologyinteraction.

subject: technology.technologycollaboration
text: The relationship 'communicationnetwork assigned-to technologycollaboration' is not valid ArchiMate.
proposed_change: Remove or replace this relationship with one that is valid in ArchiMate.

subject: technology.technologycollaboration
text: TechnologyCollaboration lacks a collaborationType attribute (replication|consensus|sharding|mesh) to capture the kind of collaboration.
proposed_change: Add a collaborationType enum attribute with values replication, consensus, sharding, mesh.

subject: technology.technologycollaboration
text: TechnologyCollaboration lacks a memberCount attribute to capture how many members participate.
proposed_change: Add a memberCount attribute.

subject: technology.technologyevent
text: The eventType enum of technology.technologyevent has overlapping values: 'alert' is usually a consequence of a 'threshold-breach', so the values mix different axes.
proposed_change: Separate or redefine overlapping values such as alert and threshold-breach so the enum values sit on a single axis.

subject: technology.technologyevent
text: The eventType enum of technology.technologyevent omits common cases such as recovery/resolved, scaling, startup/shutdown, and configuration-change.
proposed_change: Add enum values for recovery/resolved, scaling, startup/shutdown, and configuration-change.

subject: technology.technologyevent
text: technology.technologyevent has no attribute for the emitting source of the event.
proposed_change: Add an attribute capturing the emitting source of the event.

subject: technology.technologyevent
text: technology.technologyevent has no attribute for a schedule or condition expression that triggers the event.
proposed_change: Add an attribute for a schedule or condition expression.

subject: technology.technologyevent
text: The eventType description claims 'aligned with OpenTelemetry event semantics' without explaining what the alignment means.
proposed_change: Explain the OpenTelemetry alignment or remove the claim from the description.

subject: technology.technologyevent
text: The flows-to relationship from technology.technologyevent to artifact is semantically dubious for an instantaneous event.
proposed_change: Remove or replace the flows-to relationship from technologyevent to artifact with a more fitting predicate.

subject: technology.technologyfunction
text: technology.technologyfunction has no attribute distinguishing function categories such as replication, balancing, monitoring, or scaling.
proposed_change: Add a functionType enum attribute to technology.technologyfunction, parallel to the sibling types.

subject: technology.technologyfunction
text: The definition of technology.technologyfunction says it is performed by a node, but systemsoftware is also assigned to it, so the definition must cover both.
proposed_change: Revise the definition to state the function is performed by a node or by system software.

subject: technology.technologyfunction
text: The boundary between technology.technologyfunction and technology.technologyprocess hinges on step sequencing, which is weakly observable in configuration.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: technology.technologyfunction
text: The incoming navigation.route 'uses' relationship to technology.technologyfunction looks questionable.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: technology.technologyinteraction
text: The 'realizes' relationship from technology.technologyinteraction to technology.technologycollaboration is not valid ArchiMate because behavior does not realize active structure; a collaboration is assigned to the interaction, which 'performs' already covers.
proposed_change: Remove the 'realizes' relationship from technologyinteraction to technologycollaboration and rely on 'performs'.

subject: technology.technologyinteraction
text: The 'composes' relationship from technology.technologyinteraction to technology.technologyfunction is questionable.
proposed_change: Reconsider or remove the 'composes' relationship to technologyfunction.

subject: technology.technologyinteraction
text: The flows-to self-relationship on technology.technologyinteraction is listed twice, creating a duplicate.
proposed_change: Remove the duplicate flows-to self-relationship entry.

subject: technology.technologyinteraction
text: The definition of technology.technologyinteraction says 'nodes' only, but performers may also be system software or devices.
proposed_change: Reword the definition to say performers include nodes, devices, and system software.

subject: technology.technologyinteraction
text: technology.technologyinteraction could use an optional protocol or coordinationPattern attribute to capture how participants coordinate.
proposed_change: Add an optional protocol/coordinationPattern attribute.

subject: technology.technologyinterface
text: The protocol enum on technology.technologyinterface lacks common infrastructure wire protocols such as kafka, redis, postgres/sql and ssh.
proposed_change: Add kafka, redis, postgres/sql and ssh values to the protocol enum.

subject: technology.technologyinterface
text: technology.technologyinterface has no port or address attribute, which is the main identifier of an interface.
proposed_change: Add a port/address attribute to technologyinterface.

subject: technology.technologyinterface
text: The 'provides' relationships involving technology.technologyinterface are non-ArchiMate.
proposed_change: Remove or replace the non-ArchiMate 'provides' relationships with ArchiMate-conformant ones.

subject: technology.technologyinterface
text: The service-provides-interface and service-serves-interface relationships between technologyservice and technologyinterface are redundant with each other.
proposed_change: Keep only one of the two relationships and remove the other.

subject: technology.technologyinterface
text: The relationship 'path assigned-to interface' is non-standard in ArchiMate.
proposed_change: Remove or replace the path assigned-to technologyinterface relationship with a standard one.

subject: technology.technologyinterface
text: The boundary between technology.technologyinterface and application.applicationinterface for HTTP APIs needs an explicit rule.
proposed_change: Add an explicit precedence/boundary rule for HTTP APIs between the two types.

subject: technology.technologyprocess
text: technology.technologyprocess has no attribute capturing trigger kind (scheduled, event-driven, manual), although code reliably shows it.
proposed_change: Add a 'triggerType' attribute to technology.technologyprocess.

subject: technology.technologyprocess
text: technology.technologyprocess has no attribute for a schedule expression (e.g. cron, workflow 'on:'), although code reliably shows it.
proposed_change: Add a 'schedule' attribute to technology.technologyprocess.

subject: technology.technologyprocess
text: The boundary between technology.technologyprocess and application-layer ApplicationProcess is unclear for business batch jobs.
proposed_change: State that only infrastructure-oriented sequences (build, deploy, backup, provisioning) belong in technology.technologyprocess.

subject: technology.technologyservice
text: The serviceType enum of technology.technologyservice lacks values for networking/DNS/CDN, secrets/key-management, search and scheduling services.
proposed_change: Add enum values for networking (DNS/CDN), secrets/key-management, search and scheduling to serviceType.

subject: technology.technologyservice
text: The serviceType value 'database' overlaps with 'storage' in technology.technologyservice.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: technology.technologyservice
text: The serviceType description cites IaaS/PaaS/SaaS classification, but the enum values do not encode that service model.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: technology.technologyservice
text: Serves relationships from technology.technologyservice to business processes and stakeholders contradict the definition's clause that the service is not consumed directly by end users or business processes.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: technology.technologyservice
text: The flows-to and serves self-relationships of technology.technologyservice are listed twice, making them redundant.
proposed_change: Remove the duplicate listings of the flows-to and serves self-relationships.

subject: testing.contextvariation
text: The contextType enum on testing.contextvariation mixes test levels/kinds (smoke, regression, exploratory) with quality-attribute contexts (load, security), i.e. different axes.
proposed_change: Split or restructure contextType so test kinds and quality-attribute contexts are separate axes, or clearly separate the values.

subject: testing.contextvariation
text: The contextType enum on testing.contextvariation lacks values for performance/stress, accessibility and compatibility.
proposed_change: Add performance/stress, accessibility and compatibility values to contextType.

subject: testing.contextvariation
text: The environmentFactors attribute on testing.contextvariation duplicates the references relationship to EnvironmentFactor.
proposed_change: Remove the environmentFactors attribute and rely on the references relationship.

subject: testing.contextvariation
text: The relationship 'EnvironmentFactor composes ContextVariation' conflicts in direction with the 'ContextVariation references EnvironmentFactor' relationship.
proposed_change: Make the direction consistent, e.g. remove or reverse the composes relationship.

subject: testing.contextvariation
text: testing.contextvariation lacks a name/label attribute.
proposed_change: Add a name or label attribute.

subject: testing.contextvariation
text: testing.contextvariation has a duplicated self depends-on relationship.
proposed_change: Deduplicate the self depends-on relationship so only one remains.

subject: testing.coverageexclusion
text: The attribute testing.coverageexclusion.affectedTargetRef can hold either a testcoveragetarget ID or a coveragerequirement ID, so its name is misleading.
proposed_change: Rename affectedTargetRef to affectedRef or split it into separate target and requirement reference fields.

subject: testing.coverageexclusion
text: The incoming reference from testing.partitionvalue to testing.coverageexclusion implies partition-level exclusions, but coverageexclusion has no attribute that can express a partition-level exclusion.
proposed_change: Add an attribute (e.g. a partition value reference) to coverageexclusion to express partition-level exclusions.

subject: testing.coverageexclusion
text: testing.coverageexclusion has no expiry or review date attribute, so waivers cannot lapse.
proposed_change: Add an expiry date or review date attribute to coverageexclusion.

subject: testing.coverageexclusion
text: testing.coverageexclusion has an outgoing relationship to testing.coveragegap but no gapRef attribute records it.
proposed_change: Add a gapRef attribute to coverageexclusion that records the related coveragegap.

subject: testing.coveragegap
text: The attribute testing.coveragegap.affectedRequirements is a single string although it may hold several requirement references; it should be an array of coveragerequirement IDs, matching the references relationship.
proposed_change: Change affectedRequirements to an array of testing.coveragerequirement IDs.

subject: testing.coveragegap
text: The attribute testing.coveragegap.targetRef is optional although every coverage gap belongs to some target.
proposed_change: Make targetRef a required attribute.

subject: testing.coveragegap
text: testing.coveragegap lacks a detection timestamp attribute (detectedAt) and an owner/assignee attribute.
proposed_change: Add detectedAt and an owner/assignee attribute to testing.coveragegap.

subject: testing.coveragegap
text: The relationship 'triggers' from testing.coveragegap to testing.coveragerequirement is semantically unclear, because a gap is detected against a requirement rather than triggering one.
proposed_change: Replace or reword the 'triggers' predicate with one meaning the gap is detected against the requirement, or remove the relationship.

subject: testing.coveragerequirement
text: The composition relationship between testing.coveragerequirement and testing.testcoveragetarget exists in both directions (coveragerequirement composes testcoveragetarget and the reverse); only the target-to-requirement direction should remain.
proposed_change: Remove the coveragerequirement-composes-testcoveragetarget relationship and keep only testcoveragetarget composes coveragerequirement.

subject: testing.coveragerequirement
text: testing.coveragerequirement lacks a targetRef attribute that sibling types have.
proposed_change: Add a targetRef attribute to testing.coveragerequirement to match siblings.

subject: testing.coveragerequirement
text: The coverageCriteria enum values MC/DC and path-coverage are code-structural criteria rather than partition-based, so they conflict with the type's definition of partition-based coverage.
proposed_change: Remove MC/DC and path-coverage from the coverageCriteria enum, or reconcile the definition with them.

subject: testing.coveragerequirement
text: Line and branch coverage thresholds (such as jest coverageThreshold) have no place in testing.coveragerequirement, which lacks a minimum-threshold attribute.
proposed_change: Add a minimum-threshold attribute to testing.coveragerequirement.

subject: testing.coveragesummary
text: testing.coveragesummary holds only design-time inventory counts (totalTargets, totalRequirements, totalSketches) and no achieved-coverage metrics such as implemented, automated, percentage, open gaps or exclusions, so it cannot summarise coverage status as its definition states.
proposed_change: Add achieved-coverage attributes (implemented count, automated count, coverage percentage, open gaps, exclusions) or redefine the type as an inventory-count summary.

subject: testing.coveragesummary
text: Line or branch coverage outputs such as istanbul coverage-summary.json do not map to testing.coveragesummary.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: testing.coveragesummary
text: testing.coveragesummary.modelRef is optional even though the type is composed by a testcoveragemodel via a composes relationship, so it should be required.
proposed_change: Make modelRef required.

subject: testing.coveragesummary
text: The aggregates, references and serves relationships from testing.coveragesummary to testing.testcoveragemodel are redundant with each other and with the composes relationship.
proposed_change: Remove the redundant aggregates, references and serves edges, keeping a single relationship.

subject: testing.environmentfactor
text: The factorType enum of testing.environmentfactor lacks common categories such as timezone, browser/runtime, container/cloud region and configuration flags.
proposed_change: Add enum values 'timezone', 'browser' and 'other' to factorType.

subject: testing.environmentfactor
text: The relationship 'composes' from testing.environmentfactor to testing.inputspacepartition looks semantically doubtful for an environmental variable.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: testing.environmentfactor
text: The relationship 'flows-to' from testing.environmentfactor to testing.coveragesummary looks semantically doubtful for an environmental variable.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: testing.environmentfactor
text: The ContextVariation.environmentFactors attribute duplicates the references relationship edge between contextvariation and environmentfactor.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: testing.environmentfactor
text: It is questionable whether the value and expectedRange attributes of testing.environmentfactor should be single-valued strings.
proposed_change: Consider whether value and expectedRange should be single-valued or multi-valued.

subject: testing.inputpartitionselection
text: The attributes coverValues and excludeValues on testing.inputpartitionselection are required comma-separated strings even though each is ignored in one of the two modes; they should be optional arrays.
proposed_change: Make coverValues and excludeValues optional and change their type from comma-separated string to array of strings.

subject: testing.inputpartitionselection
text: The coverValues and excludeValues attributes of testing.inputpartitionselection duplicate the aggregates relationship from inputpartitionselection to partitionvalue.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: testing.inputpartitionselection
text: The aggregation of contextvariation by testing.inputpartitionselection is misplaced; it belongs on CoverageRequirement rather than on InputPartitionSelection.
proposed_change: Move the aggregates relationship to contextvariation from inputpartitionselection to coveragerequirement.

subject: testing.inputpartitionselection
text: testing.inputpartitionselection has three composing parent types, which makes ownership ambiguous.
proposed_change: Reduce to a single composing parent (the CoverageRequirement).

subject: testing.inputpartitionselection
text: The TestCaseSketch.inputSelections attribute points to testing.inputpartitionselection, which invites confusion with testing.inputselection.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: testing.inputselection
text: TestCaseSketch.inputSelections is described as referencing InputPartitionSelection, yet sketches actually compose InputSelection (testing.inputselection), so the description and relationship disagree.
proposed_change: Align either the TestCaseSketch.inputSelections description or the composed target type so both name the same type.

subject: testing.inputselection
text: The outgoing relationships from testing.inputselection to coveragerequirement and testcoveragetarget are redundant because the owning TestCaseSketch already implies them.
proposed_change: Remove the outgoing references from inputselection to coveragerequirement and testcoveragetarget.

subject: testing.inputselection
text: The attributes partitionRef and selectedValue on testing.inputselection could be merged into a single partitionValueRef attribute.
proposed_change: Replace partitionRef and selectedValue with a single partitionValueRef attribute.

subject: testing.inputselection
text: The coveragerequirement-accesses-inputselection relationship mixes design-level (coverage requirement) and case-level (input selection) concerns.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: testing.inputspacepartition
text: The presenceRule attribute of testing.inputspacepartition describes the input field rather than the partition and overlaps TargetInputField.relevance, using a different enum.
proposed_change: Remove presenceRule from inputspacepartition or reconcile it with TargetInputField.relevance using a single shared enum.

subject: testing.inputspacepartition
text: The 'mutually-exclusive' value of the presenceRule enum on testing.inputspacepartition needs a counterpart field reference to identify which field it excludes.
proposed_change: Add an attribute referencing the counterpart field for mutually-exclusive, or remove that enum value.

subject: testing.inputspacepartition
text: The fieldRef attribute of testing.inputspacepartition duplicates TargetInputField.fieldRef.
proposed_change: Remove the duplicate fieldRef from one of the two types or define one as derived from the other.

subject: testing.inputspacepartition
text: The relationships inputspacepartition composes partitionvalue and partitionvalue composes inputspacepartition are redundant and point in opposite directions.
proposed_change: Keep only inputspacepartition composes partitionvalue and drop the reverse relationship.

subject: testing.inputspacepartition
text: The relationship environmentfactor composes inputspacepartition appears erroneous.
proposed_change: Remove this relationship or replace it with a more appropriate one.

subject: testing.outcomecategory
text: The outcomeType enum of testing.outcomecategory does not distinguish authentication failure (401) from authorization failure (403).
proposed_change: Add an authentication-error value alongside authorization-error.

subject: testing.outcomecategory
text: The outcomeType enum of testing.outcomecategory lacks values for conflict, rate-limited and side-effect outcomes (event emitted, state change).
proposed_change: Add conflict, rate-limited, and side-effect (event-emitted, state-change) values to the enum.

subject: testing.outcomecategory
text: The outcomeType enum values 'exception' and 'server-error' overlap in meaning.
proposed_change: Merge or clearly delineate 'exception' and 'server-error'.

subject: testing.outcomecategory
text: testing.outcomecategory has no targetRef attribute although its definition says each category is bound to one target.
proposed_change: Add a targetRef attribute referencing the testcoveragetarget.

subject: testing.outcomecategory
text: Both the testcoveragemodel and the testcoveragetarget compose testing.outcomecategory, giving it two composing parents, although the definition binds it to one target.
proposed_change: Keep a single composing parent (the target) or clarify the dual composition.

subject: testing.outcomecategory
text: The 'outcomecategory aggregates testcasesketch' relationship duplicates 'testcasesketch depends-on outcomecategory' in the opposite direction.
proposed_change: Remove one of the two relationships, keeping a single direction.

subject: testing.partitiondependency
text: testing.partitiondependency has no attribute identifying the dependent (affected) InputSpacePartition or field, so the target of the dependency is not captured; an affectedPartitionRef should be added.
proposed_change: Add an affectedPartitionRef attribute referencing the dependent InputSpacePartition.

subject: testing.partitiondependency
text: testing.partitiondependency.affectedValues is a bare comma-separated string of labels, which is ambiguous when labels repeat across partitions.
proposed_change: Qualify affected values by partition via affectedPartitionRef (and/or use IDs rather than bare labels).

subject: testing.partitiondependency
text: The effect enum value 'modifies-range' on testing.partitiondependency.effect is undefined and overlaps with 'restricts-to'.
proposed_change: Define 'modifies-range' clearly and distinguish it from 'restricts-to', or remove one of them.

subject: testing.partitiondependency
text: The 'triggers' relationship from testing.partitiondependency to testing.coveragerequirement has unclear semantics and direction.
proposed_change: Clarify the semantics and direction of the triggers edge, or remove it.

subject: testing.partitiondependency
text: The 'constrained-by' relationship from testing.partitiondependency to testing.inputpartitionselection has unclear semantics and direction.
proposed_change: Clarify the semantics and direction of the constrained-by edge, or remove it.

subject: testing.partitiondependency
text: The dependsOnValue attribute of testing.partitiondependency duplicates the triggers edge to testing.partitionvalue.
proposed_change: Remove either the dependsOnValue attribute or the triggers→partitionvalue edge so the trigger value is expressed once.

subject: testing.partitionvalue
text: The definition of testing.partitionvalue calls the constraint expression optional, yet both constraint and constraintExpression are required attributes, so the definition contradicts the attributes.
proposed_change: Align the definition and the attributes, either by making constraintExpression optional or by removing the word 'optional' from the definition.

subject: testing.partitionvalue
text: testing.partitionvalue has no explicit partitionRef attribute, so its ownership by an InputSpacePartition relies only on the composes relationship.
proposed_change: Add an explicit partitionRef attribute pointing to the owning InputSpacePartition.

subject: testing.partitionvalue
text: The category enum of testing.partitionvalue mixes validity classes (valid, invalid, boundary-valid, boundary-invalid) with value shapes (null-empty, special-character).
proposed_change: Separate validity class and value shape into distinct axes, e.g. a validity enum plus a separate value-shape attribute.

subject: testing.partitionvalue
text: The triggers relationship between testing.partitionvalue and testing.coveragegap runs in both directions, making it redundant or inconsistent in direction.
proposed_change: Keep the triggers relationship in only one direction and remove the reverse one.

subject: testing.partitionvalue
text: The depends-on relationship from testing.partitionvalue to testing.environmentfactor is doubtful as to whether it fits.
proposed_change: Reconsider and likely remove or replace the depends-on relationship to environmentfactor.

subject: testing.targetcoveragesummary
text: testing.targetcoveragesummary lacks a generatedAt/timestamp attribute that CoverageSummary has, so staleness of the summary cannot be judged.
proposed_change: Add a generatedAt timestamp attribute to testing.targetcoveragesummary.

subject: testing.targetcoveragesummary
text: testing.targetcoveragesummary lacks a modelRef attribute that CoverageSummary has, so staleness cannot be judged against the model version.
proposed_change: Add a modelRef attribute to testing.targetcoveragesummary.

subject: testing.targetcoveragesummary
text: The attribute coveragePercentage measures coverage of requirements rather than code lines, so its name could be confused with line/branch coverage tool metrics.
proposed_change: Rename coveragePercentage to requirementCoveragePercentage.

subject: testing.targetcoveragesummary
text: testing.targetcoveragesummary has no gapCount or exclusionCount attributes; references to CoverageGap and CoverageExclusion exist only as relationships.
proposed_change: Add gapCount and exclusionCount attributes to testing.targetcoveragesummary.

subject: testing.targetcoveragesummary
text: The 'validates' relationship verb on testing.targetcoveragesummary is questionable for a report-type element.
proposed_change: Replace the 'validates' predicate with one that fits a report, such as 'summarizes' or 'reports-on'.

subject: testing.targetinputfield
text: The testing.targetinputfield attribute relevance duplicates InputSpacePartition.presenceRule but uses a different enum that lacks the values forbidden and mutually-exclusive.
proposed_change: Remove the duplication by aligning the relevance enum with presenceRule (adding forbidden and mutually-exclusive) or keeping the concept in only one of the two types.

subject: testing.targetinputfield
text: fieldRef is also present on testing.inputspacepartition, which ties that partition to one field and makes it non-reusable across fields.
proposed_change: Remove fieldRef from InputSpacePartition so the field binding lives only in TargetInputField and partitions stay reusable.

subject: testing.targetinputfield
text: The description of testing.targetinputfield.fieldRef mentions only API and Data Model layer fields and omits UX fields, although a maps-to relationship to ux.actioncomponent exists.
proposed_change: Extend the fieldRef description to include UX layer input fields such as ux.actioncomponent.

subject: testing.targetinputfield
text: The aggregates relationship from testing.targetinputfield to testing.partitionvalue is redundant with the partitionRef attribute.
proposed_change: Remove the aggregates relationship to partitionvalue and rely on partitionRef.

subject: testing.targetinputfield
text: testing.targetinputfield has no targetRef attribute, so the link to the owning TestCoverageTarget is carried only by composition.
proposed_change: Add a targetRef attribute referencing the testing.testcoveragetarget.

subject: testing.testcasesketch
text: The testing.testcasesketch inputSelections attribute is described as referencing InputPartitionSelection, which belongs to CoverageRequirement, whereas the per-case bindings this type composes are InputSelection.
proposed_change: Retarget the inputSelections description to reference InputSelection nodes instead of InputPartitionSelection.

subject: testing.testcasesketch
text: The testing.testcasesketch status enum values implemented and automated overlap with the implementationFormat attribute and contradict the definition's statement that the sketch is not yet tied to a runner.
proposed_change: Remove implemented and automated from the status enum, or otherwise separate lifecycle status from implementation concerns.

subject: testing.testcasesketch
text: testing.testcasesketch has no coverageRequirementRef or expectedOutcome attributes, so the links to the coverage requirement and expected outcome exist only as relationships.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: testing.testcoveragemodel
text: testing.testcoveragemodel has both an aggregates and a composes relationship to testing.testcoveragetarget, which is redundant; only one should be kept.
proposed_change: Keep only one of aggregates or composes between testcoveragemodel and testcoveragetarget and remove the other.

subject: testing.testcoveragemodel
text: The relationship 'coveragesummary aggregates testcoveragemodel' inverts the direction of the model-to-target composition, since the model should be the aggregating side.
proposed_change: Reverse or replace the coveragesummary aggregates testcoveragemodel relationship so it does not invert the composition direction.

subject: testing.testcoveragemodel
text: The three relationship edges from coveragesummary to testcoveragemodel are redundant with each other.
proposed_change: Collapse the three coveragesummary-to-testcoveragemodel edges into a single relationship.

subject: testing.testcoveragemodel
text: The single required 'application' attribute on testing.testcoveragemodel conflicts with 'covers' edges that reach into many layers, since it only references one application or API element.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: testing.testcoveragemodel
text: testing.testcoveragemodel lacks a testLevel attribute (unit, integration, system, acceptance) to align with IEEE 829 level test plans.
proposed_change: Add a testLevel attribute with enum values unit, integration, system, acceptance.

subject: testing.testcoveragemodel
text: testing.testcoveragemodel lacks a status attribute to align with IEEE 829 level test plans.
proposed_change: Add a status attribute to testcoveragemodel.

subject: testing.testcoveragetarget
text: The targetType enum of testing.testcoveragetarget lacks values for library/domain function, data-model schema, stored logic and CLI command, even though relationships cover data-model.objectschema and data-store.storedlogic.
proposed_change: Add enum values for library/domain function, data-model schema, stored logic and CLI command to targetType.

subject: testing.testcoveragetarget
text: Composition between testing.testcoveragetarget and coveragerequirement is defined in both directions, forming a cycle.
proposed_change: Keep composition in only one direction between testcoveragetarget and coveragerequirement.

subject: testing.testcoveragetarget
text: Inputpartitionselection is composed by testcoveragetarget in the relationships, but its definition places it under CoverageRequirement.
proposed_change: Align the composition relationship and the inputpartitionselection definition so the same parent owns it.

subject: testing.testcoveragetarget
text: The 'source' attribute of testing.testcoveragetarget is typed as an object but has no schema defining its structure.
proposed_change: Define a schema for the source object (or use a typed reference).

subject: ux.actioncomponent
text: The validations attribute of ux.actioncomponent fits poorly because HTML Constraint Validation applies to form-associated input controls, not buttons or links, and the ux layer has no input-field type to hold it.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: ux.actioncomponent
text: The style enum values 'link' and 'icon' on ux.actioncomponent duplicate the type enum values 'link' and 'icon-button'.
proposed_change: Remove 'link' and 'icon' from the style enum, leaving visual variants only.

subject: ux.actioncomponent
text: The 'menu' value of ux.actioncomponent.type is a container of actions and arguably needs child items, which the type cannot express.
proposed_change: Add a way to hold child action items for menu components.

subject: ux.actioncomponent
text: The renders relationship from ux.actioncomponent to ux.librarycomponent blurs the boundary between type (library definition) and instance (concrete control).
proposed_change: none stated

subject: ux.actionpattern
text: ux.actionpattern.feedback is single-valued, but the canonical example (modal then toast) requires an ordered list of feedback mechanisms.
proposed_change: Change feedback to an ordered array of feedback enum values.

subject: ux.actionpattern
text: The ux.actionpattern.trigger enum (click|swipe|voice|keyboard) diverges from the trigger values used by StateTransition (e.g. 'voice' vs 'voice-command').
proposed_change: Align the trigger enum values with those of StateTransition.trigger (e.g. use a shared vocabulary for voice).

subject: ux.actionpattern
text: ux.actionpattern.targetRef conflicts with the pattern's reusability, since a reusable pattern should not point at a single instance.
proposed_change: Remove targetRef from ActionPattern or move the instance reference to the applying element.

subject: ux.actionpattern
text: The relationships ux.actionpattern governs ux.stateaction and ux.stateaction uses ux.actionpattern are redundant, expressing the same meaning in opposite directions.
proposed_change: Keep only one direction of the relationship and remove the other.

subject: ux.chartseries
text: The ux.chartseries description mentions 'legend properties' and 'data source', but no legend attributes exist beyond label, and the data source is supplied by the dataconfig relationship rather than by the type itself.
proposed_change: Reword the definition to drop 'legend properties' and 'data source' claims, or add legend attributes.

subject: ux.chartseries
text: The ux.chartseries.lineStyle attribute cites the CSS Border specification, which is misleading because line styles are SVG/canvas stroke styles.
proposed_change: Replace the CSS Border reference with SVG/canvas stroke style semantics in the lineStyle description.

subject: ux.chartseries
text: The ux.chartseries.type enum includes 'pie', 'donut' and 'heatmap', which are usually chart-level types rather than series-level ones.
proposed_change: Reconsider or remove pie, donut and heatmap from the series type enum, or document them as chart-level; keep a per-series type for mixed-type charts.

subject: ux.chartseries
text: ux.chartseries has no attribute for axis assignment or stacking.
proposed_change: Add attributes for axis assignment (e.g., yAxis) and stacking (e.g., stack group).

subject: ux.componentinstance
text: ux.componentinstance has two relationships, implements and realizes, that both point to ux.librarycomponent and express the same meaning.
proposed_change: Keep only one of implements or realizes between componentinstance and librarycomponent.

subject: ux.componentinstance
text: The renders relationship from ux.componentinstance to ux.librarycomponent duplicates the information carried by the ref attribute.
proposed_change: Keep only one of the renders relationship or the ref attribute.

subject: ux.componentinstance
text: The ref attribute of ux.componentinstance is optional although the type's definition depends on it, so it should be required.
proposed_change: Make ref a required attribute.

subject: ux.componentinstance
text: ux.componentinstance has no slot or variant attribute, unlike ComponentReference.
proposed_change: Consider adding slot and variant attributes to componentinstance.

subject: ux.componentinstance
text: Buttons that are library components blur the boundary between ux.componentinstance and ux.actioncomponent.
proposed_change: Define a boundary or precedence rule for button-like library components versus ActionComponent.

subject: ux.componentinstance
text: ux.componentinstance lacks a name or label attribute, so instances of the same component cannot be told apart.
proposed_change: Add a name/label attribute to componentinstance.

subject: ux.componentreference
text: The 'implements' relationship from ux.componentreference to ux.librarycomponent is semantically odd for a slot pointer; 'references' fits better.
proposed_change: Replace the 'implements' relationship to ux.librarycomponent with a 'references' relationship.

subject: ux.componentreference
text: The self-referential 'renders' relationship on ux.componentreference is listed twice, once as outgoing and once as incoming.
proposed_change: Keep a single listing of the self-referential 'renders' relationship.

subject: ux.componentreference
text: The ux.componentreference.variant attribute must match a variant on the referenced component, but ux.librarycomponent declares no variants attribute, so the constraint cannot be verified.
proposed_change: Add a variants attribute to ux.librarycomponent, or drop or relax the variant-matching constraint.

subject: ux.componentreference
text: ux.componentreference has no props override attribute, and it is not stated whether props are permitted.
proposed_change: Add a props override attribute, or state explicitly that props are not permitted.

subject: ux.dataconfig
text: The ux.dataconfig definition mentions transformation pipelines and update triggers, but the type has no attributes for transform, refresh or polling interval, or cache policy and invalidation.
proposed_change: Add attributes for transform, refresh/polling interval, and cache policy/invalidation, or remove transformation pipelines and update triggers from the definition.

subject: ux.dataconfig
text: The ux.dataconfig.target attribute is described as the destination receiving bound data, but its examples (an API endpoint, a data-model entity) are data sources, and binds-to relationships already identify the receiving component.
proposed_change: Redefine or rename target to reflect that it references the data source, or remove it in favor of binds-to relationships.

subject: ux.dataconfig
text: The 'realizes' relationship from ux.dataconfig to ux.statepattern is doubtful.
proposed_change: Reconsider and likely remove or replace the realizes relationship to ux.statepattern.

subject: ux.errorconfig
text: The ux.errorconfig description promises retry behavior, fallback content and user guidance, but the type has no attributes that model retry, fallback content or user guidance.
proposed_change: Add attributes for retry behavior, fallback content and user guidance, or narrow the description to what is modelled.

subject: ux.errorconfig
text: The enum ux.errorconfig.notificationType includes the value 'success', which does not fit an error configuration.
proposed_change: Remove 'success' from the notificationType enum.

subject: ux.errorconfig
text: ux.errorconfig has no attribute mapping error codes or api.response statuses to messages, even though a maps-to relationship exists.
proposed_change: Add an attribute or structure mapping error codes or response statuses to messages.

subject: ux.errorconfig
text: The spec does not state the difference between ux.errorconfig errorMessage and defaultErrorMessage.
proposed_change: Document in the spec how errorMessage differs from defaultErrorMessage (e.g. specific vs. fallback).

subject: ux.experiencestate
text: The ux.experiencestate attribute 'channel' duplicates UXSpec.experience but uses a different enum (web/mobile/voice/chat/sms vs visual), creating an inconsistent overlapping concept.
proposed_change: Remove channel or align its enum and semantics with UXSpec.experience.

subject: ux.experiencestate
text: ux.experiencestate has no attribute to mark a final/terminal state, as SCXML final states require.
proposed_change: Add a boolean 'final' attribute to ux.experiencestate.

subject: ux.experiencestate
text: ux.experiencestate has no parent-state attribute to express hierarchical statecharts (nested states).
proposed_change: Add a parent state reference attribute (e.g. parentState) to ux.experiencestate.

subject: ux.experiencestate
text: ux.experiencestate has three outgoing relationships to ux.view (associated-with, governs, renders) that overlap in meaning.
proposed_change: Keep only one of associated-with, governs or renders from experiencestate to view and remove the others.

subject: ux.experiencestate
text: The 'specializes' relationship from ux.experiencestate to ux.statepattern is semantically wrong because a state is a member of a pattern, not a subtype of it.
proposed_change: Remove the specializes relationship, or replace it with a membership/composition relationship (statepattern composes experiencestate).

subject: ux.experiencestate
text: The 'uses' relationship from ux.chartseries to ux.experiencestate appears spurious.
proposed_change: Remove the chartseries uses experiencestate relationship.

subject: ux.layoutconfig
text: The ux.layoutconfig definition promises responsive breakpoints, but the type has no breakpoint attribute.
proposed_change: Add a breakpoint attribute (or breakpoints collection) to ux.layoutconfig, or remove responsive breakpoints from the definition.

subject: ux.layoutconfig
text: The ux.layoutconfig.justifyItems enum uses flex-start/flex-end, but CSS Grid justify-items uses start/end.
proposed_change: Replace flex-start/flex-end with start/end in the justifyItems enum.

subject: ux.layoutconfig
text: The ux.layoutconfig.type enum includes 'absolute' and 'sticky', which are position values rather than display/layout modes.
proposed_change: Remove absolute and sticky from the type enum.

subject: ux.layoutconfig
text: The ux.layoutconfig.style enum contains 'grid', which duplicates the 'grid' value in the type enum.
proposed_change: Remove 'grid' from the style enum.

subject: ux.layoutconfig
text: The ux.layoutconfig.labelPosition attribute is form-specific and does not belong to a general layout configuration.
proposed_change: Move labelPosition to a form-specific type or remove it from ux.layoutconfig.

subject: ux.layoutconfig
text: The ux.view.layout string attribute overlaps with ux.layoutconfig, as both describe layout.
proposed_change: Clarify the boundary, e.g. replace ux.view.layout with a reference to ux.layoutconfig.

subject: ux.layoutconfig
text: The self-referencing 'composes' relationship on ux.layoutconfig is listed twice.
proposed_change: Remove the duplicate composes relationship.

subject: ux.librarycomponent
text: The ux.librarycomponent type enum lacks an 'action' or 'button' category, so button-like library components are classified ambiguously against ActionComponent.
proposed_change: Add an 'action' (or 'button') value to the ux.librarycomponent type enum.

subject: ux.librarycomponent
text: The renders and composes self-relationships on ux.librarycomponent overlap in meaning.
proposed_change: Consolidate renders and composes into a single self-relationship or define a clear distinction.

subject: ux.librarycomponent
text: The implements and realizes relationships from ux.componentinstance to ux.librarycomponent overlap in meaning.
proposed_change: Keep only one of implements or realizes between ComponentInstance and LibraryComponent.

subject: ux.librarycomponent
text: ux.librarycomponent lacks a 'variants' attribute, which ComponentReference.variant depends on.
proposed_change: Add a 'variants' attribute to ux.librarycomponent.

subject: ux.librarycomponent
text: ux.librarycomponent lacks a 'version' attribute.
proposed_change: Add a 'version' attribute to ux.librarycomponent.

subject: ux.librarysubview
text: The relationships 'aggregates' and 'composes' from ux.librarysubview to ux.componentinstance express the same meaning and are redundant.
proposed_change: Keep only one of 'aggregates' or 'composes' between librarysubview and componentinstance.

subject: ux.librarysubview
text: The relationships 'subview realizes librarysubview' and 'subview uses librarysubview' are redundant with each other.
proposed_change: Keep only one of 'realizes' or 'uses' between subview and librarysubview.

subject: ux.librarysubview
text: The relationships 'uxlibrary aggregates librarysubview' and 'uxlibrary provides librarysubview' are redundant with each other.
proposed_change: Keep only one of 'aggregates' or 'provides' between uxlibrary and librarysubview.

subject: ux.librarysubview
text: ux.librarysubview lacks layout, dataConfig and slot/parameter attributes, so consumers cannot override instance props when embedding it.
proposed_change: Add layout, dataConfig and slot/parameter attributes to librarysubview to allow instance prop overrides when embedding.

subject: ux.librarysubview
text: The category attribute of ux.librarysubview is free-text string whereas sibling categories are enums.
proposed_change: Change category to an enum consistent with sibling types' categories.

subject: ux.stateaction
text: The ux.stateaction 'action' enum lacks scroll and focus values, although the type's own examples (scroll-to-top, focus-first-field) require them.
proposed_change: Add 'scroll' and 'focus' to the action enum.

subject: ux.stateaction
text: The ux.stateaction timing value 'conditional' refers to a guard condition, but the type has no guard attribute to express it.
proposed_change: Add a guard (condition) attribute to ux.stateaction, or remove the 'conditional' timing value.

subject: ux.stateaction
text: The definition of timing 'immediate' as running synchronously before the state activates is meaningless for the on-exit lifecycle hook.
proposed_change: Redefine 'immediate' so it is meaningful for all lifecycle hooks, e.g. synchronous execution at the hook point rather than before the state activates.

subject: ux.stateaction
text: HTML 5.3 has no equivalent for ux.stateaction; the closest standard concept is UML 2.5 state entry/exit/effect behaviors.
proposed_change: Reference UML 2.5 state entry/exit/effect behaviors as the standards alignment instead of HTML 5.3.

subject: ux.stateactiontemplate
text: The action enum on ux.stateactiontemplate lacks values for the scroll-to-top and focus-first-field examples, so scroll and focus should be added.
proposed_change: Add 'scroll' and 'focus' values to the action enum.

subject: ux.stateactiontemplate
text: The relationships 'implements' and 'provides' to stateaction plus the incoming 'specializes' relationship on ux.stateactiontemplate are redundant with one another.
proposed_change: Consolidate the implements, provides and specializes relationships into a single relationship.

subject: ux.stateactiontemplate
text: The 'implements' relationship from ux.stateactiontemplate to stateaction points the wrong way.
proposed_change: Reverse the implements relationship or remove it in favor of a correctly directed one.

subject: ux.stateactiontemplate
text: The definition of ux.stateactiontemplate says 'state transitions' but on-enter/on-exit hooks also apply, so the definition is too narrow.
proposed_change: Broaden the definition to cover lifecycle hooks such as on-enter and on-exit as well as transitions.

subject: ux.stateactiontemplate
text: The item schema of the parameters array on ux.stateactiontemplate is unspecified.
proposed_change: Define an explicit item schema for parameters (name, type, optional default).

subject: ux.statepattern
text: The ux.statepattern type is modeled on HTML 5.3, which has no state-machine concept; W3C SCXML would be a better reference standard.
proposed_change: Replace the HTML 5.3 reference with W3C SCXML as the standard reference for StatePattern.

subject: ux.statepattern
text: The initial state of a StatePattern is marked twice, by the ordering of the 'states' array and by ExperienceState.initial, so the two markers can conflict.
proposed_change: Use a single mechanism to mark the initial state, either states ordering or ExperienceState.initial, and remove or derive the other.

subject: ux.statepattern
text: ux.statepattern has no 'parameters' attribute, although patterns such as tab-panel need N parameterized states.
proposed_change: Add a 'parameters' attribute to StatePattern to support parameterized patterns like tab-panel.

subject: ux.statepattern
text: The 'form' and 'multi-step' values of the ux.statepattern category enum overlap in meaning.
proposed_change: Merge or clearly differentiate the 'form' and 'multi-step' category values.

subject: ux.statepattern
text: The relationship ExperienceState specializes StatePattern is semantically odd because a state is not a specialization of a pattern.
proposed_change: Replace or remove the specializes relationship from ExperienceState to StatePattern, e.g. with a composition/membership relationship.

subject: ux.statepattern
text: The self-specializes relationship on StatePattern is listed twice, making it redundant.
proposed_change: Remove the duplicate self-specializes relationship entry.

subject: ux.statetransition
text: The ux.statetransition trigger enum lacks a keyboard value, although ActionPattern's trigger enum has one.
proposed_change: Add a keyboard value to the trigger enum.

subject: ux.statetransition
text: The ux.statetransition trigger enum lacks timeout and data events (API success or failure), and 'load' is only a weak proxy for them.
proposed_change: Add timeout and data-event values (e.g. api-success, api-failure) to the trigger enum.

subject: ux.statetransition
text: The 'to' attribute of ux.statetransition is optional even though every transition edge needs a destination.
proposed_change: Make 'to' required.

subject: ux.statetransition
text: The 'to' attribute of ux.statetransition duplicates the navigates-to relationship.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: ux.statetransition
text: TransitionTemplate's required to and trigger attributes blur its motion-only role relative to StateTransition.
proposed_change: Make TransitionTemplate's to and trigger non-required, keeping it motion-only.

subject: ux.statetransition
text: The Navigation-layer NavigationTransition type overlaps ux.statetransition for route changes.
proposed_change: Define a boundary or precedence rule between StateTransition and NavigationTransition for route changes.

subject: ux.subview
text: ux.subview in inline mode lacks a 'components' attribute (which ux.librarysubview has), so inline composition can only be expressed via relationships.
proposed_change: Add a 'components' attribute to ux.subview for inline composition.

subject: ux.subview
text: ux.subview has duplicate relationships to componentinstance: aggregates and renders express the same meaning.
proposed_change: Keep one of aggregates/renders to componentinstance and remove the other.

subject: ux.subview
text: ux.subview has redundant relationships to librarysubview: ref, realizes and uses express the same meaning.
proposed_change: Keep a single relationship (or the ref attribute) to librarysubview and remove the others.

subject: ux.subview
text: The relationships view aggregates subview and view composes subview are redundant.
proposed_change: Keep one of aggregates/composes between view and subview and remove the other.

subject: ux.subview
text: The relationship ux.subview accesses data-store.collection bypasses the application layer and looks misplaced.
proposed_change: Remove it or route data access through the application layer.

subject: ux.subview
text: The relationship ux.subview realizes business.businessprocess bypasses the application layer and looks misplaced.
proposed_change: Remove it or route through the application layer.

subject: ux.tablecolumn
text: ux.tablecolumn lacks boolean attributes such as sortable, filterable, resizable and hidden to describe column behavior.
proposed_change: Add boolean attributes sortable, filterable, resizable and hidden to ux.tablecolumn.

subject: ux.tablecolumn
text: The defaultSortDirection value 'none' of ux.tablecolumn conflates a column that is not sortable with one that is sortable but currently unsorted.
proposed_change: Separate sortability into a distinct sortable boolean and clarify or remove the 'none' value of defaultSortDirection.

subject: ux.tablecolumn
text: The filterType enum of ux.tablecolumn mixes filter operators (equals, range) with widget kinds (multiselect, boolean) on different axes.
proposed_change: Split filterType into separate operator and widget-kind axes, or restrict it to a single axis.

subject: ux.tablecolumn
text: The filterType description of ux.tablecolumn cites 'HTML 5.3 form input filter patterns', which is not a real standard clause.
proposed_change: Remove or replace the fictitious HTML 5.3 citation with a valid reference.

subject: ux.tablecolumn
text: The renders relationship from ux.tablecolumn to ux.componentinstance overlaps with the displayType attribute for custom cell renderers, and precedence between them is unclear.
proposed_change: Document a precedence rule between the renders relationship and displayType for custom cell renderers.

subject: ux.transitiontemplate
text: The required attribute 'to' on ux.transitiontemplate contradicts the type's reusability, because a template bound to one destination duplicates StateTransition.to.
proposed_change: Make 'to' optional, or redefine it as a lifecycle target.

subject: ux.transitiontemplate
text: The attribute 'trigger' on ux.transitiontemplate is free-text string while StateTransition.trigger is an enum, so the two are inconsistent.
proposed_change: Align TransitionTemplate.trigger with StateTransition.trigger, e.g. use the same enum.

subject: ux.transitiontemplate
text: ux.transitiontemplate lacks attributes for delay, direction and iteration of the animation.
proposed_change: Add delay, direction and iteration attributes.

subject: ux.transitiontemplate
text: The name 'TransitionTemplate' is easily confused with StateTransition, and 'MotionTemplate' would be clearer.
proposed_change: Rename TransitionTemplate to MotionTemplate.

subject: ux.uxapplication
text: The ux.uxapplication channel enum (web|mobile|voice|chat|sms) differs from the UXSpec.experience enum (visual|voice|chat|sms), and the overlap between 'web'/'mobile' and 'visual' is undocumented.
proposed_change: Document the mapping between channel values web/mobile and UXSpec experience value visual, or align the two enums.

subject: ux.uxapplication
text: The ux.uxapplication 'experiences' attribute duplicates the aggregates relationship from UXApplication to UXSpec.
proposed_change: Remove the 'experiences' attribute and rely on the aggregates relationship to UXSpec.

subject: ux.uxapplication
text: The ux.uxapplication designSystem attribute accepts either a free identifier or a ux.uxlibrary specNodeId, so it should be expressed as a reference relationship instead of a string attribute.
proposed_change: Replace designSystem with a reference relationship to ux.uxlibrary.

subject: ux.uxapplication
text: ux.uxapplication lacks a name/identifier attribute.
proposed_change: Add a name or identifier attribute.

subject: ux.uxapplication
text: ux.uxapplication lacks an entry-point or source reference attribute like View.source.
proposed_change: Add a source/entry-point reference attribute analogous to View.source.

subject: ux.uxlibrary
text: The relationships 'aggregates' and 'provides' from ux.uxlibrary are duplicated toward the same targets and express overlapping semantics, so one semantics should be chosen.
proposed_change: Keep only one of aggregates or provides for ux.uxlibrary toward its targets and remove the other.

subject: ux.uxlibrary
text: The relationship uses→uxlibrary appears twice in the catalog for ux.uxlibrary, creating a duplicate relationship.
proposed_change: Remove the duplicate uses→uxlibrary relationship entry.

subject: ux.uxlibrary
text: ux.uxlibrary has no relationships to ux.statepattern or ux.actionpattern even though it has statePatterns and actionPatterns array attributes referencing them.
proposed_change: Add relationships from ux.uxlibrary to ux.statepattern and ux.actionpattern.

subject: ux.uxlibrary
text: ux.uxapplication.designSystem references a ux.uxlibrary via a string but no relationship exists between uxapplication and uxlibrary for it.
proposed_change: Add a relationship from ux.uxapplication to ux.uxlibrary representing the design system reference.

subject: ux.uxlibrary
text: ux.uxlibrary lacks an attribute to express library-to-library dependencies.
proposed_change: Add a dependencies attribute to ux.uxlibrary listing other libraries it uses.

subject: ux.uxspec
text: The experience enum on ux.uxspec (visual|voice|chat|sms) does not align with the channel enum (web|mobile|voice|chat|sms) used by UXApplication, ActionComponent and ExperienceState; 'visual' conflates web and mobile.
proposed_change: Align the experience enum with the channel enum by replacing 'visual' with separate 'web' and 'mobile' values (or reuse the shared channel enum).

subject: ux.uxspec
text: The granularity of a ux.uxspec is undefined; the word 'complete' in its definition should be replaced by an explicit rule such as one spec per journey or feature.
proposed_change: Replace 'complete' in the definition with a granularity rule (one UXSpec per journey or feature).

subject: ux.uxspec
text: The governs relationship from ux.uxspec to ux.errorconfig has no matching attribute on ux.uxspec.
proposed_change: Add an attribute on ux.uxspec referencing errorconfig, or remove the governs relationship.

subject: ux.view
text: The ux.view definition says 'routable' but the routable boolean attribute allows false, so the definition contradicts the attribute; it should clarify that non-routable modals are still views.
proposed_change: Clarify in the definition that non-routable views such as modals are still views.

subject: ux.view
text: The phrase 'a complete user experience' in the ux.view definition collides with the concept of ux.uxspec.
proposed_change: Remove or reword 'a complete user experience' in the ux.view definition and add a boundary against ux.uxspec.

subject: ux.view
text: The free-text ux.view.layout attribute duplicates the applies/uses relationships from ux.view to ux.layoutconfig.
proposed_change: Remove the layout attribute and rely on the relationships to ux.layoutconfig.

subject: ux.view
text: The aggregates and composes relationships from ux.view to ux.subview express the same meaning and are redundant.
proposed_change: Keep one of aggregates or composes and drop the other.

subject: ux.view
text: The ux.view.source object attribute has no schema; it needs defined properties (path, symbol, repository).
proposed_change: Define a schema for source with path, symbol and repository properties.

subject: api.callback
text: The relationship api.callback uses api.server is questionable because a callback's target URL comes from the runtime expression rather than a declared server.
proposed_change: Remove the uses relationship from api.callback to api.server.

subject: api.callback
text: The api.callback uses api.server relationship is redundant because any servers override lives on the callback's PathItem or operation, so it duplicates a pathitem-to-server relationship and can be derived transitively through api.callback aggregates api.pathitem.
proposed_change: Delete api.callback uses api.server and derive the server link transitively via the aggregated api.pathitem.

subject: api.components
text: api.components has both an aggregates and a composes relationship to api.response, which are redundant and contradictory.
proposed_change: Keep a single relationship from api.components to api.response and remove the other.

subject: api.components
text: The api.components composes api.paths relationship is wrong because Paths is a root-level sibling of components, not a child of it.
proposed_change: Remove the composes edge from api.components to api.paths.

subject: api.components
text: The api.components composes api.responses relationship is wrong because components holds individual Response entries, not operation-scoped Responses maps.
proposed_change: Remove the composes edge from api.components to api.responses.

subject: api.components
text: api.components relationships to registry entry kinds use aggregates for some kinds (callback, example, link, requestbody, response) and composes for others (header, parameter, schema, securityscheme) with no clear basis for the difference.
proposed_change: Use one consistent predicate for all registry entry kinds held by api.components.

subject: api.contact
text: The relationship api.contact associated-with api.openapidocument is an indirect shortcut, because Contact is structurally nested in the Info object, which the document composes, and it may be redundant once a containment link via api.info exists.
proposed_change: Consider removing the document-level associated-with relationship from api.contact to api.openapidocument once containment via api.info is expressed.

subject: api.encoding
text: The relationship api.encoding associated-with api.mediatype understates the link, because MediaType composes its encoding entries; it should be expressed as composition from MediaType (api.mediatype composes api.encoding already exists).
proposed_change: Remove the associated-with relationship from api.encoding to api.mediatype and rely on composition from api.mediatype to api.encoding.

subject: api.encoding
text: The relationship api.encoding associated-with api.parameter has no basis in OpenAPI 3.0, because encodings apply only to request-body media types.
proposed_change: Drop the associated-with relationship from api.encoding to api.parameter.

subject: api.encoding
text: The relationships api.encoding composes api.header and api.encoding references api.header are not redundant: composes is an inline header declaration while references is a $ref.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: api.example
