text: TestCoverageModel both aggregates and composes TestCoverageTarget, which is contradictory; since the model is a root container, composition is the fitting relationship.
proposed_change: Remove the aggregates relationship to testcoveragetarget and keep the composes relationship.

subject: testing.testcoveragemodel
text: TestCoverageModel aggregates ContextVariation, InputSpacePartition and TestCaseSketch, but as root container it should compose them, consistent with the root container definition.
proposed_change: Change the aggregates relationships to contextvariation, inputspacepartition and testcasesketch into composes relationships.

subject: testing.testcoveragemodel
text: TestCoverageModel composing InputPartitionSelection directly duplicates the composition that already occurs via CoverageRequirement.
proposed_change: Remove the direct composes relationship from testcoveragemodel to inputpartitionselection.

subject: testing.testcoveragemodel
text: The predicate 'tests' used for technology elements (systemsoftware, technologyservice) is inconsistent with 'covers' used for other target elements.
proposed_change: Rename the 'tests' predicate to 'covers' for the technology targets.

subject: testing.testcoveragemodel
text: The 'fulfills-requirements' predicate to motivation.requirement does not fit since a test plan verifies rather than fulfills requirements; 'validates' is more apt.
proposed_change: Replace the 'fulfills-requirements' predicate with 'validates'.

subject: testing.testcoveragetarget
text: The composes edge from testing.testcoveragetarget to testing.inputpartitionselection conflicts with the definition of InputPartitionSelection as part of a CoverageRequirement.
proposed_change: Remove the composes edge from testcoveragetarget to inputpartitionselection or reconcile it with the definition.

subject: testing.testcoveragetarget
text: The flows-to edge from testing.testcoveragetarget to testing.coveragerequirement duplicates the composes edge between the same types.
proposed_change: Remove the flows-to edge to coveragerequirement and keep composes.

subject: testing.testcoveragetarget
text: The covers and tests relationships from testing.testcoveragetarget to the artifacts it exercises overlap in meaning.
proposed_change: Pick one of covers or tests and drop the other.

subject: testing.testcoveragetarget
text: The fulfills-requirements and supports-goals edges from testing.testcoveragetarget are semantically dubious because a test target verifies requirements rather than fulfilling them.
proposed_change: Replace fulfills-requirements (and supports-goals) with a validates relationship.

subject: testing.testcoveragetarget
text: The self-composition edge testing.testcoveragetarget composes testing.testcoveragetarget has no defined meaning.
proposed_change: Define the meaning of self-composition (e.g. nested targets) or remove the edge.

subject: ux.actioncomponent
text: The relationship ux.actioncomponent renders ux.componentreference contradicts the componentreference definition, which says a reference is not a rendered occurrence.
proposed_change: Remove the renders relationship from actioncomponent to componentreference or redefine it.

subject: ux.actioncomponent
text: The relationship ux.actioncomponent accesses data-store.collection bypasses the API and application layers.
proposed_change: Remove the direct access and route data access through API or application layer relationships.

subject: ux.actioncomponent
text: The relationship ux.actioncomponent triggers data-store.storedlogic bypasses the API and application layers.
proposed_change: Remove the direct trigger and route invocation through API or application layer relationships.

subject: ux.actioncomponent
text: The relationships ux.actioncomponent triggers ux.stateaction and ux.actioncomponent triggers ux.statetransition overlap, since state actions run from lifecycle hooks.
proposed_change: Remove or merge one of the two triggers relationships, likely dropping triggers stateaction.

subject: ux.actioncomponent
text: The relationship ux.actioncomponent uses application.applicationfunction conflicts with the application function definition that it is invoked internally.
proposed_change: Remove the uses relationship to applicationfunction.

subject: ux.actioncomponent
text: The relationship ux.actioncomponent realizes business.businessfunction is weak because a control rarely realizes a function.
proposed_change: Remove or replace the realizes relationship to businessfunction with a more suitable predicate.

subject: ux.actionpattern
text: The relationship ux.actionpattern governs ux.stateaction blurs the scope of ActionPattern, because the pattern is described as applied to action components while StateActions are automatic lifecycle effects.
proposed_change: Remove the 'governs' relationship from ux.actionpattern to ux.stateaction.

subject: ux.actionpattern
text: The relationship ux.actionpattern triggers ux.statetransition is questionable because a reusable pattern should not directly trigger a StateTransition; instance-level ActionComponents usually emit the triggering event, so 'triggers' may belong on ActionComponent.
proposed_change: Move the 'triggers' relationship to ux.actioncomponent (ux.actioncomponent triggers ux.statetransition) and remove it from ux.actionpattern.

subject: ux.chartseries
text: The relationship ux.chartseries accesses data-store.collection bypasses layering, since DataConfig says endpoints and entities belong to other layers; it duplicates the binds-to path via ux.dataconfig and should be derived through it.
proposed_change: Remove the direct accesses relationship to data-store.collection and derive it through the binds-to ux.dataconfig path.

subject: ux.chartseries
text: The relationship ux.chartseries maps-to data-model.arrayschema overlaps with the binding's field path (dataField/categoryField).
proposed_change: none stated

subject: ux.chartseries
text: The relationship ux.chartseries uses ux.experiencestate is inverted in meaning, because states govern components rather than series using states.
proposed_change: Reverse the direction or replace the 'uses' predicate so experiencestate governs chartseries.

subject: ux.componentinstance
text: The relationships ux.componentinstance implements ux.librarycomponent and ux.componentinstance realizes ux.librarycomponent express the same meaning and are redundant.
proposed_change: Keep only one predicate between componentinstance and librarycomponent, preferably realizes, and remove implements.

subject: ux.componentinstance
text: The relationship ux.componentinstance renders ux.librarycomponent also overlaps with implements and realizes to librarycomponent.
proposed_change: Remove renders to librarycomponent and keep only realizes.

subject: ux.componentinstance
text: The relationship ux.componentinstance renders ux.layoutconfig uses a wrong predicate because a layout config renders nothing; applies fits better.
proposed_change: Change the predicate from renders to applies for the layoutconfig relationship.

subject: ux.componentinstance
text: The relationships ux.componentinstance aggregates ux.componentreference and ux.componentinstance renders ux.componentreference overlap in meaning.
proposed_change: Keep only one of aggregates or renders between componentinstance and componentreference.

subject: ux.componentinstance
text: The relationship ux.componentinstance provides ux.componentinstance is a self-reference whose meaning is vague.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: ux.componentinstance
text: The relationship ux.componentinstance maps-to data-model.objectschema arguably belongs on ux.dataconfig rather than on the component instance.
proposed_change: Move the maps-to objectschema relationship from componentinstance to dataconfig.

subject: ux.componentreference
text: The relationship ux.componentreference implements ux.librarycomponent overlaps with ux.componentreference renders ux.librarycomponent, as both express the same link between a reference and a library component.
proposed_change: Remove the implements relationship and keep renders to ux.librarycomponent.

subject: ux.componentreference
text: The predicate implements from ux.componentreference to ux.librarycomponent is semantically wrong because a reference only points at a definition and does not realize it.
proposed_change: Drop implements or replace it with a pointing predicate such as renders.

subject: ux.componentreference
text: The self-referential relationship ux.componentreference renders ux.componentreference allows indirection chains of unclear value.
proposed_change: Remove the self-referential renders relationship or justify it explicitly.

subject: ux.componentreference
text: The relationship ux.componentreference renders ux.actioncomponent may be redundant if action components are library components or instances.
proposed_change: Remove renders to ux.actioncomponent if action components are covered as library components or instances.

subject: ux.componentreference
text: The relationship ux.componentreference uses ux.layoutconfig would fit better with the predicate applies.
proposed_change: Rename the uses predicate to applies.

subject: ux.dataconfig
text: The relationship ux.dataconfig accesses data-store.collection contradicts the DataConfig definition, which says fetching belongs to the application layer and the target belongs to the api or data-model layer, and it skips the API layer.
proposed_change: Remove the direct accesses relationship to data-store.collection or route data access through the API layer.

subject: ux.dataconfig
text: The relationship ux.dataconfig realizes ux.statepattern is dubious because a data binding does not realize a state pattern.
proposed_change: Remove or replace the realizes relationship to ux.statepattern with a more fitting predicate.

subject: ux.dataconfig
text: The relationship ux.dataconfig composes ux.chartseries arguably belongs to the chart component rather than to the data binding.
proposed_change: Remove the composes relationship from dataconfig to chartseries and rely on chartseries binds-to dataconfig or a chart-component-owned composition.

subject: ux.dataconfig
text: The relationship ux.dataconfig binds-to ux.librarycomponent conflicts with the type-versus-instance distinction, since bindings should attach to component instances rather than library component definitions.
proposed_change: Remove the binds-to relationship to ux.librarycomponent and keep binding to componentinstance.

subject: ux.dataconfig
text: The relationships ux.dataconfig maps-to data-model.objectschema and ux.dataconfig references data-model.schemadefinition overlap in meaning.
proposed_change: Consolidate into a single relationship to the data-model schema type.

subject: ux.dataconfig
text: The relationships ux.dataconfig maps-to api.schema and ux.dataconfig maps-to api.response overlap in meaning.
proposed_change: Consolidate the two maps-to relationships into one or define a clear distinction between them.

subject: ux.errorconfig
text: The four 'governs' relationships from ux.errorconfig (to actioncomponent, componentinstance, experiencestate, view) express one attachment idea, and 'governs' is a motivation-layer predicate that fits the ux predicate family poorly; 'applies' would fit better.
proposed_change: Replace the 'governs' predicate with 'applies' on the four ux.errorconfig relationships.

subject: ux.errorconfig
text: The 'maps-to' relationship from ux.errorconfig to api.response uses a predicate classed as schema/table mapping, which does not fit a response link; 'associated-with' or 'references' may suit better.
proposed_change: Change the predicate of the ux.errorconfig to api.response relationship from 'maps-to' to 'associated-with' or 'references'.

subject: ux.experiencestate
text: The relationships associated-with, governs and renders from ux.experiencestate to ux.view overlap in meaning, and governs (component enablement) is the only meaningful one.
proposed_change: Keep governs and remove associated-with and renders between ux.experiencestate and ux.view.

subject: ux.layoutconfig
text: The relationships ux.layoutconfig governs ux.view and ux.layoutconfig provides ux.view express essentially the same fact (the view uses this layout), so they are redundant; one should be kept, preferably using 'applies'.
proposed_change: Remove one of governs/provides between LayoutConfig and View and keep a single relationship using the 'applies' predicate.

subject: ux.librarycomponent
text: The relationships ux.librarycomponent composes ux.actioncomponent and ux.librarycomponent renders ux.actioncomponent overlap heavily in meaning, so only one predicate should be kept.
proposed_change: Keep only one of composes or renders between ux.librarycomponent and ux.actioncomponent.

subject: ux.librarycomponent
text: The relationships ux.librarycomponent composes ux.librarycomponent and ux.librarycomponent renders ux.librarycomponent overlap heavily in meaning, so only one predicate should be kept.
proposed_change: Keep only one of composes or renders between ux.librarycomponent and ux.librarycomponent.

subject: ux.librarycomponent
text: The relationship ux.librarycomponent renders ux.componentreference is semantically odd because a component reference is a declaration rather than a rendered occurrence.
proposed_change: Remove or replace the renders predicate to ux.componentreference with one that fits a declaration.

subject: ux.librarycomponent
text: The relationship ux.librarycomponent satisfies motivation.principle conflicts with the principle definition because satisfaction of a principle is not directly verifiable; governed-by-principles fits better.
proposed_change: Replace satisfies with governed-by-principles for the relationship to motivation.principle.

subject: ux.librarysubview
text: The relationships ux.librarysubview aggregates ux.componentinstance and ux.librarysubview composes ux.componentinstance are contradictory; the ComponentInstance definition implies composition, so the aggregates relationship is redundant or wrong.
proposed_change: Remove the aggregates relationship from ux.librarysubview to ux.componentinstance and keep composes.

subject: ux.librarysubview
text: The relationship ux.librarysubview uses ux.layoutconfig would read better with the 'applies' predicate, which is the ux predicate for configuration or style.
proposed_change: Change the predicate of the relationship to ux.layoutconfig from 'uses' to 'applies'.

subject: ux.librarysubview
text: The relationship ux.librarysubview uses ux.dataconfig arguably overlaps with a 'binds-to' relationship.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: ux.stateaction
text: The relationship ux.stateaction flows-to ux.statetransition inverts the documented containment, since transitions own and run actions; if the intent is an action dispatching an event that fires a transition, 'triggers' would fit better.
proposed_change: Replace the flows-to predicate from StateAction to StateTransition with 'triggers' (or reverse the direction to reflect containment).

subject: ux.stateaction
text: The relationship ux.stateaction specializes ux.stateactiontemplate describes instantiation with parameter values rather than subtyping, so 'specializes' is semantically inaccurate.
proposed_change: Change the predicate from 'specializes' to 'realizes' or 'implements'.

subject: ux.stateactiontemplate
text: The relationships ux.stateactiontemplate implements ux.stateaction and ux.stateactiontemplate provides ux.stateaction express the same meaning (the action instantiates the template), so one is redundant.
proposed_change: Keep only one of implements or provides between StateActionTemplate and StateAction and remove the other.

subject: ux.stateactiontemplate
text: The relationship ux.stateactiontemplate implements ux.stateaction is inverted, because the concrete StateAction realizes the abstract template rather than the template implementing the action.
proposed_change: Reverse the direction so StateAction realizes/implements StateActionTemplate, or drop it in favor of the existing specializes relationship.

subject: ux.stateactiontemplate
text: The relationship ux.stateactiontemplate governs ux.statetransition is indirect, because the template only constrains transitions through the StateActions placed on them.
proposed_change: Remove or rework the direct governs relationship to StateTransition, expressing the link via StateAction instead.

subject: ux.statepattern
text: The relationships ux.statepattern aggregates ux.experiencestate and ux.statepattern governs ux.experiencestate overlap on the same pattern-to-state pair, since both express membership/rule-setting.
proposed_change: Remove one of the two relationships, keeping a single membership relationship between ux.statepattern and ux.experiencestate.

subject: ux.statepattern
text: The 'governs' predicate on ux.statepattern to ux.experiencestate is a motivation-layer influence predicate and fits poorly for UX structural relationships.
proposed_change: Drop 'governs' and use composes instead if states are defined inline in the pattern.

subject: ux.statepattern
text: ux.transitiontemplate names an animation, which risks confusion with state-machine transitions (ux.statetransition) used by ux.statepattern.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: ux.statetransition
text: The relationship ux.statetransition --[navigates-to]--> ux.experiencestate uses a predicate catalogued as UI navigation between screens or routes, but ExperienceState is explicitly not a screen or route, so the predicate does not fit.
proposed_change: Replace navigates-to with a dedicated 'targets-state' predicate, or with flows-to.

subject: ux.statetransition
text: The relationship ux.statetransition --[associated-with]--> ux.actioncomponent is vague and does not express the ActionComponent's role as the event source of the transition.
proposed_change: Replace associated-with with the more precise 'triggered-by' predicate.

subject: ux.subview
text: The relationship ux.subview uses ux.librarysubview duplicates ux.subview realizes ux.librarysubview, since both express the ref placement of a library sub-view.
proposed_change: Remove the uses relationship to ux.librarysubview and keep realizes.

subject: ux.subview
text: The relationships ux.subview renders ux.componentinstance and ux.subview aggregates ux.componentinstance overlap in meaning.
proposed_change: Collapse the renders and aggregates relationships to componentinstance, preferring composes for inline sub-views.

subject: ux.subview
text: The relationship ux.subview uses ux.layoutconfig would fit better with the predicate applies than uses.
proposed_change: Replace the uses predicate with applies for the relationship to ux.layoutconfig.

subject: ux.subview
text: The relationship ux.subview serves application.applicationservice reverses the usual direction, since the application service serves the UI.
proposed_change: Reverse the direction so application.applicationservice serves ux.subview, or remove the relationship.

subject: ux.subview
text: The relationship ux.subview accesses data-store.collection skips the API layer, so a UI element should not access a data store collection directly.
proposed_change: Remove the direct accesses relationship to data-store.collection and route data access through the API layer.

subject: ux.tablecolumn
text: The maps-to relationships from ux.tablecolumn to data-store.field and to data-model.schemaproperty, plus binds-to dataconfig, all describe the column's data source redundantly; the column should usually map only to the schema property.
proposed_change: Keep only the maps-to relationship to data-model.schemaproperty and remove the maps-to data-store.field and binds-to dataconfig relationships.

subject: ux.tablecolumn
text: The renders relationship from ux.tablecolumn to ux.componentinstance is odd because the column is itself part of a table ComponentInstance.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: ux.tablecolumn
text: The uses relationship from ux.tablecolumn to ux.layoutconfig overlaps with the column's own width and textAlign attributes.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: ux.transitiontemplate
text: The relationships flows-to from ux.transitiontemplate to ux.experiencestate and ux.subview misstate the role of a TransitionTemplate, which describes how a change animates rather than which change occurs; an 'applies' predicate would fit better and be consistent across targets.
proposed_change: Replace flows-to to ExperienceState and SubView with an 'applies' relationship.

subject: ux.transitiontemplate
text: The navigates-to relationship from ux.transitiontemplate to ux.view misstates the template's role, since a TransitionTemplate describes animation and does not navigate; 'applies' would fit better.
proposed_change: Replace navigates-to View with an 'applies' relationship to View.

subject: ux.transitiontemplate
text: The triggers relationship from ux.transitiontemplate to ux.stateaction conflicts with StateAction being executed by state/transition lifecycle hooks rather than by animations.
proposed_change: Remove the triggers relationship to StateAction.

subject: ux.transitiontemplate
text: The governs relationship from ux.transitiontemplate to ux.statetransition overlaps in meaning with the proposed 'applies' relationship.
proposed_change: Merge governs into the 'applies' relationship, or remove it.

subject: ux.uxlibrary
text: ux.uxlibrary has both 'aggregates' and 'provides' relationships to ux.librarycomponent, which overlap because membership and export usually coincide; keep 'aggregates' only if it covers internal, unexported members, otherwise drop one.
proposed_change: Drop one of aggregates/provides for librarycomponent, keeping aggregates only if it is meant to cover internal unexported members.

subject: ux.uxlibrary
text: ux.uxlibrary has both 'aggregates' and 'provides' relationships to ux.librarysubview, which overlap because membership and export usually coincide; keep 'aggregates' only if it covers internal, unexported members, otherwise drop one.
proposed_change: Drop one of aggregates/provides for librarysubview, keeping aggregates only if it is meant to cover internal unexported members.

subject: ux.uxlibrary
text: The ux.uxlibrary description mentions state and action patterns, but no relationships link ux.uxlibrary to ux.statepattern or ux.actionpattern.
proposed_change: Add relationships from ux.uxlibrary to ux.statepattern and ux.actionpattern (e.g. provides).

subject: ux.uxspec
text: The relationship ux.uxspec governs ux.errorconfig is only plausible if specs define default error policies; otherwise error configs attach to views, components, routes and bindings, making the link from uxspec indirect.
proposed_change: Remove or justify the uxspec governs errorconfig relationship, or ensure uxspec defines default error policies; otherwise attach errorconfig to views, components, routes and bindings.

subject: ux.uxspec
text: The relationship ux.uxspec aggregates ux.experiencestate may use the wrong predicate, because experience states are usually composed within a state machine and do not exist independently, so composes may fit better than aggregates.
proposed_change: Change the predicate from aggregates to composes for the uxspec to experiencestate relationship.

subject: ux.view
text: The relationship ux.view uses ux.layoutconfig duplicates ux.view applies ux.layoutconfig; the applies relationship should be kept.
proposed_change: Remove ux.view uses ux.layoutconfig and keep applies.

subject: ux.view
text: The relationships ux.view aggregates ux.subview and ux.view composes ux.subview overlap and need a distinction between referenced sets and inline composition.
proposed_change: Define aggregates as a reference-set of subviews and composes as inline subviews, documenting the distinction.

subject: ux.view
text: The relationship ux.view renders ux.componentinstance overlaps with ux.view aggregates ux.actioncomponent.
proposed_change: none stated

subject: ux.view
text: The relationship ux.view realizes motivation.goal should use a supports-goals predicate instead of realizes.
proposed_change: Replace realizes with supports-goals for the view to goal relationship.

subject: ux.view
text: The maps-to predicate is a data-mapping predicate and is misused for ux.view relationships to motivation.outcome and business.businessobject.
proposed_change: Replace maps-to with a more appropriate predicate for these relationships.

subject: ux.view
text: The relationship ux.view serves application.applicationservice is inverted, since application services serve the UI rather than the view serving them.
proposed_change: Reverse the direction so application.applicationservice serves ux.view.
